author: john-bunyan
fields.title: Ekisa Ekyayitirira eri Asinga Aboonoonyi Bonna
fields.subtitle: Okusaasira kwa Katonda mu Kristo eri Omuweereza We
fields.description: Ebyafaayo John Bunyan bye yawandiika ku kukyuka kwe yennyini — emyaka egy’entiisa, okubuusabuusa, n’ennyiriri za Bayibuli ze yawuliranga ekitundu, egyakulembera Olugendo lw’Omutambuze. Tekikweka kuggwaamu ssuubi, era kiri mu bitabo ebisooka mu Lungereza okunnyonnyola obulamu obw’omunda obw’omuntu owa bulijjo ng’obulaba okuva munda.

qa.question: Ekitabo Ekisa Ekyayitirira eri Asinga Aboonoonyi Bonna kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Bye byafaayo John Bunyan bye yawandiika ku kukyuka kwe yennyini — emyaka emingi egy’entiisa, okubuusabuusa, n’ennyiriri ze yawuliranga ekitundu, egyakulembera okuwandiika kwe Olugendo lw’Omutambuze. Tekikweka kuggwaamu ssuubi, kiraga engeri ekisa gye kyakwata omusajja eyali abonyaabonyezebwa, era kiri mu bitabo ebisooka mu Lungereza okunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu bwe butyo ebyo omuntu owa bulijjo by’ayitamu mu mwoyo.

qa.question: John Bunyan yali ani?
qa.answer: Yali muddabiriza w’ebintu eby’ekyuma Omungereza ow’omu kyasa ekya kkumi n’omusanvu, ataasoma nnyo, eyafuuka omubuulizi Omupuritani, era oluvannyuma lw’emyaka kkumi n’ebiri mu kkomera ly’e Bedford olw’okubuulira nga talina lukusa, n’awandiika Olugendo lw’Omutambuze. Ekitabo kino bye byafaayo bye eby’omwoyo, emboozi ey’omunda ey’okukyuka okwali emabega w’olugero lwe olumanyiddwa ennyo.

qa.question: Lwaki omutwe gwogera ku 'asinga aboonoonyi bonna'?
qa.answer: Kubanga Bunyan yeetwala ng’omusingayo obubi ekisa kye kyali kirokodde — ng’addamu ebigambo bya Pawulo mu 1 Timoseewo nti Kristo yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi, 'mu bo nze mwonoonyi asookera ddala.' Omutwe si kwetoowaza okw’obulimba, wabula kukakasa okukkalidde okw’omusajja eyeewuunya nti okusaasira kwatuuka ne ku ye, era kuteeka ekitabo kyonna ng’obujulirwa ku bunene bw’ekisa.

qa.question: Bunyan ayogera ku bumanyirivu bwa ngeri ki?
qa.answer: Obwali obuwanvu era obw’omuyaga — emyaka egy’okunenyezebwa mu mwoyo, okutya, n’okubulako katono okuggwaamu ssuubi, ennyiriri za Bayibuli ezimu mwe zaamubetentanga oba okumubudaabuda, oluusi okumala wiiki nnamba. Awandiika ku kukemebwa, okubuusabuusa obanga yali akoze ekibi ekitasonyiyibwa, n’okukakasibwa okwajja mpola mpola era nga kukoma ne kudda, n’obwesimbu bw’omunda obwali obutono mu mulembe gwe.

qa.question: Lwaki ekitabo kikulu mu byafaayo?
qa.answer: Kubanga kiri mu byafaayo ebisooka era ebisinga okunoonyereza mu Lungereza ku bulamu obw’omunda obw’omwoyo obw’omuntu owa bulijjo — akabonero akakulu mu byafaayo by’abantu ku bulamu bwabwe obw’omwoyo. Engeri gye kigoberera n’obwesimbu okubuusabuusa, entiisa, n’ekisa yakwata ku nnono yonna ey’Abapuritani n’ey’enjiri ey’okwekebera, era kiwa abasomi eddirisa erizibu okufuna ku ngeri omusajja eyawandiika Olugendo lw’Omutambuze gye yakolebwamu.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kimalamu amaanyi?
qa.answer: Tekikweka kuggwaamu ssuubi, era Bunyan takweka kizikiza kye na kimu — naye ensonga yaakyo yonna kye kisa ekyakizibwa. Omutwe gukyogera: ekisa ekyayitirira, ekituuka ne ku asinga aboonoonyi bonna. Eri abasomi abaamanya okubuusabuusa kwabwe n’okutya kwabwe, obwesimbu bwa Bunyan buba kubudaabudibwa, n’okuwonyezebwa kwe kuba ssuubi.

qa.question: Kikwatagana kitya ne Olugendo lw’Omutambuze?
qa.answer: Ekitabo kino ye mboozi ey’amazima ey’omunda eri emabega w’olugero. Omugugu, entiisa, ebisuubizo ebyawulirwa ekitundu, n’okukakasibwa okw’enkomerero Bunyan by’annyonnyola wano mu bulamu bwe biddamu okulabika, nga byambaziddwa ng’ebifo n’abantu, mu lugendo lw’Omukristaayo. Okukisoma kuzza obuziba mu lugero ng’olaga obumanyirivu obw’amazima mwe lwakulira.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanye kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, ng’agoberera emboozi ya Bunyan okuva mu buvubuka bwe obw’obutafaayo okuyita mu lutalo lwe oluwanvu okutuuka ku kukakasibwa. Mboozi ey’omuntu ayogera ku bubwe egendereddwamu okusomebwa mu nteeko, era bw’esomebwa bw’etyo, ebyafaayo byayo eby’ekisa nga kikwata omusajja eyali aggwaamu essuubi bifuuka emboozi ekwata omutima era, eri bangi, endabirwamu y’obumanyirivu bwabwe bennyini.

fields.title: Ebigambo by’Omufulumya
fields.body_html:
EBIGAMBO EBISOOKA EBY’OMUFULUMYA

John Bunyan yazaalibwa e Elstow, okumpi ne Bedford, mu Bungereza, mu kiseera ky’ebikoola okugwa mu mwaka 1628, nga ye mwana omubereberye ku baana basatu Thomas ne Margaret Bunyan be baazaala. Ekitabo ky’ekkanisa y’omu kitundu ekiwandiikibwamu abantu kiraga nti yabatizibwa nga 30 Novemba 1628.

Mu Ekisa Ekyayitirira, Bunyan ayogera ku lulyo lwe nti lwali “lwa wansi era olutaaliko bwe lulowoozebwako.” Ennyumba ya kitaawe yali aginyooma nnyo; gy’ali yali “ya ddaala erisinga obunyoomi n’okunyoomebwa mu nnyumba zonna ez’omu nsi.”

Sir Walter Scott yalowooza nti John Bunyan yava mu lulyo lw’Abajipusi, kubanga kitaawe yali omuyunzi w’ebintu by’ebyuma eyatambulanga, ng’addaabiriza ensuwa n’ebisaanikira. Naye abannyonnyozi b’ebyafaayo balaba omulimu ogwo ng’ogufaananako n’ogwa “omuweesi w’ekyalo.” Aba Bunyan tebaali bantu abataliiko maka; baalina ettaka, wadde nga baali ba lulyo lwa bakopi.

Bunyan teyasoma bbanga ddene, era tekyalwa n’atandika okuyamba kitaawe n’okuyiga omulimu ogwo yennyini. Ku lunaku lwe yaweza emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, Bunyan yeegatta ku Ggye Eriggya erya Cromwell (New Model Army), era eyo gye yasisinkanira ekibiina ky’Abapuliitani. Bwe yamala obuweereza obwo obw’amagye, n’atereera ng’omuyunzi w’ebintu by’ebyuma (“omukozi w’ebikomo”), n’awasa ng’alina emyaka abiri.

Mu 1653 Bunyan yeegatta ku Kkanisa Ey’eddembe ey’Abapuliitani e Bedford, ne mu 1657 n’atandika omulimu gwe ogwasooka ng’“omubuulizi ow’omu nnimiro.” Mu biseera ebyo waaliwo abasajja bangi nnyo, abasinga nga tebasoma nnyo, abaabuuliranga abantu abataagoberera Kkanisa ya Gavumenti (Nonconformists) mu Bungereza yonna. Charles II bwe yazzibwa ku ntebe y’obwakabaka, ababuulizi abo ne batandika okuteeberezebwa era nga bakwatibwa. Bunyan bwe yagaana okulekera awo okubuulira, n’akwatibwa mu 1660 n’asibibwa mu kkomera okumala emyaka egisukka kkumi na gumu.

Ekisa Ekyayitirira eri Asinga Aboonoonyi Bonna, ekyawandiikibwa mu kusibibwa okwo, kye kitabo Bunyan mwe yawandiikira ebyafaayo bye eby’omwoyo — omuyunzi w’ebintu by’ebyuma eyatambulanga, eyafuuka omubuulizi era omuwandiisi ow’ettutumu. Kiri mu kika kye kimu ne Confessions ya Augustine ne Imitation of Christ ya Thomas a Kempis. Si kitabo ekinnyonnyola mu bujjuvu obulamu bwa Bunyan obw’edda, kubanga kitubuulira kitono nnyo ku buvubuka bwe, ku kusoma kwe, ku bye yayitamu mu magye, ne ku bufumbo bwe.

Ekyawandiikibwa mu 1666, Ekisa Ekyayitirira kinnyonnyola olugendo lwa Bunyan olw’omwoyo, okuva mu bulamu obw’obugwagwa obujjudde okukolima, okuvvoola, n’okwonoona Ssabbiiti, okutuuka ku kufuuka ekitonde ekiggya mu Kristo Yesu. Abamu ku abo abannyonnyola obulamu bwa Bunyan n’emirimu gye balowooza nti Bunyan yayogera bubi nnyo ku bulamu bwe obw’edda okusinga bwe bwali. George Offor, eyakuŋŋaanya emirimu gya Bunyan mu bitabo bisatu, agamba nti:

Abasajja abayivu bayogedde ebirowoozo eby’enjawulo ennyo ku kubanga ebyo Bunyan by’ayogera ku ye yennyini birina okutegeerwa nga bwe biri ddala, ku bikwata ku mpisa ze embi nga tannakyuka, oba nga yeetunuulira ng’ayita mu ndabirwamu egigaziya emize gye emibi. Tewali ayinza kubuusabuusa bwesimbu bwe obutuukiridde. Annyonnyola mu lwatu empisa ze embi, era n’ennungi ezaamuwonya; era ebyo by’ayogera tebirabika nga bigaziyiziddwa.

Ekisa Ekyayitirira kitabo ky’ebyafaayo by’omuntu yennyini ekitandika n’omusango gw’omutima n’okuggwaamu essuubi, ne kikomekkerezebwa n’omutima “ogujjudde okubudaabudibwa,” omutima ogwebaza olw’“ekisa ekyayitirira.”

Abo abaasoma Ekisa Ekyayitirira era ne Olugendo lw’Omutambuze bajja kutegeera nti Olugendo lw’Omutambuze, mu kitundu ekinene, bwe bulamu bwe bumu obunnyonnyolwa mu Ekisa Ekyayitirira, naye nga bwogerwa mu lugero mu kifo ky’okubuulirwa obutereevu. George Offor alaga ensonga eno bw’ajuliza Dr. Cheever:

Bw’osoma “Ekisa Ekyayitirira”, buli ddaala ky’otuukako ky’oyagala okugamba nti, Ono ye agenda okuwandiika “Olugendo lw’Omutambuze”. Kiri ng’oyimiridde kumpi n’omubazzi w’ebifaananyi omukugu, ng’olaba buli kuseeseetula kw’ennyondo ye, ng’omaze okulaba ekifaananyi ky’ategeka; buli lw’akuba, akatundu akapya ak’obulungi bw’ekyo ekigenda okubaawo ne kalabika mu lwatu.

Ernest W. Bacon, mu kitabo ky’ebyafaayo bya Bunyan ekyakawandiikibwa nga kyesigamiziddwa ku kunoonyereza kw’ebyafaayo okusembayo, alaga ensonga y’emu:

Ebyo by’ayitamu [Bunyan] by’awandiika mu Ekisa Ekyayitirira birabika mu bantu abali mu Olugendo lw’Omutambuze, era tekuli kubuusabuusa kungi nti teyandisobodde kuwandiika lugero olwo olukulu singa teyafuna kusaasira kwa Katonda okulokola okunnyonnyolwa mu kitabo ky’ebyafaayo bye. Kirimu obulamu obutafa n’obuvubuka obw’olubeerera, kiwandiiko ky’ebyo Abapuliitani bye baayitamu ekitasingibwa, era kizzaamu omwoyo amaanyi mu ngeri ey’omuwendo ennyo.

Obukulu bwa Ekisa Ekyayitirira Hugh Martin abufunza bw’ati:

Ekisa Ekyayitirira kiri mu mboozi ezisinga obukulu ku ngeri Katonda gy’akolaganamu n’emmeeme y’omuntu — eky’okuteeka ku lubaawo lw’ebitabo wamu n’eby’obugagga nga Confessions ya Augustine, Serious Call ya Law, Autobiography ya Baxter, n’ebyo Wesley bye yawandiika ku kulumwa kwe okw’omwoyo.

fields.title: Ennyanjula, oba Ennyinyonnyola Ennyimpi ku Kufulumya Omulimu Guno
fields.body_html:
ENNYANJULA

OBA ENNYINYONNYOLA ENNYIMPI KU KUFULUMYA OMULIMU GUNO

EYAWANDIIKIBWA OMUWANDIISI WAAGWO, ERA EWEEREDDWA ABO KATONDA BE YAMUBALA OKUBA OMUSAANIRIZI OKUZAALA MU KUKKIRIZA, MU BUWEEREZA BWE OBW’EKIGAMBO

ABAANA, ekisa kibeere nammwe, Amiina. Wadde nga nzigiddwa gye muli mu mubiri, era nga nsibiddwa nnyo nti siyinza kutuukiriza mulimu ogwo Katonda gwe yanteekako gye muli, olw’okwongera okubazimba n’okubanyweza mu kukkiriza ne mu butukuvu, n’ebirala, naye mulyoke mulabe nti emmeeme yange ebafaako nga kitammwe era yeegomba obulamu bwammwe obw’omwoyo n’obw’emirembe n’emirembe; nze kaakano omulundi omulala, nga bwe nakola edda okuva ku ntikko ya Seniri ne ku ntikko ya Kerumooni, bwe ntyo kaakano okuva mu mpuku ey’empologoma, ne ku nsozi ez’engo (Oluyimba 4:8), mbatunuulira mwenna, nga neegomba nnyo okubalaba nga mutuuse mirembe ku mwalo gwe mwegomba.

Nneebaza Katonda buli lwe mbajjukira; era nsanyuka, ne bwe mba nga nkyali wakati w’amannyo g’empologoma mu ddungu, olw’ekisa, n’okusaasira, n’okumanya Kristo Omulokozi waffe, Katonda bye yabawa, wamu n’okukkiriza n’okwagala okungi. Enjala yammwe n’ennyonta yammwe olw’okwongera okumanya Kitaffe mu Mwana we; obugonvu bw’omutima gwammwe, okukankana kwammwe olw’ekibi, n’empisa zammwe ez’obwegendereza n’obutukuvu mu maaso ga Katonda n’abantu, binzizaamu nnyo amaanyi; ‘Kubanga mmwe kitiibwa kyaffe era essanyu lyaffe’ (1 Abasessaloniika 2:20).

Mbaweerezza wano, nga kiteekeddwa mu bbaluwa eno, ettondo ly’omubisi gw’enjuki ogwo gwe naggya mu mulambo gw’empologoma (Abalamuzi 14:5-9). Nange nagulyako, era gunzizizzaamu nnyo amaanyi. (Ebikemo, bwe tubisisinkana omulundi ogusooka, biba ng’empologoma eyawulugumira Samusooni; naye bwe tubiwangula, omulundi oguddako bwe tubiraba, tulisanga munda mu byo ekisu ky’omubisi gw’enjuki.) Abafirisuuti tebantegeera. Kino kye kimu ku kunnyonnyola omulimu gwa Katonda ku mmeeme yange, okuva ku lubereberye ddala okutuusa kaakano; mwe muyinza okulabira okusuulibwa kwange wansi n’okuyimusibwa kwange; kubanga y’alumya era y’awonya. Kyawandiikibwa mu Byawandiikibwa (Isaaya 38:19) nti, ‘bakitaabwe b’abaana babategeeza nga bw’oli omwesigwa ennyo.’ Weewaawo, olw’ensonga eyo kyennava mmala ebbanga eddene bwe ntyo ku Sinaayi (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 4:10-11), okulaba omuliro, n’ekire, n’ekizikiza, ndyoke ntye Mukama ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwange ku nsi, era mbuulire abaana bange ebikolwa bya Mukama eby’ekitalo (Zabbuli 78:3-5).

Musa (Okubala 33:1-2) yawandiika ku ntambula z’abaana ba Isirayiri, okuva e Misiri okutuuka mu nsi ya Kanani; era n’alagira nti bajjukirenga olugendo lwabwe olw’emyaka amakumi ana mu ddungu. ‘Onojjukiranga emyaka gino gyonna amakumi ana Mukama Katonda gy’azze ng’akukulembera okukuyisa mu ddungu alyoke akugezese, akukakkanye obeere muwombeefu omwetoowaze, era yeekkaanye mu mutima gwo alabe obanga onookwatanga amateeka ge’ (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 8:2). Noolwekyo kino kye ngezezzaako okukola; era si ekyo kyokka, naye n’okukifulumya; bwe kiba nga Katonda ayagadde, abalala balyoke bajjukizibwe ebyo by’akoledde emmeeme zaabwe, nga basoma omulimu gwe gwe yakola ku nze.

Kigasa Abakristaayo okujjukiranga emirundi mingi entandikwa ddala ey’ekisa mu mmeeme zaabwe. ‘Mukama yali bulindaala ekiro ky’olunaku olwo, n’aggya abaana ba Isirayiri mu nsi y’e Misiri; noolwekyo abaana ba Isirayiri banajjukiranga Mukama ekiro ky’olunaku olwo emirembe gyabwe gyonna’ (Okuva 12:42). ‘Ayi Katonda wange,’ Dawudi bw’ayogera (Zabbuli 42:6), ‘emmeeme yange yennyise, yeeraliikiridde; naye nkujjukira olw’ebyo bye wakola mu nsi ya Yoludaani ne ku nsozi engulumivu eza Kalumooni ne ku Lusozi Mizali.’ Era yajjukira ku mpologoma n’eddubu, bwe yali agenda okulwana n’omusajja omuwagguufu ow’e Gaasi (1 Samwiri 17:36-37).

Yali mpisa ya Pawulo eya bulijjo (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 22), era ne bwe yali awozesebwa ng’obulamu bwe buli mu kabi (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 24), okunnyonnyolanga buli kiseera, mu maaso g’abalamuzi be, engeri gye yakyukamu: yalowoozanga ku lunaku olwo, n’essaawa eyo, mwe yasookera okusisinkana ekisa; kubanga yakisanga nga kimuwanirira. Katonda bwe yamala okuyisa abaana ba Isirayiri mu Nnyanja Emyufu, n’abatwala wala mu ddungu, baali balina okukyuka ne baddayo eyo, okujjukira okubbira kw’abalabe baabwe (Okubala 14:25). Kubanga wadde nga baali bamaze okuyimba nga bamutendereza, naye ‘waayita akabanga katono ne beerabira ebyo byonna bye yakola’ (Zabbuli 106:11-13).

Mu kwogera kwange kuno muyinza okulaba bingi; bingi, nkyogera nate, ku kisa kya Katonda gye ndi. Nneebaza Katonda nti nsobola okukibala nga kingi, kubanga kyasinga ebibi byange n’ebikemo bya Setaani nabyo. Nsobola okujjukira okutya kwange, n’okubuusabuusa kwange, n’emyezi gyange egy’ennaku nga mbudaabudibwa; biri ng’omutwe gwa Goliyaasi mu mukono gwange. Tewaali kintu eri Dawudi ekyali ng’ekitala kya Goliyaasi, ekitala ekyo ddala ekyandisimbiddwa mu byenda bye; kubanga okukiraba n’okukijjukira kyokka kyamubuuliranga okununula kwa Katonda. Woowe, okujjukira ebibi byange ebinene, n’ebikemo byange ebinene, n’okutya kwange okunene okw’okuzikirira emirembe gyonna! Binzizaamu buggya mu birowoozo okujjukira obuyambi bwange obunene, okuwanirirwa kwange okunene okuva mu ggulu, n’ekisa ekinene Katonda kye yalaga ekinyolwa ekifaanana nga nze.

Abaana bange abaagalwa, mujjukire ennaku ez’edda, n’emyaka egy’ebiseera eby’edda; mujjukire n’ennyimba zammwe ez’ekiro; era mwogere n’emitima gyammwe (Zabbuli 77:5-12). Weewaawo, munoonye n’obunyiikivu, temulekaawo nsonda n’emu mu gwo nga temugyekenneenyezza, kubanga mulimu eky’obugagga ekikusike, kye ky’obugagga eky’ebyo bye mwasooka n’ebyo bye mwaddako okulaba ku kisa kya Katonda gye muli. Mujjukire, nkyogera nate, ekigambo ekyasooka okubakwata; mujjukire entiisa ey’omu muntu wammwe ow’omunda, n’okutya okufa ne ggeyeena; mujjukire n’amaziga gammwe n’okusaba kwammwe eri Katonda; weewaawo, nga bwe mwasindanga wansi wa buli lukomera nga musaba okusaasirwa. Temulina Lusozi Mizali lwe mujjukira? Mwerabidde ennimiro, ennyumba y’amata, ekiyumba ky’ensolo, etterekero ly’emmere, n’ebirala ebifaanana bwe bityo, Katonda gye yakyalira emmeeme zammwe? Mujjukire n’Ekigambo — Ekigambo, nkyogera nate, Mukama kye yabawa okusuubiriramu. Bwe muba nga mwayonoona nga mumanyi ekituufu; bwe muba nga mukemebwa okuvvoola; bwe muba nga muweddemu essuubi; bwe muba mulowooza nti Katonda abalwanyisa; oba bwe muba nga eggulu likwekeddwa amaaso gammwe, mujjukire nti bwe kyali bwe kityo eri kitammwe, naye mu ebyo byonna Mukama yannunula.

Nnandisobodde okugaziya ennyo mu kwogera kwange kuno, ku bikemo byange n’ebizibu byange olw’ekibi; era ne ku kisa ekijjudde okusaasira n’omulimu gwa Katonda mu mmeeme yange. Nnandisobodde n’okukozesa olulimi olusingako ennyo obugulumivu okusinga kuno kwe nkozesezza wano, era nnandiyooyoozezza ebintu byonna okusinga bwe ndabika nga nkoze wano, naye siguma. Katonda teyazannya bwe yansalira omusango mu mutima, Setaani teyazannya bwe yankema, nange saazannya bwe nakka ng’agwa mu bunnya obutaliiko ntobo, okulumwa okw’emagombe bwe kwankwata; noolwekyo sisaanye kuzannya mu kubinnyonnyola, wabula okubeera omutangaavu era omwangu, nteeke ekintu wansi nga bwe kyali. Akyagala, akikkirize; n’atakyagala, aleete ekisingako. Mweraba.

Abaana bange abaagalwa, amata n’omubisi gw’enjuki biri emitala w’eddungu lino; Katonda abasaasire, era abawe obutaba bagayaavu okuyingira okulya ensi.

fields.title: Ekisa Ekyayitirira eri Asinga Aboonoonyi Bonna; Oba, Ebyafaayo Ebimpi eby’Okusaasira Okungi Ennyo okwa Katonda mu Kristo eri Omuweereza We Omwavu John Bunyan
fields.body_html:
EKISA EKYAYITIRIRA ERI ASINGA ABOONOONYI BONNA;

OBA, EBYAFAAYO EBIMPI EBY’OKUSAASIRA OKUNGI ENNYO OKWA KATONDA MU KRISTO ERI OMUWEEREZA WE OMWAVU JOHN BUNYAN

1. Mu kunnyonnyola kuno okw’omulimu gw’ekisa Katonda gwe yakola ku mmeeme yange, tekiribaamu buzibu, bwe nsooka, mu bigambo bitono, okubalaga ku lunyiriri lwe nva n’engeri gye nnakuzibwamu; obulungi n’obugabi bwa Katonda gy’ali bisobole okweyongera okulabika n’okugulumizibwa mu maaso g’abaana b’abantu.

2. Ku nzaalo yange, nga bangi bwe bamanyi, nava mu lulyo lwa wansi olutalina kitiibwa; ennyumba ya kitange nga yali ya ddaala erisinga obunaku n’okunyoomebwa mu nnyumba zonna ez’omu nsi. Noolwekyo sirina, ng’abalala, kya kwenyumiriza mu musaayi gw’ekitiibwa oba mu buzaale obwa waggulu ng’omubiri bwe gulaba; wabula, nga ndowoozezza ku byonna, ngulumiza Obukulu obw’omu ggulu, kubanga mu mulyango guno mwe yampitira okunzisa mu nsi eno, ndyoke ngabanire ku kisa n’obulamu ebiri mu Kristo olw’enjiri.

3. Naye newankubadde bazadde bange baali banaku era nga tebalina kitiibwa, Katonda yasiima okubateeka ku mutima okuntwala ku ssomero, njige okusoma n’okuwandiika; ekyo nange kye nnatuukako, ng’abaana b’abaavu abalala bwe baatuukangako; wabula, nkyatula nga nkwatiddwa ensonyi, nti amangu ddala ekitono kye nnayiga nnakyerabira, era kumpi kyonna, era ekyo kyaliwo dda nnyo nga Mukama tannakola mulimu gwe ogw’ekisa ogw’okunkyusa mu mmeeme yange.

4. Ku bulamu bwange obw’obuzaaliranwa, mu biseera bye nnamala nga sirina Katonda mu nsi, mazima bwali nga bwe bwali empisa z’ensi eno, era nga ‘omwoyo ogwa Setaani, ogufuga abajeemu bonna’ bwe gwagala (Abaefeso 2:2-3). Kyali kinsanyusa okuba ‘mu mutego gwa Setaani,’ ng’ankozesa by’ayagala (2 Timoseewo 2:26). Nnali njjudde obutali butuukirivu bwonna, era nga bukola n’amaanyi mangi ne bweyoleka mu mutima gwange ne mu bulamu bwange, okuva mu buto bwange, ne kiba nti abaali benkana nange baali batono nnyo, naddala bw’olowooza ku myaka gyange egyali emito era emitono, mu kukolima, mu kulayira, mu kulimba, ne mu kuvvoola erinnya ettukuvu erya Katonda.

5. Weewaawo, ebintu bino byali binsimbiddemu nnyo era nga binnywezeddwamu, ne bifuuka gye ndi ng’obuzaaliranwa obw’okubiri; ekyo, nga bwe nkirowoozezzaako n’obwegendereza oluvannyuma, kyanyiiza nnyo Mukama, ne kiba nti ne mu buto bwange yantiisanga n’ebirooto eby’entiisa, era n’antiitiibya n’okwolesebwa okw’ekikangabwa; kubanga emirundi mingi, bwe nnamalanga olunaku luno n’olulala mu kibi, nga ndi ku kitanda kyange, nga neebase, nnabonyaabonyezebwanga nnyo olw’okutya dayimooni n’emizimu emibi, nga bwe nnalowoozanga mu biseera ebyo, ezaafubanga okunsikira gye ziri, era nga sisobola kuzeewala.

6. Era mu myaka egyo nnabonyaabonyezebwanga nnyo era ne neeraliikirira olw’okulowooza ku lunaku olw’omusango, ekiro n’emisana, era ne nkankana olw’okulowooza ku kubonyaabonyezebwa okw’entiisa okw’omu muliro gwa ggeyeena; nga bulijjo ntya nti kiriba mugabo gwange okusangibwa ku nkomerero wakati mu dayimooni ezo n’emizimu egy’omu ggeyeena, egisibiddwa eyo mu njegere ez’ekizikiza ekitaggwaawo, ‘gye balindiririra okusalirwa omusango.’

7. Ebintu bino, nkigamba nate, bwe nnali nkyali mwana ow’emyaka mwenda oba kkumi gyokka, byanakuwazanga nnyo emmeeme yange, ne kiba nti wakati mu mizannyo gyange emingi n’obutaliimu obw’ekito, wakati mu banange abataliimu, emirundi mingi nnennyamiranga era nga mbonaabona mu birowoozo olw’ebyo; naye era nga siyinza kuleka bibi byange. Weewaawo, mu kiseera ekyo nnali mmaliddwamu nnyo essuubi ery’obulamu n’ery’eggulu, ne kiba nti emirundi mingi neegombanga nti singa ggeyeena teyabaawo, oba nti singa nnali dayimooni—nga ndowooza nti zo zibonyaabonya buboonyabonya; bwe kiba nga kiteekwa okubaawo nti ndigenda eyo, nsobole okuba omubonyaabonya okusinga okubonyaabonyezebwa nze kennyini.

8. Oluvannyuma lw’akaseera, ebirooto ebyo eby’entiisa byandeka, era nange ne mbyerabira mangu; kubanga amasanyu gange gaabimalamu amangu okujjukirwa, ng’ebitaabangawo: kyennava, n’omululu ogusingako, ng’amaanyi g’obuzaaliranwa bwe gaali, ne neeyongera okusumulula enkoba z’okwegomba kwange, ne nsanyukira okusobya kwonna ku mateeka ga Katonda: ne kiba nti, okutuusa lwe nnawasa, nze nnali omukulembeze ddala w’abavubuka bonna abaatambulanga nange, mu buli ngeri y’obubi n’obutatya Katonda.

9. Weewaawo, okwegomba n’ebibala by’omubiri byali bifuga nnyo mmeeme yange eno embi, ne kiba nti singa ekyamagero eky’ekisa eky’omuwendo tekyanziyiza, sandizikiridde kyokka olw’okukubwa obwenkanya obutaggwaawo, naye nandibadde neeteeka ne mu kabi ak’okukubwa amateeka ago agaleetera abamu okuswazibwa n’okukwatibwa ensonyi mu lwatu mu maaso g’ensi.

10. Mu nnaku ezo, okulowooza ku ddiini kwali kunnuma nnyo; saali musobola kukugumiikiriza nze kennyini, wadde okulaba omulala ng’akugoberera; ne kiba nti, bwe nnalabanga abamu nga basoma mu bitabo ebyo ebikwata ku kutya Katonda okw’Ekikristaayo, kyali gye ndi ng’ekkomera. Awo ne ŋŋamba Katonda nti, ‘Ndekera emirembe gyange! Seegomba kumanya makubo go’ (Yobu 21:14). Kaakano nnali sirina kulowooza kwonna okulungi; eggulu ne ggeyeena byombi byali biviiridde ddala mu maaso gange ne mu birowoozo byange; ate ku kulokolebwa n’okuzikirizibwa, ebyo bye nnalowoozangako ekisembayo. Ayi Mukama, ggwe omanyi obulamu bwange, n’amakubo gange tegaakukisibwa.

11. Naye kino nkijjukira bulungi, nti newankubadde nze kennyini nnayinza okwonoona n’essanyu lingi era nga kinnyanguyira, era nga nsanyukira n’obugwagwa bwa banange; naye era ne mu kiseera ekyo, bwe nnalabanga ebikolwa ebibi nga bikolebwa abo abeeyatulanga obulungi, omwoyo gwange gwakankananga. Ng’olumu, okusinga emirundi emirala gyonna, bwe nnali ku ntikko y’obutaliimu bwange, ne mpulira omuntu eyali abalibwa ng’omusajja w’eddiini ng’alayira, kyankuba nnyo mu mwoyo gwange ne kiruma omutima gwange.

12. Naye Katonda teyandekerera ddala, wabula yagenda angoberera, kati si na kunsalira musango mu mutima, wabula n’emisango; naye nga gitabuddwamu okusaasira. Kubanga olumu nnagwa mu kikono ky’ennyanja, ne mpona kumpi okufa amazzi. Omulundi omulala nnagwa okuva mu lyato ne nnyika mu mugga gw’e Bedford, naye okusaasira ne kunkuumira nga ndi mulamu. Ate n’omulundi omulala, bwe nnali mu nnimiro n’omu ku banange, ne kibaawo nti omusota ogw’obusagwa ne gusala ku luguudo; awo nze, nga nkutte omuggo mu ngalo, ne ngukuba ku mugongo; bwe nnamala okugukuba ne guzirika, ne nyasamya akamwa kaagwo n’omuggo gwange, ne nziggyamu oluboobi lwagwo n’engalo zange; era olw’ekikolwa ekyo, singa Katonda teyansaasira, nandyereetedde okufa olw’obuteefaako bwange.

13. Era kino nkyetegerezza nga nneebaza: bwe nnali omuserikale, nze n’abalala twalondebwa okugenda mu kifo ekimu okukizingiza; naye bwe nnali nneetegese okugenda, omu ku banaffe n’asaba okugenda mu kifo kyange; bwe nnakkiriza, n’adda mu kifo kyange; awo bwe yatuuka mu kuzingiza, ng’ayimiridde ng’omukuumi, n’akubwa essasi lya mmundu mu mutwe, n’afa.

14. Wano, nga bwe nnyogedde, waaliwo emisango n’okusaasira, naye tewali na kimu ku byo ekyazuukusa emmeeme yange okudda eri obutuukirivu; kyennava nneeyongera okwonoona, ne neeyongera okujeemera Katonda, ne sifaayo ku bulokozi bwange.

15. Amangu ddala oluvannyuma lw’ebyo, nnakyusa embeera yange ne mpasa, era okusaasira kwe nnafuna kwali nti nnafuna omukazi kitaawe eyali abalibwa ng’omuntu atya Katonda. Omukazi ono nange, newankubadde twagattibwa nga tuli baavu nnyo nga bwe kisoboka, nga tetulina wadde ebintu by’omu nnyumba ng’essowaani oba ekijiiko wakati waffe ffembi, naye ye yalina ku lulwe bino: The Plain Man’s Pathway to Heaven, ne The Practice of Piety, kitaawe bye yamulekera bwe yafa. Mu bitabo ebyo ebibiri nnasomangamu naye oluusi, era mwe nnasanga ebintu ebimu ebyansanyusaako; naye mu biseera ebyo byonna saasalirwa musango mu mutima. Era emirundi mingi yambuuliranga kitaawe nga bwe yali omusajja atya Katonda, n’engeri gye yanenyanga n’okugolola obubi, mu nnyumba ye ne mu baliraanwa be; n’obulamu obukakali era obutukuvu bwe yalimu mu biseera bye, mu kigambo ne mu kikolwa.

16. Noolwekyo ebitabo bino awamu n’ebyo bye yanjulira, newankubadde tebyatuuka ku mutima gwange okuguzuukusa ku mbeera yange ey’ennaku n’ey’ekibi, naye byazaala mu nze okwegomba okumu okw’eddiini: ne kiba nti, kubanga saamanya kisinga awo, nneegatta n’obunyiikivu bungi ku ddiini ey’omu biseera ebyo; kwe kugamba, okugenda ku kkanisa emirundi ebiri olunaku, era nga ndi mu basooka; era eyo ne njogera ne nnyimba n’okwewaayo okungi ng’abalala bwe baakolanga, naye nga nkyakuuma obulamu bwange obubi; wabula ate, nnali mmaliddwamu ddala omwoyo gw’obulombolombo, ne kiba nti nnasinzanga, era n’okwewaayo okungi, ebintu byonna, ekifo ekigulumivu, kabona, omuwandiisi w’ekkanisa, ebyambalo, okusinza, n’ebirala byonna ebyali eby’ekkanisa; nga mbala ebintu byonna ebyalimu okuba ebitukuvu, naddala kabona n’omuwandiisi nga mbalaba ng’abasinga essanyu, era awatali kubuusabuusa abaweereddwa omukisa mungi, kubanga baali baweereza ba Katonda, nga bwe nnalowooza mu kiseera ekyo, era nga be bakulu mu yeekaalu entukuvu okukolerangamu omulimu gwe.

17. Endowooza eno yakula n’amaanyi mangi mu mwoyo gwange mu kiseera kitono, ne kiba nti bwe nnalabanga kabona, newankubadde ng’obulamu bwe bwali bugwagwa era bwa bwenzi nnyo, omwoyo gwange gwavunnamanga wansi we, ne mmussaamu ekitiibwa, ne neegatta naye: weewaawo, nnalowooza nti olw’okwagala kwe nnali nnina gye bali, nga ndowooza nti be baweereza ba Katonda, nandisobodde okugalamira ku bigere byabwe ne bannigaanyiriza; erinnya lyabwe, ebyambalo byabwe, n’omulimu gwabwe byantamiizanga era ne binnoga.

18. Bwe nnamala ebbanga eggwanvu nga bwe ntyo, ekirowoozo ekirala ne kinzijira; nga kino: oba nga twali ba mu Bayisirayiri, oba nedda? Kubanga bwe nnasanga mu Byawandiikibwa nga bo edda baali bantu ba Katonda ab’enjawulo, ne ndowooza nti, singa nnali wa mu lulyo luno, emmeeme yange teyandirema kuba na ssanyu. Ate era ne neesangamu okwegomba okungi okufuna eky’okuddamu ku kibuuzo kino, naye nga simanyi ngeri gye nnandikifunyemu. Ku nkomerero ne nkibuuza kitange; n’ankoberera nti,—Nedda, tetwali. Awo omwoyo gwange ne gugwa olw’essuubi eryo, ne nsigala bwe ntyo.

19. Naye mu biseera ebyo byonna, saategeera kabi na bubi bwa kibi; nnaziyizibwa okulowooza nti ekibi kyandinzikirizza, eddiini yonna gye nnandigoberedde, okuggyako nga nsangibwa mu Kristo. Nedda, saamulowoozangako n’akatono, wadde oba nga waliwo Kristo, oba nedda. Bw’atyo omuntu, ng’akyali muzibe, abula, naye yeekooya n’obutaliimu, kubanga tamanyi kkubo erimutwala mu kibuga kya Katonda (Omubuulizi 10:15).

20. Naye lumu, mu bubaka bwonna omusumba waffe bwe yabuulira, omulamwa gwe gwali ku Ssabbiiti n’obubi bw’okugimenya, oba mu kukola emirimu, mu mizannyo oba mu ngeri endala. Kaakano nze, newankubadde nnalina eddiini yange, nnali omu ku abo abaasanyukiranga ennyo obubi obw’engeri zonna, era naddala olwo lwe lwali olunaku lwe nneesanyusizangako; kyennava ne nsalirwa omusango mu muntu wange ow’omunda nga mpulira okubuulira kwe, nga ndowooza era nga nzikiriza nti okubuulira okwo yakukola mu bugenderevu okundaga ebibi byange; era mu kiseera ekyo ne mpulira omusango kye guli, ekintu kye saali mpulidde ku lubereberye, nga bwe nzijukira; naye awo, okumala akaseera, nnali nzitoowereddwa nnyo nakyo, ne nzirayo eka ng’okubuulira kuwedde, nga nnina omugugu omunene ku mwoyo gwange.

21. Kino, mu kaseera ako, kyazirika ebinywa by’amasanyu gange agasinga, ne kikaayiza gye ndi amasanyu gange ag’edda; naye laba, tekyalwawo, kubanga nga sinnamala bulungi kulya ekyemisana, obuzibu bwatandika okuva mu birowoozo byange, omutima gwange ne gudda mu kkubo lyagwo ery’edda: naye ai! nnasanyuka nnyo nti obuzibu buno bwali bunvuddeko, era nti omuliro gwali guzikidde, ndyoke nnyinze okwonoona nate awatali anziyiza! Kyennava, bwe nnamala okukkusa omubiri gwange n’emmere, ne nziggya okubuulira mu birowoozo byange, ne nzirayo n’essanyu lingi ku mpisa yange ey’edda ey’emizannyo n’okukuba zzaala.

22. Naye ku lunaku olwo lwennyini, bwe nnali wakati mu muzannyo gw’akati (ogwayitibwanga cat), era nga nkubye akati omulundi gumu ne kava ku kinnya, bwe nnali nga ndi kumpi okukakuba omulundi ogw’okubiri, eddoboozi ne libuuka mangu okuva mu ggulu ne liyingira mu mmeeme yange, ne ligamba nti, “Onooleka ebibi byo ogende mu ggulu, oba onookuuma ebibi byo ogende mu ggeyeena?” Kino kyanneewuunyisa nnyo okukamala; kyennava, ne ndeka akati kange wansi, ne ntunula waggulu mu ggulu, era kyali ng’alabye, n’amaaso g’okutegeera kwange, Mukama Yesu ng’antunuulira wansi, ng’ansunguwalidde nnyo ddala, era ng’alinga antiisatiisa n’amaanyi n’ekibonerezo eky’amaanyi olw’empisa zino n’endala ez’obutatya Katonda.

23. Nnali nga nkyakirowoozako bwe ntyo mu birowoozo byange, amangu ago ekirowoozo kino ne kinywezebwa ku mwoyo gwange, kubanga ekyo ekyasooka kyazzaayo ebibi byange mu maaso gange, nti nnali mwonoonyi munene era omubi ennyo, era nti kaakano kyali kikeerezi nnyo gye ndi okunoonya eggulu; kubanga Kristo teyandinsonyiye, wadde okusonyiwa ebisobyo byange. Awo ne ntandika okufumiitiriza ne ku kino; era bwe nnali nkirowoozako, nga ntya nti kiyinza okuba bwe kityo, ne mpulira omutima gwange nga gubbira mu kuggwaamu essuubi, ne nsalawo nti kyali kikeerezi; noolwekyo ne nsalawo mu mutima gwange nti nja kweyongera mu kibi; kubanga nnalowooza nti, bwe kiba nga bwe kiri, embeera yange mazima ya buyinike; ya buyinike bwe ndeka ebibi byange, era ya buyinike bwe mbigoberera; nnyinza okuzikirizibwa obuzikirizibwa, era oba nga kinsaanira okuzikirizibwa, waakiri nzikirizibwe olw’ebibi ebingi, okusinga okuzikirizibwa olw’ebitono.

24. Bwe ntyo ne nnyimirira wakati mu muzannyo gwange, mu maaso g’abo bonna abaaliwo; naye saababuulira kintu: naye nkigamba, bwe nnamala okusalawo bwe ntyo, ne nzirayo mu muzannyo gwange nga mmaliddwamu essuubi; era nzijukira bulungi, nti amangu ago okuggwaamu essuubi kuno kwanyweza nnyo emmeeme yange, ne kiba nti nnakakasa nga sisobola kufuna kubudaabudibwa kulala okuggyako okwo kwe nnandifunye mu kibi; kubanga eggulu lyali limaze okuvaawo, ne kiba nti nnali sirina kulirowoozaako; kyennava ne neesangamu okwegomba okungi okwekkusa ekibi, nga bulijjo nnoonya kibi ki ekyali kikyasigaddeyo okukolebwa, ndyoke mpoomere obuwoomi bwakyo; era ne nnyanguwa nga bwe nnasobola okujjuza olubuto lwange n’ebiwoomerera byakyo, nneme kufa nga sinnatuuka ku kye nneegomba; kubanga ekyo nnakitya nnyo. Mu bintu bino, ndayira mu maaso ga Katonda, sirimba, era seegirirwa njogera eno; bino ddala, n’amaanyi, era n’omutima gwange gwonna, bye byali okwegomba kwange; Mukama omulungi, ow’okusaasira okutanoonyezeka, ansonyiwe ebisobyo byange .

25. Era nkakasa nnyo nti okukemebwa kuno okwa Setaani kubunye nnyo mu bantu abanaku okusinga bangi bwe bamanyi, okutuuka n’okufuga emyoyo gyabwe n’omutima omubi era omukalu, n’okuzirika kw’omuntu ow’omunda; era embeera eyo, Setaani agigattamu mpola era mu bukujjukujju okuggwaamu essuubi okw’engeri eyo, ne kiba nti newankubadde emmeeme terina musango mungi, naye bulijjo baba n’ekirowoozo eky’ekyama munda mu bo, nti tebalina ssuubi; kubanga baagala ebibi, ‘kyebava bateekwa okubigoberera’ (Yeremiya 2:25; 18:12).

26. Kaakano noolwekyo ne neeyongera mu kibi n’omululu mungi mu mutima, nga bulijjo nneemulugunya nti sisobola kukimatira nga bwe nnandyagadde. Kino kyamala nange omwezi gumu oba okusingawo; naye lumu, bwe nnali nnyimiridde ku ddirisa ly’edduuka ly’omuliraanwa, nga eyo nkolima era nga ndayira, era nga nneeyisa ng’omulalu, nga bwe nnali mmanyidde, omukazi nannyini nnyumba yali atudde munda, n’ampulira; era newankubadde nga ye yennyini yali mukazi mugwagwa era atatya Katonda, yalangirira nti nnalayira era ne nkolima mu ngeri ey’entiisa ennyo, ne kiba nti yakankana okumpulira; era n’angamba nate nti nze nnali omusajja asinga obutatya Katonda mu kulayira gwe yali awulidde mu bulamu bwe bwonna; era nti nze, bwe nkola bwe ntyo, nnali nsobola okwonoona abavubuka bonna ab’omu kibuga kyonna, singa baatambulanga nange.

27. Olw’okunenya kuno nnasirika, ne nkwatibwa ensonyi mu kyama, era ekyo, nga bwe nnalowooza, mu maaso ga Katonda ow’omu ggulu; kyennava, bwe nnali nnyimiridde awo, nga nkutamye omutwe, ne neegomba n’omutima gwange gwonna nti singa nzirayo okuba omwana omuto, kitange anjigirize okwogera awatali mpisa eno embi ey’okulayira; kubanga nnalowooza nti, ndi mmanyidde nnyo, ne kiba nti kya bwereere gye ndi okulowooza ku kukyuka, kubanga nnalowooza nti tekirisoboka.

28. Naye engeri gye kyabaawo, simanyi; okuva mu kiseera ekyo ne ndeka okulayira ne kiba nti kyali kyewuunyisa nnyo nze kennyini okukitunuulira; era ate nga edda nnali simanyi kwogera okuggyako nga nteeka ekirayiro mu maaso n’ekirala emabega, ebigambo byange bibeere n’obuzito, kati nnali nsobola, awatali kyo, okwogera obulungi, era n’obuwoomi bungi, okusinga bwe nnali nsobola edda. Mu biseera ebyo byonna nnali simanyi Yesu Kristo, era saaleka mizannyo gyange n’okwesanyusa kwange.

29. Naye amangu ddala oluvannyuma lw’ebyo, ne neegatta n’omusajja omu omwavu eyali eyatula eddiini; eyali, nga bwe nnalowooza mu kiseera ekyo, ayogera bulungi ku Byawandiikibwa ne ku bintu by’eddiini; kyennava, bwe nnatandika okwagala n’okusiima bye yayogeranga, ne neekwata Bayibuli yange, ne ntandika okusanyukira ennyo okusoma, naddala ebitundu byayo eby’ebyafaayo; kubanga ku bbaluwa za Pawulo, n’Ebyawandiikibwa eby’engeri eyo, saabigumiikirizanga, kubanga nnali nkyali mutamanya, ow’obukyamu bw’obuzaaliranwa bwange, n’obwetaavu bwange bwa Yesu Kristo n’omuwendo gwe okundokola.

30. Kyennava ne ntandika okweddaabiriza okw’ebweru, mu bigambo byange ne mu bulamu bwange, ne nteeka ebiragiro mu maaso gange ng’ekkubo lyange eridda mu ggulu; era ebiragiro ebyo ne nfuba okubikuuma, era, nga bwe nnalowooza, oluusi nnabikuumanga bulungi ddala, ne mbudaabudibwa; naye buli lwe nnamenyanga ekimu, ne kiruma omuntu wange ow’omunda; naye ate ne neenenya, ne ŋŋamba nti nnejjusa, ne nsuubiza Katonda okukola obulungi omulundi oguddako, ne ndyoka nfuna nate obuyambi, kubanga mu kiseera ekyo nnalowooza nti nsanyusa Katonda nga bwe kisoboka eri omuntu yenna mu Bungereza.

31. Bwe ntyo ne mmala ng’omwaka mulamba; era mu kiseera ekyo kyonna baliraanwa baffe bantwala ng’omusajja atya Katonda ennyo, omuntu omuggya era ow’eddiini, era ne beewuunya nnyo okulaba enkyukakyuka ennene era emanyiddwa bwetyo mu bulamu bwange ne mu mpisa zange; era, mazima, bwe kyali bwe kityo, newankubadde nga nnali simanyi Kristo, wadde ekisa, wadde okukkiriza, wadde essuubi; era mazima, nga bwe nkirabye obulungi oluvannyuma, singa nnafa mu kiseera ekyo, embeera yange yandibadde ya ntiisa nnyo; kale, kino, nkigamba, kyamala ng’omwaka mulamba oba okusingawo.

32. Naye, nkigamba, baliraanwa bange beewuunya nnyo olw’okukyuka kwange kuno okunene, okuva mu buvvoozi obw’ekitalo okutuuka ku kintu ekifaanana obulamu obw’empisa ennungi; era, mazima, baali basaanidde okwewuunya; kubanga okukyuka kwange kuno kwali kunene, ng’omulalu w’e Bedlam okufuuka omusajja ow’amagezi amatereevu. Kaakano, noolwekyo, ne batandika okuntendereza, okunsiima, n’okunjogerako obulungi, mu maaso gange ne mu bbanga lyange. Kaakano, nga bwe baagamba, nnali mfuuse muntu atya Katonda; kaakano nnali mfuuse omusajja omwesimbu ddala. Naye ai! bwe nnategeera nti bino bye byali ebigambo byabwe n’endowooza zaabwe ku nze, ne kinsanyusa nnyo ddala. Kubanga newankubadde, okutuusa kati, nnali sirina kye ndi okuggyako munnanfuusi omwavu eyasiigibwa langi, naye nnayagalanga okwogerwako ng’omuntu atya Katonda ddala. Nneenyumirizanga mu kutya Katonda kwange, era byonna bye nnakolanga, nnabikolanga okulabibwa abantu oba okwogerwako obulungi abantu. Era bwe ntyo ne mmala ng’omwaka mulamba oba okusingawo.

33. Kaakano mumanye nti, ng’ebyo tebinnabaawo, nnali nsanyukira nnyo okukuba ebide, naye omuntu wange ow’omunda bwe yatandika okugonda, ne ndowooza nti empisa eyo yali ya bwereere, kyennava ne neewaliriza okugireka, naye omutima gwange nga gukyagyegomba; kyennava nnagendanga ku kigo ky’ebide, ne ntunuulira nga bakuba, newankubadde nga saagezangako kukuba. Naye ne ndowooza nti n’ekyo tekyasaanira ddiini, naye era ne neewaliriza, ne nneeyongera okutunuulira; naye amangu ddala oluvannyuma, ne ntandika okulowooza nti, Ate singa ekimu ku bide kigwa? Awo ne nnonda okuyimirira wansi w’omuti omunene ogwali gugalamidde ku kigo, okuva ku ludda olumu okutuuka ku lulala, nga ndowooza nti awo nnyinza okuyimirira nga ndi mu mirembe; naye ate ne ndowooza nate nti, ekide bwe kinaagwa nga kiwuubaala, kiyinza okusooka okukuba ekisenge, ate ne kibuuka ne kinkubako, ne kinzita newankubadde nga ndi wansi w’omuti guno. Kino kyandeetera okuyimirira ku mulyango gw’ekigo; era kaakano nnalowooza nti, ndi mu mirembe ddala; kubanga ekide bwe kinaagwa, nnyinza okufuluma ne neekweka emabega w’ebisenge bino ebinene, bwe ntyo ne nkuumibwa newankubadde.

34. Bwe ntyo, oluvannyuma lw’ebyo, nnagendanga okulaba nga bakuba, naye nga sisukka mulyango gw’ekigo; naye ate ne kinzijira mu mutwe nti, Ate singa ekigo kyennyini kigwa? Era ekirowoozo kino, nti kiyinza okugwa okusinziira ku nze bye mmanyi, bwe nnayimiriranga nga ntunuulira, kyakankanyanga bulijjo nnyo ebirowoozo byange, ne kiba nti saagezaako kuyimirira ku mulyango gw’ekigo nate, wabula ne mpalirizibwa okudduka, olw’okutya nti ekigo kinaangwira ku mutwe.

35. Ekintu ekirala kyali kuzina kwange; nnamala omwaka mulamba nga sinnasobola kukulekera ddala; naye mu kiseera ekyo kyonna, bwe nnalowoozanga nti nkuumye ekiragiro kino oba kiri, oba nti nkoze, mu kigambo oba mu kikolwa, ekintu kyonna kye nnalowooza nti kirungi, nnabanga n’emirembe mingi mu muntu wange ow’omunda; era ne neelowoozaamu nti, Katonda tayinza butasanyuka nange kaakano; weewaawo, okukyogera mu ngeri yange, nnalowooza nti tewali muntu mu Bungereza yali ayinza kusanyusa Katonda okunsinga.

36. Naye, nga ndi munaku bwe ntyo, mu biseera ebyo byonna nnali simanyi Yesu Kristo, nga ngezaako okwenoonyeza obutuukirivu bwange nze; era nandizikiridde mu ekyo, singa Katonda, mu kusaasira kwe, teyandaga bingi ku mbeera yange ey’obuzaaliranwa.

37. Naye lumu, okulabirira okulungi okwa Katonda kwantwala e Bedford, okukola omulimu gwange; era mu kimu ku nguudo z’ekibuga ekyo, ne ntuuka awaali abakazi abaavu basatu oba bana nga batudde ku mulyango ku musana, nga boogera ku bintu bya Katonda; era nga kaakano njagala okuwulira nga boogera, ne nsembera okuwulira bye baali boogera, kubanga kaakano nange nnali mwogezi mukujjukujju mu bintu by’eddiini; naye kaakano nnyinza okugamba nti, nnawulira, naye ne sitegeera; kubanga baali waggulu nnyo, nga sisobola kubatuukako, kubanga ebigambo byabwe byali ku kuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, omulimu gwa Katonda ku mitima gyabwe, era n’engeri gye baasalirwa omusango ku mbeera yaabwe ey’ennaku ey’obuzaaliranwa; baayogera ku ngeri Katonda gye yakyalira emmeeme zaabwe n’okwagala kwe mu Mukama Yesu, n’ebigambo n’ebisuubizo bye baazzibwamu amaanyi, ne babudaabudibwa, ne bawanirirwa nga balwana n’okukemebwa kwa Setaani. Ate era, baayogera naddala ku birowoozo bya Setaani by’assa mu bantu n’okukema kwe; ne babuuliragana bye baali babonyaabonyezebwa nabyo, n’engeri gye baawanirirwamu mu bulumbaganyi bwe. Era baayogera ku bubi bw’emitima gyabwe, ku butakkiriza bwabwe; era ne banyooma, ne bagaaya, ne bakyawa obutuukirivu bwabwe bo, nga bwa bugwagwa era nga tebubamala kubakolera kalungi konna.

38. Era ne ndaba nga boogera ng’abaali boogezebwa essanyu; baayogera n’obuwoomi bungi obw’olulimi lw’Ebyawandiikibwa, era nga ekisa kirabika mu byonna bye baayogera, ne kiba nti gye ndi baali ng’abazudde ensi empya, ng’abantu abeeyawuddeko ababeera bokka, era abatabalibwa mu baliraanwa baabwe (Okubala 23:9).

39. Olw’ekyo ne mpulira omutima gwange nga gutandika okukankana, nga nneebuusabuusa nti embeera yange si nnungi; kubanga nnalaba nti mu birowoozo byange byonna ku ddiini ne ku bulokozi, okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri tekwali kuyingira mu birowoozo byange, wadde nnali mmanyi okubudaabudibwa okw’Ekigambo n’ekisuubizo, wadde obulimba n’enkwe ez’omutima gwange omubi. Ku birowoozo eby’ekyama, saabifaangako; era saategeera kukemebwa kwa Setaani kye kuli, wadde engeri y’okukwaŋŋanga n’okukuziyiza, n’ebirala.

40. Bwe ntyo, noolwekyo, bwe nnamala okuwulira n’okulowooza ku bye baayogera, ne mbaleka, ne nzirayo ku mulimu gwange, naye ebigambo byabwe n’emboozi yaabwe ne bigenda nange; era n’omutima gwange gwasigalanga gye bali, kubanga ebigambo byabwe byankwata nnyo, olw’okuba ku lwabyo nnakakasibwa nti nnali sirina bubonero obwa nnamaddala obw’omuntu atya Katonda ddala, era olw’okuba ku lwabyo nnakakasibwa ku mbeera ey’essanyu era ey’omukisa ey’omuntu ali bw’atyo.

41. Noolwekyo emirundi mingi nnafubanga okugenda enfunda n’enfunda mu bantu bano abaavu, kubanga nnali siyinza kubeewala; era gye nnakoma okugenda mu bo, gye nnakoma okubuusabuusa embeera yange; era nga bwe nkyajjukira, amangu ago ne neesangamu ebintu bibiri, bye nnewuunyanga oluusi, naddala bwe nnalowoozanga nga bwe nnali omuntu muzibe, atamanyi, omugwagwa, era atatya Katonda mu kaseera akaali kayise kokka; ekimu kyali bugonvu n’obwegendereza bw’omutima bungi, obwandeetera okusalirwa omusango ku bye baakakasanga okuva mu Byawandiikibwa; n’ekirala kyali kwegomba kungi mu birowoozo byange okufumiitiriza bulijjo ku byo, ne ku bintu ebirala byonna ebirungi bye nnawuliranga oba bye nnasomanga ekiseera kyonna.

42. Olw’ebintu bino ebirowoozo byange byali bikyuse nnyo, ne kiba nti byali ng’ekinoso ku musuwa, nga bulijjo kireekaana nti, Mpa! mpa! (Engero 30:15); weewaawo, byali binywezeddwa nnyo ku bitaggwaawo, ne ku bintu ebikwata ku bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, kwe kugamba, nga bwe nnali mmanyi, newankubadde, Katonda amanyi, nnali mmanyi bitono nnyo; ne kiba nti amasanyu, wadde amagoba, wadde okusendebwasendebwa, wadde okutiisibwatiisibwa, tebyayinza kubisumulula, wadde okubireetera okulekulira bye byakwata; era newankubadde nkyogera n’ensonyi, naye mazima ddala ge mazima, mu kiseera ekyo kyandibadde kizibu gye ndi okuggya ebirowoozo byange mu ggulu okubizza ku nsi, nga bwe nkizudde emirundi mingi oluvannyuma okubiggya ku nsi okubizza mu ggulu.

43. Ekintu kimu siyinza kukibuusa: Waaliwo omuvubuka mu kibuga kyaffe, omutima gwange gwe gwali gwegasse naye okusinga omuntu omulala yenna, naye ye nga yali muntu mubi nnyo mu kukolima, n’okulayira, n’obwenzi, kaakano ne mmusuula, ne ndeka okutambula naye: naye ng’emyezi esatu bwe gyayitawo nga mmuleseeko, ne musisinkana mu kakubo akamu, ne mmubuuza bw’ali; ye, mu kulayira kwe okw’edda n’engeri ye ey’obulalu, n’anziramu nti ali bulungi. “Naye, Harry,” bwe nnagamba, “lwaki olayira era n’okolima bw’otyo? Kiki ekirikutuukako, bw’olifa ng’oli mu mbeera eno?” N’anziramu ng’asunguwadde nnyo, “Setaani yandibadde atambula n’ani, singa tewaaliwo bali nga nze?”

44. Mu kiseera ekyo ne nsanga ebitabo by’abayitibwa Ranters, ebyafulumizibwa abamu ku bannansi bannaffe, era ebitabo ebyo nga byassibwamu nnyo ekitiibwa abaali beeyatula eddiini edda abawerako; ebimu ku byo ne mbisoma, naye nga sisobola kubisalirako musango; kyennava bwe nnabisomangamu, ne mbirowoozaako, nga mpulira nga siyinza kusalawo, ne neekwata okusaba okw’omutima gwonna mu ngeri eno: Ayi Mukama, ndi musirusiru, era siyinza kwawula mazima ku bukyamu: Mukama, tondekera muzibe wange, okusiima oba okuvumirira enjigiriza eno; oba nga ya Katonda, ka nneme kuginyooma; oba nga ya Setaani, ka nneme kugikkiriza. Mukama, emmeeme yange, mu nsonga eno, ngiteeka ku kigere kyo kyokka; ka nneme kulimbibwa, nkwegayiridde n’obwetoowaze. Nnalina munnange omu ow’eddiini ow’oku lusegere mu biseera ebyo byonna, era oyo ye yali omusajja omwavu gwe nnayogeddeko emabegako; naye mu kiseera ekyo naye n’afuuka omu ku Ranters ow’ekisetaani ennyo, ne yeewaayo eri obugwagwa obw’engeri zonna, naddala obwenzi; era yegaananga nti waliwo Katonda, oba malayika, oba omwoyo; era yasekereranga okubuulirira kwonna okw’okwefuga. Bwe nnafubanga okunenya obubi bwe, yeeyongeranga okuseka, n’agamba nti yali ayise mu ddiini zonna, era nti teyasobola kusanga ntuufu okutuusa kaakano. Era yaŋŋamba nti mu kiseera kitono twandirabye abeeyatula eddiini bonna nga bakyukira amakubo ga Ranters. Kyennava, nga nkyayira ddala enjigiriza ezo ezikolimiddwa, ne mmuleka amangu ago, ne mmufuukira mugwira nnyo nga bwe nnali mukwano gwe ow’oku lusegere edda.

45. Era omusajja ono si ye yekka eyali okukemebwa gye ndi; naye omulimu gwange nga guli mu byalo, ne kibaawo nti ne nneegatta n’abantu abawerako, abaali, newankubadde edda baali bakakali mu ddiini, naye nabo baali bakuluggusiddwa aba Ranters bano. Bano nabo baayogeranga nange ku makubo gaabwe, ne bansalira omusango nti ndi wa mateeka era ndi mu kizikiza; nga bagamba nti bo bokka be baali batuuse ku butuukirivu obujjuvu, abasobola okukola kye baagala, ne batayonoona. Ai! okukemebwa kuno kwali kusaanira omubiri gwange, nga nkyali muvubuka, era obuzaaliranwa bwange nga buli mu buvubuka bwabwo; naye Katonda, eyali, nsuubira, antegekedde ebintu ebisingako, n’ankuuma mu kutya erinnya lye, n’atandeka kukkiriza njigiriza ng’ezo. Era Katonda atenderezebwe, eyanteeka ku mutima okumukaabirira ankuume era anluŋŋamye, nga bulijjo seesiga magezi gange; kubanga oluvannyuma ndabye n’ebyava mu kusaba okwo, mu kunkuuma kwe, si mu bukyamu bwa Ranters bwokka, naye ne mu obwo obwazze bujja oluvannyuma. Bayibuli yali ya muwendo gye ndi mu nnaku ezo.

46. Era kaakano, ne ndaba nga ntandika okutunuulira Bayibuli n’amaaso amaggya, ne nsoma nga bwe saasomangako edda; era naddala ebbaluwa z’omutume Pawulo zaali nnungi era nga ziwooma gye ndi; era, mazima, mu kiseera ekyo saavanga mu Bayibuli, oba mu kusoma oba mu kufumiitiriza; nga bulijjo nkaabirira Katonda, ndyoke mmanye amazima, n’ekkubo eridda mu ggulu ne mu kitiibwa.

47. Era bwe nneeyongera okusoma, ne ntuuka ku kitundu kino, ‘Omu Omwoyo amuwa okwogera ekigambo eky’amagezi, omulala Omwoyo oyo omu n’amuwa okuyiga n’ategeera; omulala Omwoyo y’omu n’amuwa okukkiriza,’ n’ebirala (1 Abakkolinso 12:8-9). Era newankubadde, nga bwe ndabye oluvannyuma, mu Kyawandiikibwa kino Omwoyo Omutukuvu ategeeza naddala ebintu eby’enjawulo ennyo, naye gye ndi mu kiseera ekyo kyannywerera n’okunsalira omusango, nti nnali sirina bintu bya bulijjo, kwe kugamba okutegeera n’amagezi Abakristaayo abalala bye baalina. Ku kigambo kino ne mfumiitiriza, ne simanya kya kukola, naddala ekigambo kino okukkiriza kyanzibuwalira, kubanga saayinza kukyewala, naye oluusi nnateekwanga okwebuuza oba nga nnalina okukkiriza oba nedda; kubanga nnatya nti kyanzigyako emikisa gyonna abantu abalala abalungi gye baaweebwa Katonda; naye nnali saagala kusalawo nti sirina kukkiriza mu mmeeme yange; kubanga bwe nnaakola bwe ntyo, nnalowooza nti, olwo nja kwebala ng’asuuliddwa ddala.

48. Kaakano, ne neegamba nti, newankubadde nkakasizza nti ndi musirusiru atamanyi, era nti sirina birabo ebyo eby’omukisa eby’okumanya n’okutegeera abantu abalala abalungi bye balina; naye, nga neesuula mu kabi, nja kusalawo nti siri wa butakkiriza ddala, newankubadde simanyi kukkiriza kye kuli. Kubanga nnalagibwa, era ekyo, nga bwe ndabye oluvannyuma, Setaani ye yandaga, nti abo abasalawo nti bali mu mbeera ey’obutakkiriza tebalina kuwummula wadde emirembe mu mmeeme zaabwe; era nnali saagala kugwa ddala mu kuggwaamu essuubi.

49. Kyennava, olw’ekirowoozo kino, okumala akaseera ne ntiisibwa okulaba obwetaavu bwange obw’okukkiriza; naye Katonda teyakkiriza nze kwonoona n’okuzikiriza emmeeme yange bwe ntyo, wabula bulijjo, nga awakanya okusalawo kwange kuno okw’obuzibe n’okw’ennaku, yatondanga munda mu nze ebirowoozo ng’ebyo, nti nnyinza okwerimba mu kino, ne kiba nti nnali siyinza kumatira, okutuusa lwe nnatuuka ku kumanya okukakafu, oba nga nnalina okukkiriza oba nedda; nga bulijjo kino kiddingana mu birowoozo byange nti, Naye ate singa ddala tolina kukkiriza? Naye oyinza otya okumanya nti olina okukkiriza? Era, ng’oggyeko ekyo, nnalaba mu bukakafu nti, singa nnali sirina, nnali nkakasa nti nja kuzikirira emirembe gyonna.

50. Ne kiba nti newankubadde mu kusooka nnafuba okubuusa amaaso ensonga y’okukkiriza, naye mu kiseera kitono, bwe nnalowooza obulungi ku nsonga eyo, ne nzikiriza okwekebera, oba nga nnalina okukkiriza oba nedda. Naye zinsanze, omunaku nze, nnali mutamanya era ng’ensolo bwe ntyo, ne kiba nti okutuusa leero nnali simanyi ngeri y’okukikola okusinga bwe mmanyi engeri y’okutandika n’okumaliriza ekintu eky’ekikugu eky’ekitalo kye sirabangako wadde okulowoozaako.

51. Kyennava, bwe nnali nkyalowooza bwe ntyo, era nga nzibuwaliddwa nnyo ku nsonga eyo, kubanga mumanye nti okutuusa kati nnali sinnabuulirako muntu yenna ku nsonga eno, wabula nnawuliranga buwulizi ne ndowooza, omukemi n’ajja n’obulimba bwe, nti tewali kkubo lyonna gye ndi okumanya nti nnina okukkiriza, okuggyako okugezaako okukola ekyamagero: ng’akozesa Ebyawandiikibwa ebyo ebirabika ng’ebiraga bwe bityo, okunyweza n’okwongera amaanyi mu kukema kwe. Nedda, lumu bwe nnali wakati w’e Elstow ne Bedford, okukemebwa kwali kunnyigiriza nnyo okugezaako oba nga nnina okukkiriza, nga nkola ekyamagero: era ekyamagero ekyo mu kiseera ekyo kyali kino, nnalina okugamba ebidiba by’amazzi ebyali mu bigere by’embalaasi ku kkubo nti, Mukale; n’ebifo ebikalu nti, Mufuuke ebidiba. Era mazima, lumu nnali kumpi okukyogera ddala; naye bwe nnali nga ndi kumpi okwogera, ekirowoozo kino ne kinzijira, Naye genda wansi w’olukomera luli osooke osabe, Katonda akusobozese. Naye bwe nnamala okusalawo okusaba, kino ne kinnyigiriza nnyo, Nti singa nsaba, ne nkomawo ne ngezaako okukikola, naye ne sikola kintu, olwo kakasa nti nnali sirina kukkiriza, wabula nnali oyo asuuliddwa era abuze. Nedda, ne ndowooza nti, bwe kiba bwe kityo, sijja kugezaako kaakano, wabula nja kulindako akaseera.

52. Bwe ntyo ne nsigala nga nsobeddwa nnyo; kubanga nnalowooza nti, oba nga abo bokka be baalina okukkiriza, abaayinza okukola ebintu eby’ekitalo bwe bityo, olwo ne nsalawo nti, mu kiseera kino, nnali sirina, era nti ne mu biseera ebigenda okujja, tekyali kya kusuubira nti ndikufuna. Bwe ntyo ne nsuukundibwa wakati wa Setaani n’obutamanya bwange, era ne nsoberwa nnyo, naddala mu biseera ebimu, ne kiba nti nnali simanyi kya kukola.

53. Mu kiseera ekyo, embeera n’essanyu by’abantu bano abaavu ab’e Bedford byandagibwa bwe biti, mu kirooto oba mu kwolesebwa. Nnalaba nga bali ng’abatudde ku ludda olw’omusana olw’olusozi oluwanvu, nga beewummuliza mu bitangaala ebisanyusa eby’enjuba, nga nze nkankana era nga nneefunya mu mpewo, nga mbonyaabonyezebwa omuzira, n’omuzira omugonvu, n’ebire ebiddugavu. Era ne ndaba nga, wakati wange nabo, waliwo ekisenge ekyetoolodde olusozi luno; kaakano, emmeeme yange yeegomba nnyo okuyita mu kisenge kino; nga nsalawo nti, singa nsobola, nnandigenze wakati ddala mu bo, era eyo nange ne neebuguumya n’ebbugumu ly’enjuba yaabwe.

54. Ne ndowooza nga nneetooloola ekisenge kino enfunda n’enfunda, nga bulijjo nkeneenya nga bwe ntambula, okulaba oba nga nnyinza okufuna ekkubo oba omwagaanya, mwe nnyinza okuyingirira; naye okumala akaseera ne sifuna. Ku nkomerero, ne ndaba, ng’olwatu, ekituli ekifunda, ng’akamulyango akatono mu kisenge, mwe nnagezaako okuyita; naye omwagaanya nga mufunda nnyo era nga muzibu, ne nfuba emirundi mingi okuyingira, naye nga bwereere, okutuusa lwe nnali kumpi okukoowa ddala, olw’okufuba okuyingira; ku nkomerero, nga mpaliriza nnyo, ne ndaba nga nsoose okuyingiza omutwe gwange, oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, nga neewunzika ku mabbali, ne nnyingiza ebibegabega byange, n’omubiri gwange gwonna; awo ne nsanyuka nnyo okukamala, ne ŋŋenda ne ntuula wakati mu bo, ne mbudaabudibwa bwe ntyo n’ekitangaala n’ebbugumu ly’enjuba yaabwe.

55. Kaakano, olusozi luno n’ekisenge, n’ebirala, byannyonnyolwa bwe biti—olusozi lwali lutegeeza ekkanisa ya Katonda omulamu; enjuba eyali eyaka ku lwo, okwaka okubudaabuda okw’amaaso ge ag’ekisa ku abo abaali mu yo; ekisenge, nnalowooza, kyali Kigambo, ekyawula Abakristaayo n’ensi; n’ekituli ekyali mu kisenge kino, nnalowooza, kyali Yesu Kristo, ye kkubo eridda eri Katonda Kitaffe (Yokaana 14:6; Matayo 7:14). Naye kubanga omwagaanya gwali mufunda nnyo ekitalo, mufunda nnyo ne kiba nti nnali siyinza kuyingiramu wabula n’obuzibu bungi, kyandaga nti tewali ayinza kuyingira mu bulamu, okuggyako abo abaali bamaliridde ddala, era okuggyako nga baleka ensi eno embi emabega waabwe; kubanga wano waaliwo ebbanga ly’omubiri n’emmeeme kyokka, naye si ly’omubiri n’emmeeme n’ekibi.

56. Ekifaananyi kino kyabeera ku mwoyo gwange ennaku nnyingi; era mu biseera ebyo byonna nneerabanga nga ndi mu mbeera ey’okwerabirwa n’ey’ennaku, naye era nga nkubirizibwa enjala ey’amaanyi n’okwegomba okuba omu ku abo abaali batudde ku musana. Era kaakano nnasabanga buli we nnabanga, eka oba ebweru, mu nnyumba oba mu nnimiro, era emirundi mingi, nga nnyimusa omutima, nnayimbanga ekya Zabbuli eya 51, ‘Ayi Mukama, tunuulira obuyinike bwange’; kubanga okutuusa kati nnali simanyi we nnali.

57. Era nali sinnafuna kukakasa kwonna okubudaabuda nti nnalina okukkiriza mu Kristo; naye mu kifo ky’okumatira, wano nnatandika okulaba emmeeme yange ng’erumbibwa okubuusabuusa okuggya ku bikwata ku ssanyu lyange ery’omu maaso; naddala okubuusabuusa okw’engeri eno: Nze nnalondebwa? Naye kale, singa olunaku lw’ekisa lwali luyise dda ne luggwaawo?

58. Ebikemo bino ebibiri byambonyaabonya nnyo ne bintabula; oluusi ekimu, oluusi ekirala. Era okusooka, okwogera ku ekyo eky’okubuusabuusa okulondebwa kwange, nnakizuula mu kiseera ekyo nti wadde nga nnali nnyaka ng’omuliro okuzuula ekkubo erigenda mu ggulu ne mu kitiibwa, era wadde nga tewali kintu kyali kiyinza kunziza mabega okuva ku kino, naye ekibuuzo kino kyannyiiza nnyo era ne kimmalamu amaanyi, nti, naddala mu biseera ebimu, nnali ng’amaanyi gennyini ag’omubiri gwange nago gaali ganzigiddwako olw’obuzito n’amaanyi gaakyo. Ekyawandiikibwa kino nakyo kyalabika ng’ekirinnyirira byonna bye nnali njagala: ‘tekiva ku ebyo omuntu by’ayagala newaakubadde by’akola, wabula ku kusaasira kwa Katonda’ (Abaruumi 9:16).

59. Ekyawandiikibwa kino kyandeka nga simanyi kya kukola; kubanga nnalaba bulungi nti okuggyako nga Katonda omukulu, olw’ekisa kye n’obugabi bwe obutaliiko kkomo, yali anneerondedde yekka okuba ekibya eky’okusaasirwa, wadde nnandyegombye, ne nneyagaliza, ne nfuba okutuusa omutima gwange lwe gwandimenyese, tewaali kalungi kwonna kandivuddemu. Noolwekyo kino kyasigalanga kinnywerera: Omanya otya nti walondebwa? Ate singa tewalondebwa? Olwo ate?

60. Ai Mukama, bwe nnalowooza, ate singa ddala sirondebwanga? Oboolyawo tewalondebwa, omukemi bwe yagamba; oboolyawo bwe kiri ddala, bwe nnalowooza. Kale nno, Setaani bwe yagamba, wandibadde olekera awo, n’otoddamu kufuba; kubanga singa ddala Katonda teyakulonda n’akweroboza, tewali kya kwogera ku kulokolebwa kwo; kubanga ‘tekiva ku ebyo omuntu by’ayagala newaakubadde by’akola, wabula ku kusaasira kwa Katonda.’

61. Ebintu bino byantuusa ku nkomerero y’amagezi gange, nga simanyi kya kwogera, wadde engeri y’okuddamu ebikemo bino. Mazima ddala, saalowooza n’akatono nti Setaani ye yali annumbye bw’atyo, wabula nnalowooza nti obwegendereza bwange bwennyini bwe bwali bundeetedde ekibuuzo ekyo; kubanga, nti abalonde bokka be bafuna obulamu obutaggwaawo, ekyo nnakikkiriza n’omutima gwange gwonna awatali kubuusabuusa; naye nti nange nnali omu ku bo, eyo ye yali ensonga yonna.

62. Bwe ntyo, okumala ennaku eziwerako, nnalumbibwa nnyo ne mbuzaabuzibwa, era emirundi mingi, bwe nnabanga ntambula, nnabanga kumpi okugwa we nnali, olw’okuddirira mu birowoozo byange; naye lumu, oluvannyuma lw’okumala wiiki nnyingi bwe zityo nga nnyigirizibwa era nga nzijjiriddwa olw’ekyo, era nga kati nnali kumpi okuta essuubi lyonna ery’okufuna obulamu, ekigambo kino kyagwa n’obuzito ku mwoyo gwange: ‘Mutunuulire emirembe egy’edda mulabe; waali wabaddewo omuntu eyeesiga Mukama n’aswazibwa?’

63. Ekyo kyanzigyako obuzito nnyo era ne kizzaamu emmeeme yange amaanyi; kubanga mu kaseera ako kennyini kyannyinnyonnyolwa bwe kiti: Tandikira ku ntandikwa y’Olubereberye, osome okutuuka ku nkomerero y’Okubikkulirwa, olabe obanga onoozuula nti waali wabaddewo omuntu yenna eyeesiga Mukama n’aswazibwa. Bwe ntyo, bwe nnatuuka eka, amangu ago nnagenda ku Bayibuli yange okulaba obanga nnyinza okuzuula ekigambo ekyo, nga sibuusabuusa nti nnaakizuula mangu; kubanga kyali kiggya nnyo, era nga kirina amaanyi n’okubudaabuda bwe bityo ku mwoyo gwange, nti kyali nga kyogera nange.

64. Kale, nnanoonya, naye ne sikizuula; wabula kyasigala ku nze; awo ne mbuuza omusajja omu omulungi, ate ne omulala, obanga bamanyi we kiri, naye tebaamanya kifo ng’ekyo. Ekyo kyanneewuunyisa nti ekigambo ng’ekyo kyandikutte omutima gwange mangu bwe gutyo, n’okubudaabuda n’amaanyi bwe bityo, ne kigusigalamu, naye nga tewali n’omu ayinza kukizuula; kubanga saabuusabuusa nti kyali mu Kyawandiikibwa Ekitukuvu.

65. Bwe ntyo nnamala ekisukka mu mwaka nga sisobola kuzuula kifo ekyo; naye ku nkomerero, bwe nnatunula mu bitabo bya Apokuliifa, nnakizuula mu Siraki 2:10. Kino, mu kusooka, kyanzijjako katono amaanyi; naye kubanga, mu kiseera ekyo, nnali nfunye obumanyirivu obusingawo ku kwagala n’ekisa kya Katonda, tekyanteganya nnyo; naddala bwe nnalowooza nti, wadde nga tekyali mu biwandiiko bye tuyita ebitukuvu era ebikkirizibwa mu Bayibuli, naye olw’okuba ekigambo kino kyali kifunze era nga kye kikulu mu bisuubizo bingi, kyali kinsaanidde okufuna okubudaabuda kwakyo; era nneebaza Katonda olw’ekigambo ekyo, kubanga kyava eri Katonda gye ndi: ekigambo ekyo n’okutuusa kaakano, mu biseera ebimu, kyakaayakana mu maaso gange.

66. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, okubuusabuusa kuli okulala kwanzijira n’amaanyi: Naye kale, singa olunaku lw’ekisa lwali luyise dda ne luggwaawo? Singa olwawo okusukka ekiseera eky’okusaasirwa? Kale, nzijukira nti lumu, bwe nnali ntambula nga ŋŋenda mu byalo, nnali nnyo mu birowoozo bino: Naye kale, singa olunaku lw’ekisa luyise? Era okwongera ku buzibu bwange, omukemi yaleeta mu birowoozo byange abantu abo abalungi ab’e Bedford, n’ansiikiriza bw’ati: Nti abo bwe baali bakyusiddwa dda, be bonna Katonda be yali agenda okulokola mu bitundu ebyo; era nti nnali nzize kikeerezi, kubanga abo baali bafunye omukisa nga sinnatuuka.

67. Awo nnali mu nnaku nnyingi, nga ndowooza mazima ddala nti kino kiyinza okuba bwe kiri; noolwekyo nnatambulanga eruuyi n’eruuyi nga nkungubagira embeera yange ennaku, nga nneebalira okuba omubi okusinga abasirusiru lukumi, olw’okwesamba ebbanga eddene bwe lityo, n’okumala emyaka emingi bwe gityo mu kibi nga bwe nnakola; nga bulijjo nkaaba nti, Woowe, singa nnakyuka mangu! Woowe, singa nnakyuka emyaka musanvu emabega! Era kyannyiiza nnyo ku lwange, okulowooza nti nnali sirina magezi gasingawo, wabula okumalira obwereere ebiseera byange okutuusa emmeeme yange n’eggulu lwe byandibuze.

68. Naye bwe nnamala ebbanga ddene nga ntawaanyizibwa okutya kuno, era nga nnali kumpi obutasobola kutambula na ddaala limu, kumpi mu kifo kye kimu we nnafunira okuzzibwamu amaanyi okulala, ebigambo bino byayingira mu birowoozo byange: ‘okubirize b’onoosangayo bajje, ennyumba yange ejjule’; ‘mukyalimu ebifo’ (Lukka 14:22, 23). Ebigambo bino, naddala biri, ‘mukyalimu ebifo’, byali biwoomu gye ndi; kubanga, mazima, nnalowooza nti mu byo nnalaba nga mu ggulu mulimu ekifo ekimala nange; era, okwongera ku ekyo, nti Mukama Yesu bwe yayogera ebigambo bino, yandowoozaako; era nti ye, bwe yamanya nti ekiseera kirijja lwe ndibonyaabonyezebwa okutya nti tewasigaddeyo kifo kyange mu kifuba kye, yasooka n’ayogera ekigambo kino, n’akireka nga kiwandiikiddwa, ndyoke nfunire mu kyo obuyambi okulwanyisa ekikemo kino ekibi ennyo. Kino nnakikkiriza ddala mu kiseera ekyo.

69. Mu kitangaala n’amaanyi g’ekigambo kino nnatambula ebbanga ttonotono; era okubudaabudibwa kwali kungi nnyo, bwe nnalowooza nti Mukama Yesu yandowoozaako edda ennyo bwe kityo, era nti yayogera ebigambo ebyo mu bugenderevu ku lwange; kubanga mu kiseera ekyo nnalowooza ddala nti yabyogera mu bugenderevu, okunzizaamu amaanyi.

70. Naye saaburwa bikemo bya kuddayo mabega; ebikemo, nziramu, okuva eri Setaani, n’omutima gwange gwennyini, ne mikwano gyange egy’ensi; naye nneebaza Katonda nti ebyo byawangulwa okutegeera okunywevu okw’okufa n’olunaku olw’okusalirwa omusango, okwasigalanga, nga bwe kyali, buli kiseera mu maaso gange. Era emirundi mingi nnalowoozanga ku Nebukadduneeza, oyo gwe kyogerwako nti Ye yamuwa obwakabaka bwonna obw’ensi (Danyeri 5:19). Naye nnalowooza nti, singa omusajja ono omukulu yafuna omugabo gwe gwonna mu nsi muno, essaawa emu mu muliro gwa ggeyeena yandimwerabizza byonna. Okulowooza okwo kwannyamba nnyo.

71. Mu kiseera kino nnali kumpi okulaba ekintu ekikwata ku nsolo Musa ze yabala nga nnongoofu n’ezitali nnongoofu. Nnalowooza nti ensolo ezo zaali bifaananyi by’abantu; ennongoofu, bifaananyi by’abo abaali abantu ba Katonda; naye ezitali nnongoofu, bifaananyi by’abo abaali abaana b’omubi. Kale, nnasoma nti ensolo ennongoofu zizza obwenkulumu; kwe kugamba, bwe nnalowooza, zitulaga nti tulina okuliisibwa Ekigambo kya Katonda. Era zaalina ebinuulo ebyawulamu wabiri; nnalowooza nti ekyo kitegeeza nti tulina okwawukana n’amakubo g’abantu abatatya Katonda, bwe tuba ab’okulokolebwa. Era, bwe nnayongera okusoma ku zo, nnazuula nti wadde nga tuzza obwenkulumu ng’akamyu, naye bwe tutambula n’enjala ng’embwa, oba bwe tuba n’ebinuulo ebyawulamu ng’embizzi, naye nga tetuzza bwenkulumu ng’endiga, tukyali, wadde nga biri bwe bityo, si balongoofu; kubanga nnalowooza nti akamyu kafaananyi k’abo aboogera ku Kigambo, naye ne batambulira mu makubo g’ekibi; era nti embizzi yali ng’oyo eyeeyawudde ku bucaafu bwe obw’okungulu, naye ng’akyabulwa Ekigambo eky’okukkiriza, awatali kyo tewayinza kubaawo kkubo lya bulokozi, omuntu ne bw’aba nga yeewaddeyo atya eri eddiini (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 14). Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo nnazuula, bwe nnasoma Ekigambo, nti abo abagenda okugulumizibwa wamu ne Kristo mu nsi endala balina okuyitibwa ye wano; okuyitibwa okugabana ku Kigambo kye n’obutuukirivu bwe, n’okubudaabudibwa n’ebibala ebibereberye eby’Omwoyo we, n’okuba n’omugabo ogw’enjawulo mu bintu byonna eby’omu ggulu, ebiteekateeka ddala emmeeme olw’ekiwummulo ekyo n’ennyumba ey’ekitiibwa eri mu ggulu waggulu.

72. Wano, nate, nnayimirira ddala nga sirina kya kukola, nga ntya nti siyitiddwa; kubanga, nnalowooza nti, bwe mba nga siyitiddwa, kale kiki ekiyinza okungasa? Tewali basikira bwakabaka bwa ggulu wabula abo abayitiddwa ddala n’amaanyi. Naye woowe! nga nnali njagala nnyo kati ebigambo ebyogera ku kuyitibwa kw’Omukristaayo! nga Mukama bwe yagamba omu nti, ‘Ngoberera’, n’omulala nti, ‘Mujje mungoberere’. Era woowe! nnalowooza, singa yali agamba nange bw’atyo, nga nnandiddukidde mu ssanyu okumugoberera!

73. Kati siyinza kunnyonnyola na kwegomba na kumenyeka ki mu mmeeme yange kwe nnakaabirira Kristo okumpita. Bwe ntyo ne mmala ekiseera, nga nnyaka ng’omuliro okukyusibwa eri Yesu Kristo; era mu kiseera ekyo nnalaba ekitiibwa kingi bwe kityo mu mbeera y’omuntu eyakyuka, nti saasobola kumatira awatali kugabana ku yo. Zaabu! singa yali eyinza okufunibwa na zaabu, nga nnandiwaddeyo ki! singa nnali n’ensi yonna, yonna yandigenze emirundi omutwalo olw’ekyo, emmeeme yange ebeere mu mbeera ey’okukyuka.

74. Nga buli muntu gwe nnalowooza okuba omusajja oba omukazi eyakyuka yali alabika bulungi mu maaso gange kati! baali bakaayakana, baatambula ng’abantu abeetisse akabonero akakulu ak’eggulu. Woowe! nnalaba nti omugabo gwabwe gwagwa mu bifo ebisanyusa, era nti baali n’omugabo omulungi (Zabbuli 16:6). Naye ekyandwaza kyali ekyo ekya Kristo mu Makko, nti n’alinnya ku lusozi, n’ayita abo be yayagala, ne bajja gy’ali (Makko 3:13).

75. Ekyawandiikibwa kino kyammalamu amaanyi ne kintiisa, naye ne kikoleeza omuliro mu mmeeme yange. Ekyantiisa kyali kino, nti oboolyawo Kristo tandyagadde, kubanga yayita ‘abo be yayagala’. Naye woowe! ekitiibwa kye nnalaba mu mbeera eyo kyakwata nnyo omutima gwange nti saasobolanga kusoma ku muntu yenna Kristo gwe yayita nga sigamba mangu ago nti, Singa nnali mu ngoye zaabwe; singa nnazaalibwa Peetero; singa nnazaalibwa Yokaana; oba singa nnaliwo ne mmuwulira bwe yabayita, nga nnandikaaba nti, Ai Mukama, nange mpita. Naye woowe! nnatya nti tajja kumpita.

76. Era mazima Mukama yandeka bwe ntyo okumala emyezi mingi nga talina ky’andaga; oba nti nnali nnayitibwa dda, oba nti ndiyitibwa oluvannyuma. Naye ku nkomerero, oluvannyuma lw’okumala ekiseera kinene, n’okusinda kungi eri Katonda, ndyoke mbeere omugabi w’okuyitibwa okutukuvu okw’omu ggulu, Ekigambo ekyo kyanzijira, nti alitukuza omusaayi gwabwe gw’atatukuzanga: ‘Kubanga Mukama abeera mu Sayuuni’ (Yoweeri 3:21). Ebigambo bino nnalowooza nti byatumibwa okunzizaamu amaanyi okweyongera okulindirira Katonda, era byantegeeza nti, wadde nga nnali sinnakyuka, naye ekiseera kiyinza okutuuka, ne nkyuka ddala eri Kristo.

77. Mu kiseera kino nnatandika okubuulira abantu abo abaavu ab’e Bedford ebiri ku mutima gwange, n’okubategeeza embeera yange; bwe baawulira, ne babuulira Omwami Gifford ebinkwatako, naye yennyini n’afuna akaseera okwogera nange, era n’ayagala okunkakasa obulungi, wadde ndowooza nti yalina ensonga ntono; naye yampita mu nnyumba ye, gye nnandiwulidde ng’ateesa n’abalala ku ngeri Katonda gy’akolaganamu n’emmeeme; okuva mu ebyo byonna nnafunanga okulumirizibwa okusingawo, era okuva mu kiseera ekyo ne ntandika okulaba ekitono ku butaliimu n’obunaku obw’omunda obw’omutima gwange omubi, kubanga okutuusa olwo saali mmanyi nnyo ku gwo; naye kati gwatandika okubikkulirwa gye ndi, era n’okukola obubi ku ddaala lye gwali gutakolangako. Kati nnazuula bulungi nti okwegomba okubi n’obuvundu byeyolekanga n’amaanyi munda mu nze, mu birowoozo ebibi n’okwegomba, bye saafangako emabega; okwegomba kwange okw’eggulu n’obulamu ne kutandika okuggwaawo. Era nnazuula nti, wadde emmeeme yange yali ejjudde okuyaayaanira Katonda, kati omutima gwange gwatandika okuyaayaanira buli butaliimu bwa busirusiru; weewaawo, omutima gwange tegwasikirizibwanga kufaayo ku ekyo ekirungi; gwatandika obutafaayo, ku mmeeme yange ne ku ggulu; kati gwasigalanga mabega buli kiseera, nga sinnatandika buli mulimu gw’eddiini ne mu gwo; era gwali ng’ekizito ekisibiddwa ku kugulu kw’ekinyonyi okukiremesa okubuuka.

78. Nedda, nnalowooza, kati ŋŋenda nfuuka mubi n’okusingawo; kati ndi wala n’okukyuka okusinga bwe nnali emabega. Noolwekyo nnatandika okugwa ennyo mu mmeeme yange, era ne ntandika okusembeza mu mutima gwange okuggwaamu amaanyi okwanzika wansi nga ggeyeena. Singa kati nnali wa kwokebwa ku muti, sandisobodde kukkiriza nti Kristo yalina okwagala gye ndi; woowe, saasobola kumuwulira, newakubadde okumulaba, newakubadde okumukwatako, newakubadde okuwooma ku kintu kyonna ekikye; nnagobebwanga ng’omuyaga ogw’amaanyi, omutima gwange gwali gwa kuba mucaafu, Abakanani baali ba kubeera mu nsi.

79. Oluusi nnabuuliranga abantu ba Katonda embeera yange; bwe baawuliranga, baansaasiranga, ne bambuulira ku bisuubizo; naye kyandibadde kye kimu singa bambuulira nti nnina okukwata ku njuba n’olugalo lwange, okusinga okundagira okukkiriza oba okwesigama ku kisuubizo; era amangu ddala nga ngezaako okukikola, okutegeera kwange kwonna n’okuwulira kwange byali binnwanyisa; ne ndaba nti nnina omutima ogwali gwa kwonoona, era ogwali wansi w’etteeka eryali lya kugusalira musango.

80. Ebintu bino bitera okunzijukiza omwana oli kitaawe gwe yaleeta eri Kristo, eyali akyajja gy’ali, dayimooni n’amusuula wansi, era n’amukankanya n’amutaagula nnyo n’agalamira ng’ayeevulungula, ng’abimba ejjovu (Lukka 9:42, Makko 9:20).

81. Era, mu nnaku ezo nnazuulanga omutima gwange nga gwesibira Mukama, n’Ekigambo kye ekitukuvu. Nnazuula obutakkiriza bwange nga, nga bwe kyali, buteeka ekibegabega ku luggi okumuziyiza obutayingira, era ekyo nga ne mu kiseera kyennyini bwe nnakaabanga n’okusinda okungi okw’obulumi nti, Mukama omulungi, gugguleewo ku maanyi; Mukama, menya enzigi zino ez’ebikomo, era omenyemu emitayimbwa gino egy’ekyuma (Zabbuli 107:16). Naye ekigambo kino oluusi kyaleetanga mu mutima gwange akaseera ak’emirembe: ‘Ndikuwa amaanyi wadde nga tonzisaako mwoyo’ (Isaaya 45:5).

82. Naye ekiseera kino kyonna, ku bikwata ku kukola ekibi, saali mwegendereza okusinga bwe nnali kati; saagezangako kutwala ppini newakubadde akati, ne bwe kaba katono ng’akasubi, kubanga omuntu wange ow’omunda kati yali mulwadde, era ng’alumwa buli lwe kakwatibwako; kati saamanya ngeri ya kwogeramu bigambo byange, olw’okutya okubiteeka obubi. Woowe, nga nnatambulanga n’obwegendereza mu byonna bye nnakolanga oba bye nnayogeranga! Nneerabanga ng’ali ku ntobazzi enseeseetu ekankana ne bwe nneenyeenya katono; era nnalekebwa eyo nga Katonda ne Kristo, n’Omwoyo, n’ebintu byonna ebirungi bintamwako.

83. Naye, ndaba nti, wadde nnali mwonoonyi munene bw’atyo nga sinnakyuka, naye Katonda teyampaliriza nnyo musango gwa bibi bye nnakola mu butamanya; wabula yandaga nti nnali nzibye singa sirina Kristo, kubanga nnali mwonoonyi; nnalaba nti nnali nneetaaga obutuukirivu obutuukiridde okunjanjula nga sirina kamogo mu maaso ga Katonda, era obutuukirivu buno tebwali wonna wonna, wabula mu Yesu Kristo yennyini.

84. Naye obucaafu bwange obw’obuzaaliranwa obw’omunda, obwo, obwo bwe bwali kawumpuli wange n’okubonaabona kwange; obwo, nziramu, ku ddaala ery’entiisa, nga bulijjo bweyoleka munda mu nze; obwo nnalina omusango gwabwo, okutuuka okwewuunya; olw’obwo nnali wa kyenyinyalwa mu maaso gange okusinga ekikere; era nnalowooza nti ne mu maaso ga Katonda bwe nnali; ekibi n’obuvundu, bwe nnagamba, byandifukumuse mu mutima gwange mu ngeri ey’obutonde, ng’amazzi bwe gafukumuka mu luzzi. Kati nnalowooza nti buli muntu yalina omutima omulungi okusinga ogwange; nnandiwaanyisizza omutima ne buli muntu yenna; nnalowooza nti tewali n’omu wabula Setaani yennyini eyali ayinza okwenkana nange mu bubi obw’omunda n’obucaafu bw’ebirowoozo. Noolwekyo, bwe nnalaba obugwagwa bwange, nnagwa nnyo mu kuggwaamu essuubi; kubanga nnasalawo nti embeera eno gye nnalimu teyinza kukwatagana na mbeera ya kisa. Mazima, nnalowooza, Katonda anvuddeko; mazima mpeereddwayo eri Setaani, n’eri endowooza egaaniddwa; era bwe ntyo ne nsigala ebbanga ddene, emyaka egiwerako.

85. Bwe nnali mbonyaabonyezebwa bwe ntyo okutya okusalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira, waaliwo ebintu bibiri ebyanneewuunyisanga; ekimu kyali, bwe nnalabanga abakadde nga banoonya ebintu by’obulamu buno, ng’abagenda okubeera wano emirembe gyonna; ekirala kyali, bwe nnasanganga abeeyita Abakristaayo nga banakuwadde nnyo era nga bagudde wansi, bwe baafiirwanga eby’okungulu, ng’omwami, oba omukyala, oba omwana, n’ebirala. Mukama, nnalowooza, nga waliwo akajagalalo kangi wano olw’ebintu ebitono nga bino! Nga bamu banoonya nnyo eby’omubiri, era nga balala banakuwala nnyo olw’okubifiirwa! Bwe baba nga bafuba bwe batyo, ne bayiwa amaziga mangi bwe gatyo olw’ebintu by’obulamu buno, nze nnina kukaabirwa ki, n’okusaasirwa, n’okusabirwa! Emmeeme yange efa, emmeeme yange ezikirira. Singa emmeeme yange yali mu mbeera nnungi, era singa nnali nkakasa ekyo, woowe! nga nnandyetutte okuba omugagga, ne bwe nnandiweereddwa omugati n’amazzi byokka; nnandibaze ebyo okuba okubonaabona okutono, era nnandibigumiikirizza ng’emigugu emitono. ‘emmeeme eyennyise ani ayinza okugigumiikiriza?’

86. Era wadde nnali ntawaanyizibwa bwe ntyo, ne nsuukundibwa, ne mbonyaabonyezebwa, olw’okulaba, n’okutegeera, n’entiisa y’obubi bwange, naye nnatya okuleka okulaba n’okutegeera okwo okuva ddala mu birowoozo byange; kubanga nnazuula nti, okuggyako ng’omusango ogw’omuntu ow’omunda guggiddwawo mu kkubo ettuufu, kwe kugamba, olw’omusaayi gwa Kristo, omuntu yeeyongera bweyongezi okwonooneka olw’okufiirwa obuzibu bw’ebirowoozo bwe, okusinga okulongooka. Noolwekyo, singa omusango gwange gwanzitoowereranga, nnakaabanga omusaayi gwa Kristo gugunzigyeko; era singa gwali guggwaawo awatali gwo (kubanga okutegeera ekibi oluusi kwabanga ng’okugenda okufa, ne kuggwaawo ddala), awo nange nnafubanga okuguzza nate ku mutima gwange, nga ndeeta ku mwoyo gwange ekibonerezo ky’ekibi mu muliro gwa ggeyeena; era nnakaabanga nti, Mukama, kireme okuva ku mutima gwange, wabula mu kkubo ettuufu, wabula olw’omusaayi gwa Kristo, n’olw’okuteeka ku mmeeme yange okusaasira kwo, okuyita mu ye; kubanga ekyawandiikibwa kino kyanzitoowereranga nnyo: ‘awatali kuyiwa musaayi tewabaawo kusonyiyibwa’ (Abaebbulaniya 9:22). Era ekyanneeyongeza okutya kino kyali nti nnali ndabye abamu abaakaabanga ne basaba bwe baabanga n’ebiwundu by’omuntu ow’omunda; naye bo, nga banoonya kuwummuzibwa mangu mu buzibu bwabwe okusinga okusonyiyibwa ekibi kyabwe, tebaafaayo ngeri gye baafiirwamu omusango gwabwe, kasita baguggya mu birowoozo byabwe; noolwekyo, bwe baaguggyako mu kkubo ekyamu, tekyabatukuzibwa; wabula baakakanyala nnyo, ne baziba amaaso, ne beeyongera obubi oluvannyuma lw’obuzibu bwabwe. Kino kyantiisa, era ne kinkaabya nnyo eri Katonda, kireme kuba bwe kityo gye ndi.

87. Era kati nnanakuwala nti Katonda yanfuula muntu, kubanga nnatya nti nnali mugaanibwa; nnabala omuntu atakyuse okuba ekitonde ekisinga okuba eky’ennaku mu bitonde byonna. Bwe ntyo nga mbonyaabonyezebwa era nga nsuukundibwa olw’embeera yange ennaku, nnalaba nga ndi nzekka, era nga sirina mukisa okusinga abantu abasinga obungi.

88. Weewaawo, nnalowooza nti tekisoboka n’akatono nze okutuuka ku bulungi bw’omutima obwenkana awo, okwebaza Katonda olw’okunfuula omuntu. Mazima omuntu y’asinga ekitiibwa olw’okutondebwa, mu bitonde byonna eby’omu nsi erabika; naye olw’ekibi yeefudde ekisinga obutaba na kitiibwa. Ensolo, n’ebinyonyi, n’ebyennyanja, n’ebirala, nnayitanga embeera yabyo ey’omukisa, kubanga tebyalina buzaaliranwa bwa kibi, tebyali bya kunenyezebwa mu maaso ga Katonda; tebyali bya kugenda mu muliro gwa ggeyeena oluvannyuma lw’okufa; noolwekyo nnandisanyuse singa embeera yange yali ng’ey’ekimu ku byo.

89. Nnamala ebbanga ddene mu mbeera eyo; naye ekiseera eky’okubudaabudibwa bwe kyatuuka, nnawulira omuntu ng’abuulira ku bigambo biri ebiri mu Oluyimba lwa Sulemaani 4:1, ‘Ng’olabika bulungi, gwe njagala, laba ondabikidde bulungi.’ Naye mu kiseera ekyo yafuula ebigambo bino ebibiri, ‘gwe njagala’, okuba ensonga ye enkulu; okuva mu byo, bwe yamala okunnyonnyola katono ekyawandiikibwa, n’alaga ebigambo bino ebiwerako: 1. Nti Ekkanisa, era bw’atyo buli mmeeme erokoleddwa, gwe Kristo ayagala, ne bw’eba nga tesaanidde kwagalibwa. 2. Gwe Kristo ayagala awatali nsonga. 3. Gwe Kristo ayagala ne bw’eba ng’ekyayibwa ensi. 4. Gwe Kristo ayagala ne bw’eba mu kukemebwa, era nga erekeddwa. 5. Gwe Kristo ayagala okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero.

90. Naye saafunamu kintu mu bye yayogera mu kiseera ekyo, wabula bwe yatuuka ku kukozesa ekigambo eky’okuna, kino kye kyali ekigambo kye yayogera: Bwe kiba bwe kityo, nti emmeeme erokoleddwa gwe Kristo ayagala nga eri mu kukemebwa n’okulekebwa; kale, ggwe emmeeme ekemebwa ennaku, bw’olumbibwa era ng’obonyaabonyezebwa okukemebwa, n’okukwekebwa kw’amaaso ga Katonda, naye weeyongere okulowooza ku bigambo bino ebibiri, ‘gwe njagala’.

91. Bwe ntyo bwe nnali nga ŋŋenda eka, ebigambo bino ne biddamu okuyingira mu birowoozo byange; era nzijukira bulungi, bwe nnayingira, nnagamba bwe nti mu mutima gwange: Kiki kye nnaafuna mu kulowooza ku bigambo bino ebibiri? Ekirowoozo kino kyali kyakayita mu mutima gwange, ebigambo ne bitandika okwaka bwe biti mu mwoyo gwange, ‘Ggwe gwe njagala, ggwe gwe njagala’, emirundi abiri omulundi gumu; era bwe byeyongera okuddiŋŋana mu birowoozo byange, ne byeyongera amaanyi n’ebbugumu, ne bitandika okunnyimusa amaaso; naye nga nkyali wakati w’essuubi n’okutya, nnaddamu nate mu mutima gwange nti, Naye kituufu, naye kituufu? Awo ekigambo kino ne kingwako, nti ye ‘nga tayinza kukitegeera nti byonna ebyali bimutuukako mu kaseera ako byaliwo ddala’ (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 12:9).

92. Awo ne ntandika okuwa Ekigambo ekifo, nga kyo, n’amaanyi, kyaleetanga emirundi n’emirundi eddoboozi lino ery’essanyu mu mmeeme yange: Ggwe gwe njagala, ggwe gwe njagala; era tewali kirikwawukanya n’okwagala kwange; era olw’ekyo, Abaruumi 8:39 ne kijja mu birowoozo byange. Kati omutima gwange gwajjula okubudaabudibwa n’essuubi, era kati nnasobola okukkiriza nti ebibi byange bijja kunsonyiyibwa; weewaawo, kati nnali nkwatiddwa nnyo okwagala n’okusaasira kwa Katonda, nti nzijukira nga sisobola kwefuga okutuusa lwe nnatuuka eka; nnalowooza nti nnandyogedde ku kwagala kwe n’okusaasira kwe gye ndi, ne eri namuŋŋoona abaali batudde ku nnimiro ezirimiddwa mu maaso gange, singa baali basobola okuntegeera; noolwekyo nnagamba mu mmeeme yange n’essanyu lingi nti, Kale, singa nnina wano ekkalaamu ne bwino, nnandikiwandiise kino nga sinnagenda mu maaso, kubanga mazima sirikyerabira wadde mu myaka amakumi ana okuva kati; naye woowe! mu nnaku ezitawera makumi ana, nnatandika okubuusabuusa byonna nate; ekyandeetera okweyongera okubuusabuusa byonna.

93. Naye ate oluusi, nnayambibwanga okukkiriza nti kwali kweyoleka kwa ddala okw’ekisa eri emmeeme yange, wadde nga nnali mbuze obulamu bwakwo bungi n’obuwoomi bwakwo. Kale, nga wiiki emu oba bbiri oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, ekyawandiikibwa kino kyangobereranga nnyo: ‘Simooni, Simooni, Setaani asabye okukuwewa’ (Lukka 22:31). Era oluusi kyawulikikanga n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka munda mu nze, weewaawo, era nga kirabika kiyita n’amaanyi emabega wange, nti omulundi gumu okusinga emirundi emirala gyonna, nnakyusa omutwe gwange ne ntunula emabega w’ekibegabega kyange, nga ndowooza ddala nti waliwo omuntu emabega wange ampise; era ng’ate yali wala nnyo, nnalowooza nti yayita n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka bwe lityo; kyajja, nga bwe ndowooza okuva olwo, okunsikiriza okusaba n’okutunula; kyajja okuntegeeza nti ekire n’omuyaga byali bijja okunkkako, naye saakitegeera.

94. Era, nga bwe nzijukira, ekiseera kiri lwe kyampita n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka bwe lityo, gwe gwali omulundi ogusembayo okuwulikika mu kutu kwange; naye ndowooza nti nkyawulira eddoboozi ery’omwanguka ebigambo bino, Simooni, Simooni, bwe byawulikika mu matu gange. Nnalowooza ddala, nga bwe mbabuulidde, nti waliwo omuntu ampise emabega wange, eyali ebbanga lya kitundu kya mayiro emabega wange; era wadde nga eryo teryali linnya lyange, naye kyandeetera okutunula amangu ago emabega wange, nga nzikiriza nti oyo eyayita n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka bw’atyo yali ayita nze.

95. Naye nnali musirusiru bwe ntyo, era atamanyi, nti saamanya nsonga ya ddoboozi lino; eryo, nga bwe nnalaba era ne mpulira amangu oluvannyuma, lyasindikibwa okuva mu ggulu ng’engoma ey’okulabula, okunzuukusa nneeteekereteekere ekyali kijja; wabula lyandeeteranga okufumiitiriza n’okwewuunya mu birowoozo byange, nga ndowooza ensonga ki eyandibaddewo ekyawandiikibwa kino, era ku ddaala eryo, emirundi emingi bwe gityo era n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka bwe lityo, okweyongera okuwulikika n’okunyeenya mu matu gange; naye, nga bwe nnasoose okugamba, amangu oluvannyuma nnategeera ekigendererwa kya Katonda mu kyo.

96.
