Noolwekyo, bwe nnabalaba nga banywevu bwe batyo mu bigambo byabwe ne mu bikolwa byabwe, era nga mu mitima gyabwe bafuba nnyo okutegeera Yesu Kristo, nga basanyuka nti Katonda yansindika gye baali; awo ne ntandika okulowooza nti kiyinzika okuba bwe kityo, nti Katonda akkirizza mu mulimu gwe omusirusiru nga nze; olwo ekigambo kya Katonda kino ne kijja mu mutima gwange nga kinzizaamu amaanyi mu ngeri ewooma ennyo, ‘Omusajja ng’afa, y’ansabira omukisa, ne ndeetera omutima gwa nnamwandu okuyimba’ (Yobu 29:13).

275. Ekyo kyennava nsanyuka; weewaawo, amaziga g’abo Katonda be yazuukusanga olw’okubuulira kwange gaabanga kubudaabudibwa era kuzzibwamu maanyi gye ndi; kubanga nnalowooza ku bigambo bino, ‘Ani anansanyusa wabula oyo gwe nnaanakuwaza?’ (2 Abakkolinso 2:2); era nate, Obanga ‘ssiri mutume eri abalala, naye ndi mutume eri mmwe, kubanga mmwe kabonero k’obutume bwange mu Mukama waffe’ (1 Abakkolinso 9:2). Ebintu ebyo, noolwekyo, byali ng’obukakafu obulala gye ndi nti Katonda yampita mu mulimu guno, era n’ayimirira nange mu gwo.

276. Mu kubuulira kwange Ekigambo, nnassaayo nnyo omwoyo ku kintu kimu kino, kwe kugamba nti Mukama yankulemberanga okutandikira awo Ekigambo kye we kitandikira n’aboonoonyi; kwe kugamba, okusalira omusango abantu bonna ab’omubiri, n’okulaga n’okukakasa nti ekikolimo kya Katonda, olw’amateeka, kiri ku bantu bonna era kibakwata nga bwe bazaalibwa mu nsi, olw’ekibi. Ekitundu kino eky’omulimu gwange nnakituukiriza nga nkiwulira nnyo; kubanga entiisa y’amateeka n’omusango olw’ebyonoono byange byazitowa nnyo ku muntu wange ow’omunda. Nnabuuliranga kye nnawulira, kye nnawuliranga nga kinnuma, kwe kugamba ekyo omwoyo gwange omwavu kye gwasindanga wansi waakyo era kye gwakankananga nakyo okutuuka okwewuunya.

277. Mazima nnali ng’omuntu abatumiddwa okuva mu bafu; nze kennyini nnagenda nga ndi mu njegere okubuulira abo abaali mu njegere; era nnasitula mu muntu wange ow’omunda omuliro ogwo gwe nnabalabula okwegendereza. Nnyinza okwogera mu mazima, era awatali bukuusa, nti bwe nnagendanga okubuulira, nnagendanga njjudde omusango n’entiisa okutuuka ne ku mulyango gw’ekituuti, era eyo ne bingibwako, ne mbeera wa ddembe mu birowoozo byange okutuusa lwe nnamalanga omulimu gwange; olwo amangu ago, nga sinnaba na kukka madaala ga kituuti, ne nzirayo mu mbeera embi nga bwe nnali emabega; naye Katonda yantwala mu maaso, mazima n’omukono ogw’amaanyi, kubanga omusango wadde ggeyeena tebyasobola kunzigya ku mulimu gwange.

278. Bwe ntyo bwe nnamala ekiseera kya myaka ebiri, nga nkaayana nnyo ku bibi by’abantu, n’embeera yaabwe ey’entiisa olw’ebibi ebyo. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo Mukama n’ajja ku mwoyo gwange n’emirembe egy’enkalakkalira n’okubudaabudibwa mu Kristo; kubanga yampa okulaba ebintu bingi ebiwoomu eby’ekisa kye eky’omukisa mu Ye. Kyennava nkyusa mu kubuulira kwange, kubanga nnali nkyabuulira kye nnalaba ne kye nnawulira; noolwekyo kaakano nnafuba nnyo okulaga ensi Yesu Kristo mu mirimu gye gyonna, mu nkolagana ze, ne mu birungi bye; era nnafuba n’okubikkula, okusalira omusango, n’okuggyawo ebiwaniriro n’emiko egy’obulimba ensi kw’eyesigama, era ne ku byo kw’egwa n’ezikirira. Ku bintu bino nabyo nnamalako ekiseera kiwanvu nga ku biri ebirala.

279. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, Katonda n’antwala mu kitundu ku kyama eky’okwegatta ne Kristo; kyennava nkibikkula ne nkibalaga nakyo. Era bwe nnamala okutambulira mu nsonga zino essatu enkulu ez’Ekigambo kya Katonda, okumala emyaka nga etaano oba okusingawo, ne nkwatibwa nga nkola kye nkola kaakano, ne nsuulibwa mu kkomera, gye mmaze ekiseera ekisinga ku ekyo omulundi omulala, okukakasa amazima nga mbonaabona, nga bwe nnali emabega nga ngategeeza ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe biri nga mbuulira.

280. Bwe mbadde mbuulira, nneebaza Katonda, omutima gwange emirundi mingi, ekiseera kyonna eky’omulimu ogwo n’omulala, gukaabiridde Katonda n’obunyiikivu bungi afuule Ekigambo eky’amaanyi okulokola emyoyo; nga bulijjo nnakuwala nti omulabe aleme okuggya Ekigambo mu muntu ow’omunda, ne kiba nga tekibala. Kyennava nfuba okwogera Ekigambo mu ngeri, singa kiyinzika, ekibi n’omuntu alina omusango bisonjolwe bulungi olw’ekigambo ekyo.

281. Era, bwe nnamalanga okubuulira, kyannumanga mu mutima okulowooza nti Ekigambo kaakano kiyinza okugwa ng’enkuba ku bifo eby’amayinja, nga bulijjo nneegomba okuva mu mutima gwange nti, O singa abo abampulidde nga njogera leero bandirabye nga nze bwe ndaba ekibi kye kiri, n’okufa, ne ggeyeena, n’ekikolimo kya Katonda; era n’ekisa, n’okwagala, n’okusaasira kwa Katonda bwe biri, mu Kristo, eri abantu abali mu mbeera ng’eyaabwe, abakyali ewala naye. Era, mazima, emirundi mingi nnayogeranga mu mutima gwange mu maaso ga Mukama nti, Singa okuwanikibwa kaakano mu maaso gaabwe kwandibadde kkubo ery’okubazuukusa n’okubanyweza mu mazima, nandimatidde n’essanyu.

282. Kubanga mu kubuulira kwange, naddala bwe mbadde nnyonnyola enjigiriza ey’obulamu mu Kristo, awatali bikolwa, mbadde nga gy’obeera malayika wa Katonda ayimiridde emabega wange okunzizaamu amaanyi. Oh, kibadde n’amaanyi gatyo n’obukakafu obw’omu ggulu ku mwoyo gwange, nga bwe mbadde nfuba okukinnyonnyola, okukikakasa, n’okukinyweza mu muntu ow’omunda ow’abalala, ne ndema okumatira n’okugamba nti, Nzikiriza, era nkakasa; nnalowooza nti nnali nkakasa okusingawo, bwe kiba nga kikkirizibwa okwogera bwe ntyo, nti ebintu ebyo bye nnali nkakasa mu kiseera ekyo byali bya mazima.

283. Bwe nnasooka okugenda okubuulira Ekigambo ebweru, abasomesa n’abakabona b’omu kitundu ne banjolekera n’obukambwe bungi. Naye nnali nkakasizza kino, obutaddiza kuvuma ku kuvuma, wabula okulaba bameka ku beeyatula eddiini mu bo ab’omubiri be nnyinza okumatiza ku mbeera yaabwe embi olw’amateeka, ne ku bwetaavu bwa Kristo n’omuwendo gwe; kubanga nnalowooza nti, Kino kye kirimpolereza mu biseera ebigenda okujja, bwe balibeera nga bakebera empeera yange mu maaso gaabwe (Olubereberye 30:33).

284. Saafangayo kwegatta mu bintu ebiwakanirwa era ebikaayanirwa mu batukuvu, naddala ebintu ebya wansi ennyo; naye kyansanyusanga nnyo okulwanirira n’obunyiikivu bungi ekigambo eky’okukkiriza n’okusonyiyibwa ebibi olw’okufa n’okubonaabona kwa Yesu; naye njogera nti, ku bintu ebirala, nnabirekanga, kubanga nnalaba nga bireeta empaka, era kubanga okubikola oba obutabikola tekutusemberereza Katonda okubeera babe. Ate era nnalaba nti omulimu gwange ogwali mu maaso gange gwakulukutira mu mukutu omulala, kwe kugamba okutwala ekigambo ekizuukusa; kyennava nkinywererako ne nkinywerera.

285. Saafubanga, era saagumanga, kukozesa ebyo abantu abalala bye baazimba (Abaruumi 15:18), newaakubadde sisalira musango bonna abakikola; kubanga nnalowooza mazima, era ne nkizuula mu bye nnayitamu, nti ekyo kye nnayigirizibwa Ekigambo n’Omwoyo wa Kristo kyandisobodde okwogerwa, okulwanirirwa, n’okunywererwako omuntu ow’omunda asinga obulamu n’obunywevu; era newaakubadde nga sijja kwogera kaakano byonna bye mmanyi ku nsonga eno, naye bye nnayitamu bikwatagana nnyo n’ekyawandiikibwa ekyo okusinga abantu bangi bwe bamanyi (Abaggalatiya 1:11, 12).

286. Singa omu ku abo abaazuukusibwa olw’obuweereza bwange yaddanga emabega oluvannyuma, nga bwe kyabangawo oluusi eri bangi nnyo, nnyinza okwogera mu mazima nti okubula kwabwe kubaddenga kunnuma okusinga singa omu ku baana bange, abazaalibwa mu mubiri gwange, yali agenda mu ntaana; ndowooza, mazima, nnyinza okukyogera awatali kunyiiza Mukama, nti tewali kintu kinkutteko nnyo nga ekyo, okuggyako okutya okubulwa obulokozi bw’omwoyo gwange. Mbadde ndaba nga gy’obeera nnina ennyumba ennungi n’obwami mu bifo abaana bange gye baazaalibwa; omutima gwange gubadde gusibiddwa nnyo mu kitiibwa ky’omulimu guno omulungi ennyo, ne ndowooza nti Katonda ampadde omukisa n’ekitiibwa olw’ekyo okusinga singa yanfuula kabaka omukulu ow’ensi ey’Ekikristaayo, oba mukama w’ekitiibwa kyonna eky’ensi nga sirina kino! O ebigambo bino, ‘Omuntu oyo akomyawo munne eri Katonda, aba awonyezza omwoyo gwa munne okufa’ (Yakobo 5:20). ‘Ekibala ky’omutuukirivu muti gwa bulamu, era n’oyo asikiriza emyoyo gy’abantu ne balokoka wa magezi’ (Engero 11:30). ‘Abo abalina okutegeera balyakaayakana ng’okumasamasa kw’omu bbanga; n’abo abakyusa abangi okudda eri obutuukirivu, balyakaayakana ng’emmunyeenye emirembe n’emirembe’ (Danyeri 12:3). ‘Kale Mukama waffe Yesu bw’alijja, si mmwe mulibeera essuubi n’essanyu lyaffe, n’engule ey’okwenyumiriza kwaffe? Kubanga mmwe kitiibwa kyaffe era essanyu lyaffe’ (1 Abasessaloniika 2:19, 20). Bino, njogera, wamu n’ebirala bingi ebiri ng’ebyo, bibadde binzizaamu nnyo amaanyi.

287. Nkirabye nti, gye mbadde n’omulimu gw’okukolera Katonda, nsooka okuba, nga bwe kiri, n’okutambula kwa Katonda ku mwoyo gwange nga nneegomba okubuulira eyo. Nkirabye era nti emyoyo egimu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo gitekeddwa nnyo ku mutima gwange, ne nkubirizibwa okwegomba okulokolebwa kwabwe; era nti emyoyo egyo gyennyini, oluvannyuma, giweereddwa ng’ebibala by’obuweereza bwange. Nkirabye era nti ekigambo ekyogeddwa mu kuyitawo kikoze nnyo mu kubuulira okusinga byonna ebirala ebyayogerwa; era oluusi bwe mbadde ndowooza nti sikoze kirungi kyonna, olwo nga nkoze kingi okusinga; era emirundi emirala bwe mbadde ndowooza nti nja kubakwasa, nvubye ne sikwasa kantu.

288. Nkirabye era nti, awaabanga omulimu ogw’okukola ku boonoonyi, eyo Omulyolyomi abadde atandika okuwuluguma mu mitima, ne mu kamwa k’abaddu be. Weewaawo, emirundi mingi ensi embi bw’ebadde esinga okunyiiga, eyo emyoyo we gizuukusiddwa Ekigambo. Nnandisobodde okulaga eby’okulabirako, naye nneeziyiza.

289. Kye nnasinga okwegomba mu kutuukiriza obuweereza bwange kwali kuyingira mu bifo ebisinga ekizikiza mu kitundu, ne mu bantu abo abaali ewala ennyo n’okwatula eddiini; naye si lwa kuba nti saasobola kugumira kitangaala, kubanga saatya kulaga Njiri yange eri muntu yenna, wabula kubanga nnazuula nti omwoyo gwange gwasinga kwegomba mulimu gwa kuzuukusa na kukyusa, era n’Ekigambo kye nnatwala kyennyini kyalaganga nnyo mu kkubo eryo; ‘weewaawo, nduubirira okubuulira Enjiri mu bifo etayatulwanga linnya lya Kristo, nneme okuzimba ku musingi gw’omuntu omulala’ (Abaruumi 15:20).

290. Mu kubuulira kwange mbadde mu bulumi ddala, era mbadde, nga bwe kiri, nga ndumwa ebisa okuzaalira Katonda abaana; era nnali sisobola kumatira okuggyako ng’ebibala birabise mu mulimu gwange. Singa sibala, tekyali kikulu ani antendereza; naye singa mbala, saafaayo ani ansalira musango. Nfumiitirizza ku kino, ‘Oyo asikiriza emyoyo gy’abantu ne balokoka wa magezi’ (Engero 11:30); era nate, ‘Abaana aboobulenzi kya bugagga okuva eri Mukama; era abaana mpeera gy’agaba okuva gy’ali. Ng’obusaale bwe bubeera mu mukono gw’omulwanyi, n’abaana abazaalibwa mu buvubuka bw’omuntu bwe bali bwe batyo. Alina omukisa omuntu oyo ajjuzza ensawo ye n’obusaale, kubanga tebaliswazibwa; balyolekera abalabe baabwe mu mulyango omunene’ (Zabbuli 127:3-5).

291. Tekyansanyusa n’akatono okulaba abantu nga banywa endowooza bwe baali nga tebamanyi Yesu Kristo n’omuwendo gw’obulokozi bwabwe; okukakatibwa okw’amazima olw’ekibi, naddala olw’obutakkiriza, n’omutima ogukutte omuliro okwagala okulokolebwa Kristo, n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi okw’omwoyo ogutukuziddwa ddala, ekyo kye kyansanyusanga; abo be bantu be nnatwalanga nti balina omukisa.

292. Naye mu mulimu guno, nga mu mirimu emirala gyonna, nnalina okukemebwa okwangoberera, era okw’engeri nnyingi; oluusi nga nnumbibwa okuggwamu amaanyi okungi, nga ntya nti sijja kusobola kwogera Kigambo n’akatono mu ngeri ezimba; weewaawo, nti sijja kusobola na kwogera bigambo bitegeerekeka eri abantu; mu biseera ebyo omubiri gwange gwakwatibwanga okuzirika okwewuunyisa n’obutaba na maanyi, ebigere byange ne bitasobola na kuntwala mu kifo we nnalina okubuulira.

293. Oluusi nate, bwe mbadde mbuulira, mbadde nnumbibwa n’amaanyi ebirowoozo eby’okuvvoola, ne nkemebwa nnyo okwogera ebigambo ebyo n’akamwa kange mu maaso g’ekibiina. Era oluusi, ne bwe mbadde ntandise okwogera Ekigambo n’obutangaavu bungi, n’obukakafu, n’eddembe ery’okwogera, naye nga ekiseera ekyo tekinnaggwaako, mbadde nzibiddwa amaaso nnyo, era nga ndi wala nnyo n’ebintu bye mbadde njogera, era nga nziyizibwa nnyo mu kwogera kwange mu maaso g’abantu, ne mbeera nga gy’obeera simanyi oba sijjukira kye mbadde nkola, oba ng’omutwe gwange guli mu nsawo ekiseera kyonna eky’okubuulira.

294. Ate, oluusi bwe mbadde nga nnaatera okubuulira ku kitundu ky’Ekigambo ekisala era ekyokya, nsanze omukemi ng’ansalira amagezi nti, Ki, ogenda kubuulira kino? kino kikusalira musango ggwe wennyini; omwoyo gwo gwennyini gulina omusango gwa kino; noolwekyo tokibuulirako n’akatono; oba bw’onookibuulira, kikendeeze ng’okwekolera ekkubo ery’okuwona; si kulwa nga mu kifo ky’okuzuukusa abalala, oteeka ku mwoyo gwo omusango gw’otoliva wansi waagwo.

295. Naye, nneebaza Mukama, nkuumiddwa obutakkiriza kuteesa kuno okw’entiisa ennyo, era nsinze, nga Samusooni, okusindika n’amaanyi gange gonna, okusalira omusango ekibi n’okusobya buli we nnabisanganga, weewaawo, ne bwe nnali nga mu kyo nange nneeretako omusango ku muntu wange ow’omunda! ‘Leka nfiire,’ nnalowooza, ‘wamu n’Abafirisuuti’ (Abalamuzi 16:29, 30), okusinga okukozesa Ekigambo kya Katonda eky’omukisa mu bukuusa, ‘Ggwe ayigiriza abalala, lwaki toyinza kweyigiriza wekka?’ Kirungi nnyo ggwe okwesalira omusango, ne bw’oba ng’obuulira abalala lwatu, okusinga ggwe, olw’okwewonya, okusiba amazima mu butali butuukirivu; Katonda yeebazibwe olw’obuyambi bwe ne mu kino.

296. Era, bwe mbadde nkola omulimu guno ogw’omukisa ogwa Kristo, emirundi mingi nkemeddwa okwekulumbaza n’okwegulumiza mu mutima; era newaakubadde nga sigumira kwogera nti sikwatiddwako kino, naye mazima Mukama, olw’okusaasira kwe okw’omuwendo, ankoledde bw’ati, nti, emirundi egisinga, mbadde n’essanyu ttono okukkiriza ekintu ekyo; kubanga buli lunaku gubadde mugabo gwange okulagibwa obubi bw’omutima gwange gwennyini, era n’okulaba bulijjo obungi bw’obuvundu n’obunafu mu gwo, ne kimpunza omutwe wakati mu birabo byange byonna n’ebyo bye ntuuseeko; mpulidde eriggwa eryo mu mubiri, nga kwe kusaasira kwennyini kwa Katonda gye ndi (2 Abakkolinso 12:7-9).

297. Era wamu n’ekyo, mbadde ndagibwa ekifo ekimu oba ekirala ekyeyoleka mu Kigambo, ekigambo ekyo nga kirimu ekigambo ekisala era ekifumita ku kuzikirira kw’omwoyo, newaakubadde n’ebirabo n’obusobozi; okugeza, kino kibadde kya mugaso nnyo gye ndi, ‘Singa njogera ennimi z’abantu n’eza bamalayika, naye nga sirina kwagala, mba ng’ekidde, ekireekaana oba ng’ekitaasa ekisaala’ (1 Abakkolinso 13:1, 2).

298. Ekitaasa ekisaala kye kivuga ky’ennyimba, omukubi omukugu ky’asobola okukubamu ennyimba ennungi ennyo ezikwata ku mutima, abo bonna abamuwulira ng’akuba ne batasobola na kwekomako kuzina; naye laba, ekitaasa tekirina bulamu, n’ennyimba teziva mu kyo, wabula olw’obukugu bw’oyo akikuba; kale ekivuga ekyo kiyinza ku nkomerero okufuuka ekitaliimu n’okuzikirira, newaakubadde nga edda ennyimba ng’ezo zaakubirwangako.

299. Bwe ntyo bwe nnalaba nga bwe kiri era bwe kiriba eri abo abalina ebirabo naye nga tebalina kisa kirokola: bali mu mukono gwa Kristo, ng’ekitaasa mu mukono gwa Dawudi; era nga Dawudi bwe yasobolanga, n’ekitaasa, okuleeta essanyu eryo mu kusinza Katonda n’okusitula emitima gy’abasinza, bw’atyo Kristo bw’asobola okukozesa abantu bano abalina ebirabo, okukwata nabo ku myoyo gy’abantu be mu kkanisa ye; naye bw’amala okukola byonna, n’abawanika ku bbali ng’ebitaasa ebitalina bulamu, newaakubadde nga bivuga.

300. Okulowooza kuno, noolwekyo, wamu n’ebirala, emirundi egisinga kwali ng’ennyondo ku mutwe gw’amalala n’okwegomba ekitiibwa ekitaliimu; ki, nnalowooza, nneekulumbaze kubanga ndi kidde ekireekaana? Kikulu nnyo okuba endingidi? Ekitonde ekisinga obutono ekirina obulamu tekirina ku Katonda okusinga bino? Ate era nnamanya nti okwagala kwe kutalifa, naye bino biriggwaawo ne bibula; kyennava nsalawo nti ekisa ekitono, okwagala okutono, okutya Katonda okw’amazima okutono, kusinga ebirabo bino byonna; weewaawo, era nkakasiza ddala nti kiyinzika omuntu atasobola na kuddamu muntu okuggyako n’okutabulwa okungi mu ngeri y’okwogera, njogera nti kiyinzika omuntu ng’oyo okuba n’ekisa emirundi lukumi okusingawo, era bw’atyo okuba mu kwagala ne mu kusiimibwa kwa Mukama okusinga abamu abasobola, olw’ekirabo eky’okumanya, okwogera nga bamalayika.

301. Bwe ntyo, noolwekyo, ne ntegeera nti newaakubadde ng’ebirabo mu byo byennyini birungi eri ekyo kye byategekerwa, kwe kugamba okuzimba abalala, naye tebirina kintu era tebirina maanyi kulokola mwoyo gw’oyo abirina, bwe biba nga biri byokka; era tebiri, mu ngeri eyo, kabonero konna nti embeera y’omuntu ya mukisa, kubanga birabo bya Katonda ebigabibwa eri abamu, era ku ngeri gye babikozesezza oba gye batabikozesezza, balina, obulamu obutono bwe bunaaba buwedde, okubiwozaako eri Oyo eyeeteeseteese okusalira abalamu n’abafu omusango.

302. Kino era kyandaga nti ebirabo, bwe biba nga biri byokka, bya kabi, si mu byo byennyini, wabula olw’ebibi ebigoberera abo ababirina, kwe kugamba amalala, okwegomba ekitiibwa ekitaliimu, okwemanya, n’ebirala, ebyo byonna ebyafuuwibwanga mangu olw’okutenderezebwa n’okusiimibwa buli Mukristaayo atalina magezi, ne bireeta akabi eri ekitonde ekyavu okusalirwa omusango ng’Omulyolyomi bwe yagusalirwa.

303. Kyennava ndaba nti oyo alina ebirabo yeetaaga okulagibwa obutonde bwabyo, kwe kugamba nti tebimala kumufuula muntu alokoleddwa ddala, aleme okubyesigamako, n’atuuka obutatuuka ku kisa kya Katonda.

304. Era alina ensonga okutambula n’obwetoowaze ne Katonda, n’okuba omutono mu maaso ge ye, n’okujjukira wamu n’ekyo nti ebirabo bye si bibye, wabula bya kkanisa; era nti olw’ebyo afuuliddwa omuweereza w’ekkanisa; era nti ku nkomerero ateekwa okuwoza ku buwanika bwe eri Mukama Yesu; era okuwoza obulungi kuliba kintu kya mukisa.

305. Abantu bonna, noolwekyo, basiime ekitono awamu n’okutya Mukama; ebirabo mazima birungi okwegombebwa, naye ekisa ekinene n’ebirabo ebitono bisinga ebirabo ebinene awatali kisa. Tekigamba nti Mukama awa ebirabo n’ekitiibwa, wabula Mukama awa ekisa n’ekitiibwa; era alina omukisa omuntu oyo Mukama gw’awa ekisa, ekisa eky’amazima, kubanga ekyo kye kikulembera ekitiibwa mu bukakafu.

306. Naye Setaani bwe yategeera nti okunkema kwe n’okundumba bwe kutyo tekujja kutuukiriza kigendererwa kye, kwe kugamba okumenyawo obuweereza bwange, n’okubufuula obutaliimu mu bigendererwa byabwo; olwo n’agezaako ekkubo eddala, kwe kusiikuula emitima gy’abatamanyi n’ab’ettima, okuntikka okuwaayiriza n’okuvumibwa; noolwekyo kaakano nnyinza okugamba nti buli Omulyolyomi kye yasobola okuteesa, n’ebikozesebwa bye kye byasobola okuyiiya, kyasaasaanyizibwa mu kitundu kyonna okunnwanyisa, nga balowooza, nga bwe nnyogedde, nti mu ngeri eyo bajja kuleetera obuweereza bwange okulekebwa.

307. Awo ne kitandika okuyitingana mu bantu nti ndi mulogo, Omujesuwiti, omubbi ow’oku makubo, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo.

308. Ku ebyo byonna, nja kugamba bugambi nti, Katonda amanyi nti siriiko musango. Naye abanvunaana, beeteeketeeke okusisinkana nange mu maaso g’entebe ey’okusala emisango ey’Omwana wa Katonda, eyo okuwoza ku bintu bino, wamu n’obutali butuukirivu bwabwe obulala bwonna, okuggyako nga Katonda abawadde okwenenya olw’ebyo, kye nsaba n’omutima gwange gwonna.

309. Naye ekyasinga okwogerwa n’obuvumu obungi, kyali nti nnina abakazi bange ab’ebweru, abenzi bange, abaana bange ab’ebweru w’obufumbo, weewaawo, n’abakyala babiri omulundi gumu, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo. Kaakano okuwaayiriza kuno, wamu n’okulala, nkwenyumiririzaamu, kubanga kuwaayiriza bwokka, bulimba bwa busirusiru oba bwa bukuusa, n’eby’obulimba Omulyolyomi n’ezzadde lye bye bansuulako; era singa ensi tenkola bubi bwe butyo, nandibuliddwa akabonero kamu ak’omutukuvu era ak’omwana wa Katonda. ‘Mulina omukisa mmwe (bw’atyo Mukama Yesu bwe yagamba) bwe banaabavumanga, ne babayigganya, ne baboogerako ebibi ebya buli ngeri, ne babawaayiriza, nga babalanga nze; musanyuke era mujaguze kubanga empeera yammwe nnene mu ggulu, ne bannabbi ab’edda bwe baayigganyizibwa bwe batyo’ (Matayo 5:11).

310. Ebintu bino, noolwekyo, ku lwange tebinteganya; nedda, ne bwe byandibadde emirundi abiri okusinga bwe biri. Nnina omuntu ow’omunda omulungi, era kubanga banjogerako bubi ng’omukozi w’ebibi, baliswala abo abawaayiriza empisa zange ennungi mu Kristo.

311. Kale, kiki kye nnaagamba abo abansiize enziro bwe batyo? Nnaabatiisatiisa? Nnaabanenya? Nnaabawaanawaana? Nnaabeegayirira bakwate ennimi zaabwe? Nedda, nze si bwe ntyo; singa tekyali nti ebintu bino bibafuula abeetegefu okuzikirizibwa, abo ababiyiiya n’ababiwagira, nandibagambye nti, Mukyogere, kubanga kinaayongera ekitiibwa kyange.

312. Noolwekyo obulimba buno n’okuwaayiriza mbyesiba ng’eby’okwewunda; kiri mu kwatula kwange okw’Ekikristaayo okunyoomebwa, okuwaayirizibwa, okuvumibwa n’okujeregebwa; era kubanga bino byonna si kirala wabula obulimba, nga Katonda wange n’omuntu wange ow’omunda bwe bantegeeza, nsanyuka mu kuvumibwa ku lwa Kristo.

313. Era mbayita abasirusiru oba abakuusa abo bonna abafudde kino omulimu gwabwe okukakasa ekimu ku bintu ebyogeddwako waggulu ku nze, kwe kugamba nti nnayenda ku bakazi abalala, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo. Bwe banaamala okukozesa amaanyi gaabwe gonna, ne banoonyereza ddala nga bwe basobola, bakakase mu mazima nti waliwo omukazi yenna mu ggulu, oba ku nsi, oba mu ggeyeena, ayinza okugamba nti, nnali ngezezzaako okwenda naye, ekiseera kyonna, mu kifo kyonna, emisana oba ekiro. Ate njogera bwe ntyo okwegayirira abalabe bange bansiime? Nedda, nze si bwe ntyo: mu kino sijja kwegayirira muntu yenna kumbeera; nzikiriza oba tonzikiriza mu kino, byombi gye ndi kye kimu.

314. Abalabe bange bagudde ebbali w’akabonero mu kunkuba kwabwe kuno. Nze si nze muntu oyo. Nneegomba nti bo bennyini babeere nga tebalina musango. Singa abenzi n’abakaba bonna mu Bungereza bawanikibwa mu bulago okutuusa lwe bafa, John Bunyan, oyo gwe bakwatirwa obuggya, yandibadde akyali mulamu era bulungi. Simanyi obanga waliwo ekintu ng’omukazi assa omukka wansi w’eggulu lyonna, okuggyako olw’engoye zaabwe, abaana baabwe, oba olw’ebigambo ebimanyiddwa bonna, okuggyako mukyala wange.

315. Era mu kino neewuunya amagezi ga Katonda, nti yanfuula omuntu ow’ensonyi eri abakazi okuva lwe nnakyuka okutuusa kaakano. Abo abamanyi, era abayinza okunjulira, be nnasinga okubeera nabo okumpi, nti kintu kya buzibu okundaba nga nneeyisa mu ngeri ey’okusanyusa eri omukazi; okulamusa omukazi okwa bulijjo nkukyawa, kunnyiwaza mu muntu yenna gwe nkulabako. Okubeera nabo bokka, sikigumira. Sitera na kukwata ku mukono gwa mukazi, kubanga ndowooza ebintu bino tebinsaanira. Bwe ndabye abasajja abalungi nga banywegera abakazi be baakyaliddeko, oba abaabakyalidde, emirundi egimu mbiwakanyizza, era bwe bandiddamu nti kyali kya mpisa nnungi bubeezi, mbagambye nti si kyakulaba kirungi; abamu mazima baawolereza okunywegera okutukuvu, naye olwo ne mbabuuza lwaki baasosola, lwaki baanywegera abasinga obulungi, ne baleka abatali balungi; bwe kityo, ebintu ng’ebyo ne bwe byandibadde bitenderezebwa batya mu maaso g’abalala, mu maaso gange bibadde tebisaana.

316. Era kaakano okumaliriza ensonga eno, mpita si bantu bokka, naye ne bamalayika, okukakasa nti nnina omusango gw’okwegatta n’omukazi yenna mu mubiri okuggyako mukyala wange; era sitya kukikola omulundi ogwokubiri, nga mmanyi nti siyinza kunyiiza Mukama mu nsonga ng’eyo, okuyita Katonda okuba omujulirwa ku mwoyo gwange, nti mu bintu bino siriiko musango. Si nti nkuumiddwa bwe ntyo olw’obulungi bwonna obuli mu nze okusinga omulala yenna, wabula Katonda ansaasidde, era ankuumye; gwe nsaba ankuume bulijjo, si mu kino kyokka, naye ne mu buli kkubo n’omulimu omubi, era ankuume okutuuka mu bwakabaka bwe obw’omu ggulu. Amiina.

317. Kaakano nga Setaani bwe yafuba, olw’okuvumibwa n’okuwaayiriza, okunfuula ekinyoomebwa mu bannansi bange, bwe kiba nga kiyinzika okubuulira kwange kufuulibwe okutaliimu, bwe kityo ne kwongerwako okusibibwa mu kkomera okw’ekiseera ekiwanvu era ekikooya, ndyoke ntiisibwe ndeke obuweereza bwange eri Kristo, n’ensi etiisibwe, ne batya okujja okumpulira nga mbuulira; ekyo nja kukibawa ennyinyonnyola ennyimpi mu kitundu ekiddako.
fields.body_text: 265. Era kaakano nga bwe njogera ku bye nnayitamu, nja kuyingizaamu wano ekigambo kimu oba bibiri ku kubuulira kwange Ekigambo, n’engeri Katonda gye yankolamu mu nsonga eyo nayo. Kubanga bwe nnamala emyaka nga etaano oba mukaaga nga nzuukusiddwa, era nga nnyambiddwa okulaba obwetaavu bwa Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe n’omuwendo gwe, era nga nsobozeseddwa okuwaayo omwoyo gwange gy’ali, abamu ku basinga obusobozi mu batukuvu abaali naffe, njogera abasinga mu kusalawo obulungi n’obutukuvu bw’obulamu, nga bwe baalowooza, ne bategeera nti Katonda yali ansiimye okutegeera ekitono ku by’ayagala mu Kigambo kye ekitukuvu era eky’omukisa, era ng’ampadde okwogera, mu kigera ekimu, okunnyonnyola abalala bye nnalaba ne bazimbibwa; kyebaava bansaba, era n’obunyiikivu bungi, nkkirize, oluusi, okwogera mu lumu ku nkuŋŋaana ekigambo eky’okubabuulirira. 266. Ekyo, newaakubadde nga mu kusooka kyakkakkanya nnyo omwoyo gwange ne kinswaza, naye bwe beeyongera okunsaba n’okunneegayirira, ne nzikiriza kye baasaba, ne ndaga ekirabo kyange mu bo emirundi ebiri mu nkuŋŋaana bbiri ez’enjawulo, naye mu kyama, newaakubadde nga n’obunafu bungi; awo ne batalabika bulabisi, wabula ne bakakasa n’obwegendereza, nga bali mu maaso ga Katonda omukulu, nti bakwatiddwako era babudaabudiddwa, ne beebaza Kitaffe ow’okusaasira olw’ekisa ekyampeebwa. 267. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, oluusi abamu ku bo bwe baagendanga mu byalo okuyigiriza, baayagalanga ŋŋende nabo; era eyo, newaakubadde nga nnali sinnakozesa kirabo kyange mu lwatu, era nga ntya okukikola, naye mu kyama nga bwe nnatuukanga mu bantu abalungi mu bifo ebyo, oluusi nnayogeranga nabo ekigambo eky’okubalabula; nabo ne bakitwala nga bali abalala bwe baakitwala, nga basanyuka olw’okusaasira kwa Katonda gye ndi, nga bagamba nti emyoyo gyabwe gizimbiddwa olw’ekyo. 268. Noolwekyo, mu bimpimpi, ku nkomerero, ekkanisa bwe yeeyongera okunsaba, oluvannyuma lw’okusaba Mukama n’obwegendereza, nga tusiiba, ne nnyitibwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, ne nnondebwa okubuuliranga Ekigambo bulijjo era mu lwatu, si eri abo abakkiriza bokka ne mu bo, naye n’okuleetera Enjiri abo abaali batannafuna kukkiriza; era mu kiseera ekyo ne nkizuula lwatu mu birowoozo byange nti waliwo ekintu ekinsindiikiriza mu kyama okukikola; naye nneebaza Katonda, si lwa kwegomba kitiibwa kya bwereere, kubanga mu kiseera ekyo nnali mbonyaabonyezebwa nnyo obusaale obw’omuliro obw’Omulyolyomi ku bikwata ku mbeera yange ey’olubeerera. 269. Naye ne sisobola kumatira okuggyako nga nkozesa ekirabo kyange, era ekyo kye nnazzibwamu amaanyi nnyo, si lwa kwegomba kw’abatya Katonda okutakoma kwokka, naye n’ekigambo kya Pawulo eri Abakkolinso, ‘Abooluganda, mumanyi nti mu Akaya ab’omu nnyumba ya Suteefana be baasooka okukkiriza Mukama waffe, era beewaayo okuyamba n’okuweereza abantu ba Katonda. Kale, abooluganda, mbasaba muwulirenga abantu ng’abo, era na buli omu afube okukoleranga awamu nabo’ (1 Abakkolinso 16:15, 16) . 270. Olw’ekyawandiikibwa ekyo ne ndagibwa nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu teyagenderera n’akatono abantu abalina ebirabo n’obusobozi okubiziika mu ttaka, wabula yalagira era n’akubiriza abo okukozesa ekirabo kyabwe, era n’atendereza abo abaali abeetegefu era abayaayaanira okukikola, ‘Beewaayo okuyamba n’okuweereza abantu ba Katonda.’ Ekyawandiikibwa kino, mu nnaku ezo, kyabeeranga mu birowoozo byange buli kiseera, okunzizaamu amaanyi n’okunnyweza mu mulimu guno ogwa Katonda; era nziddwamu amaanyi n’ebyawandiikibwa ebirala bingi n’eby’okulabirako by’abatya Katonda, ebyogerwako mu Kigambo ne mu byafaayo ebirala eby’edda (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 8:4; 18:24, 25; 1 Peetero 4:10; Abaruumi 12:6; Foxe, Acts and Monuments). 271. Noolwekyo, newaakubadde nga nze kennyini nze nsinga obutasaana mu batukuvu bonna, naye nze, wabula n’okutya kungi n’okukankana nga ndaba obunafu bwange, ne ntandika omulimu, era nga bwe nnali n’ekirabo kyange n’ekigera ky’okukkiriza kwange, ne mbuulira Enjiri eyo ey’omukisa Katonda gye yali andaze mu Kigambo ekitukuvu eky’amazima; abantu ab’omu kitundu ekyo bwe baakitegeera, ne bajja okuwulira Ekigambo mu bikumi n’ebikumi, era okuva mu bitundu byonna, newaakubadde nga baalina ensonga ezitali zimu era ez’enjawulo. 272. Era nneebaza Katonda nti yampa ekigera ky’okulumirwa n’okusaasira emyoyo gyabwe, ekyo nakyo ne kinsindika okukola n’obunyiikivu bungi n’okufuba, okunoonya ekigambo ekyandisobodde, singa Katonda akiwa omukisa, okukwata ku muntu ow’omunda n’okumuzuukusa; era Mukama omulungi mu kino n’assaayo omwoyo ku kwegomba kw’omuddu we; kubanga saamala kiseera kiwanvu nga mbuulira, abamu ne batandika okukwatibwako Ekigambo, n’okunakuwala ennyo mu birowoozo byabwe nga bategedde obunene bw’ekibi kyabwe n’obwetaavu bwabwe bwa Yesu Kristo. 273. Naye mu kusooka nnali sisobola kukkiriza nti Katonda ayinza okwogera ng’ayita mu nze eri omutima gw’omuntu yenna, kubanga nnali nkyeyita atasaana; naye abo abaakwatibwako bwe batyo baanjagalanga era nga bampa ekitiibwa eky’enjawulo; era newaakubadde nga nnagaananga nti baazuukusibwa ku lwange, baakyatulanga, ne bakikakasa mu maaso g’abatukuvu ba Katonda; era baatenderezanga Katonda ku lwange, nze omunaku atasaana! ne bantwala ng’ekikozesebwa kya Katonda ekyabalaga ekkubo ery’obulokozi. 274. Noolwekyo, bwe nnabalaba nga banywevu bwe batyo mu bigambo byabwe ne mu bikolwa byabwe, era nga mu mitima gyabwe bafuba nnyo okutegeera Yesu Kristo, nga basanyuka nti Katonda yansindika gye baali; awo ne ntandika okulowooza nti kiyinzika okuba bwe kityo, nti Katonda akkirizza mu mulimu gwe omusirusiru nga nze; olwo ekigambo kya Katonda kino ne kijja mu mutima gwange nga kinzizaamu amaanyi mu ngeri ewooma ennyo, ‘Omusajja ng’afa, y’ansabira omukisa, ne ndeetera omutima gwa nnamwandu okuyimba’ (Yobu 29:13). 275. Ekyo kyennava nsanyuka; weewaawo, amaziga g’abo Katonda be yazuukusanga olw’okubuulira kwange gaabanga kubudaabudibwa era kuzzibwamu maanyi gye ndi; kubanga nnalowooza ku bigambo bino, ‘Ani anansanyusa wabula oyo gwe nnaanakuwaza?’ (2 Abakkolinso 2:2); era nate, Obanga ‘ssiri mutume eri abalala, naye ndi mutume eri mmwe, kubanga mmwe kabonero k’obutume bwange mu Mukama waffe’ (1 Abakkolinso 9:2). Ebintu ebyo, noolwekyo, byali ng’obukakafu obulala gye ndi nti Katonda yampita mu mulimu guno, era n’ayimirira nange mu gwo. 276. Mu kubuulira kwange Ekigambo, nnassaayo nnyo omwoyo ku kintu kimu kino, kwe kugamba nti Mukama yankulemberanga okutandikira awo Ekigambo kye we kitandikira n’aboonoonyi; kwe kugamba, okusalira omusango abantu bonna ab’omubiri, n’okulaga n’okukakasa nti ekikolimo kya Katonda, olw’amateeka, kiri ku bantu bonna era kibakwata nga bwe bazaalibwa mu nsi, olw’ekibi. Ekitundu kino eky’omulimu gwange nnakituukiriza nga nkiwulira nnyo; kubanga entiisa y’amateeka n’omusango olw’ebyonoono byange byazitowa nnyo ku muntu wange ow’omunda. Nnabuuliranga kye nnawulira, kye nnawuliranga nga kinnuma, kwe kugamba ekyo omwoyo gwange omwavu kye gwasindanga wansi waakyo era kye gwakankananga nakyo okutuuka okwewuunya. 277. Mazima nnali ng’omuntu abatumiddwa okuva mu bafu; nze kennyini nnagenda nga ndi mu njegere okubuulira abo abaali mu njegere; era nnasitula mu muntu wange ow’omunda omuliro ogwo gwe nnabalabula okwegendereza. Nnyinza okwogera mu mazima, era awatali bukuusa, nti bwe nnagendanga okubuulira, nnagendanga njjudde omusango n’entiisa okutuuka ne ku mulyango gw’ekituuti, era eyo ne bingibwako, ne mbeera wa ddembe mu birowoozo byange okutuusa lwe nnamalanga omulimu gwange; olwo amangu ago, nga sinnaba na kukka madaala ga kituuti, ne nzirayo mu mbeera embi nga bwe nnali emabega; naye Katonda yantwala mu maaso, mazima n’omukono ogw’amaanyi, kubanga omusango wadde ggeyeena tebyasobola kunzigya ku mulimu gwange. 278. Bwe ntyo bwe nnamala ekiseera kya myaka ebiri, nga nkaayana nnyo ku bibi by’abantu, n’embeera yaabwe ey’entiisa olw’ebibi ebyo. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo Mukama n’ajja ku mwoyo gwange n’emirembe egy’enkalakkalira n’okubudaabudibwa mu Kristo; kubanga yampa okulaba ebintu bingi ebiwoomu eby’ekisa kye eky’omukisa mu Ye. Kyennava nkyusa mu kubuulira kwange, kubanga nnali nkyabuulira kye nnalaba ne kye nnawulira; noolwekyo kaakano nnafuba nnyo okulaga ensi Yesu Kristo mu mirimu gye gyonna, mu nkolagana ze, ne mu birungi bye; era nnafuba n’okubikkula, okusalira omusango, n’okuggyawo ebiwaniriro n’emiko egy’obulimba ensi kw’eyesigama, era ne ku byo kw’egwa n’ezikirira. Ku bintu bino nabyo nnamalako ekiseera kiwanvu nga ku biri ebirala. 279. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, Katonda n’antwala mu kitundu ku kyama eky’okwegatta ne Kristo; kyennava nkibikkula ne nkibalaga nakyo. Era bwe nnamala okutambulira mu nsonga zino essatu enkulu ez’Ekigambo kya Katonda, okumala emyaka nga etaano oba okusingawo, ne nkwatibwa nga nkola kye nkola kaakano, ne nsuulibwa mu kkomera, gye mmaze ekiseera ekisinga ku ekyo omulundi omulala, okukakasa amazima nga mbonaabona, nga bwe nnali emabega nga ngategeeza ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe biri nga mbuulira. 280. Bwe mbadde mbuulira, nneebaza Katonda, omutima gwange emirundi mingi, ekiseera kyonna eky’omulimu ogwo n’omulala, gukaabiridde Katonda n’obunyiikivu bungi afuule Ekigambo eky’amaanyi okulokola emyoyo; nga bulijjo nnakuwala nti omulabe aleme okuggya Ekigambo mu muntu ow’omunda, ne kiba nga tekibala. Kyennava nfuba okwogera Ekigambo mu ngeri, singa kiyinzika, ekibi n’omuntu alina omusango bisonjolwe bulungi olw’ekigambo ekyo. 281. Era, bwe nnamalanga okubuulira, kyannumanga mu mutima okulowooza nti Ekigambo kaakano kiyinza okugwa ng’enkuba ku bifo eby’amayinja, nga bulijjo nneegomba okuva mu mutima gwange nti, O singa abo abampulidde nga njogera leero bandirabye nga nze bwe ndaba ekibi kye kiri, n’okufa, ne ggeyeena, n’ekikolimo kya Katonda; era n’ekisa, n’okwagala, n’okusaasira kwa Katonda bwe biri, mu Kristo, eri abantu abali mu mbeera ng’eyaabwe, abakyali ewala naye. Era, mazima, emirundi mingi nnayogeranga mu mutima gwange mu maaso ga Mukama nti, Singa okuwanikibwa kaakano mu maaso gaabwe kwandibadde kkubo ery’okubazuukusa n’okubanyweza mu mazima, nandimatidde n’essanyu. 282. Kubanga mu kubuulira kwange, naddala bwe mbadde nnyonnyola enjigiriza ey’obulamu mu Kristo, awatali bikolwa, mbadde nga gy’obeera malayika wa Katonda ayimiridde emabega wange okunzizaamu amaanyi. Oh, kibadde n’amaanyi gatyo n’obukakafu obw’omu ggulu ku mwoyo gwange, nga bwe mbadde nfuba okukinnyonnyola, okukikakasa, n’okukinyweza mu muntu ow’omunda ow’abalala, ne ndema okumatira n’okugamba nti, Nzikiriza, era nkakasa; nnalowooza nti nnali nkakasa okusingawo, bwe kiba nga kikkirizibwa okwogera bwe ntyo, nti ebintu ebyo bye nnali nkakasa mu kiseera ekyo byali bya mazima. 283. Bwe nnasooka okugenda okubuulira Ekigambo ebweru, abasomesa n’abakabona b’omu kitundu ne banjolekera n’obukambwe bungi. Naye nnali nkakasizza kino, obutaddiza kuvuma ku kuvuma, wabula okulaba bameka ku beeyatula eddiini mu bo ab’omubiri be nnyinza okumatiza ku mbeera yaabwe embi olw’amateeka, ne ku bwetaavu bwa Kristo n’omuwendo gwe; kubanga nnalowooza nti, Kino kye kirimpolereza mu biseera ebigenda okujja, bwe balibeera nga bakebera empeera yange mu maaso gaabwe (Olubereberye 30:33). 284. Saafangayo kwegatta mu bintu ebiwakanirwa era ebikaayanirwa mu batukuvu, naddala ebintu ebya wansi ennyo; naye kyansanyusanga nnyo okulwanirira n’obunyiikivu bungi ekigambo eky’okukkiriza n’okusonyiyibwa ebibi olw’okufa n’okubonaabona kwa Yesu; naye njogera nti, ku bintu ebirala, nnabirekanga, kubanga nnalaba nga bireeta empaka, era kubanga okubikola oba obutabikola tekutusemberereza Katonda okubeera babe. Ate era nnalaba nti omulimu gwange ogwali mu maaso gange gwakulukutira mu mukutu omulala, kwe kugamba okutwala ekigambo ekizuukusa; kyennava nkinywererako ne nkinywerera. 285. Saafubanga, era saagumanga, kukozesa ebyo abantu abalala bye baazimba (Abaruumi 15:18), newaakubadde sisalira musango bonna abakikola; kubanga nnalowooza mazima, era ne nkizuula mu bye nnayitamu, nti ekyo kye nnayigirizibwa Ekigambo n’Omwoyo wa Kristo kyandisobodde okwogerwa, okulwanirirwa, n’okunywererwako omuntu ow’omunda asinga obulamu n’obunywevu; era newaakubadde nga sijja kwogera kaakano byonna bye mmanyi ku nsonga eno, naye bye nnayitamu bikwatagana nnyo n’ekyawandiikibwa ekyo okusinga abantu bangi bwe bamanyi (Abaggalatiya 1:11, 12). 286. Singa omu ku abo abaazuukusibwa olw’obuweereza bwange yaddanga emabega oluvannyuma, nga bwe kyabangawo oluusi eri bangi nnyo, nnyinza okwogera mu mazima nti okubula kwabwe kubaddenga kunnuma okusinga singa omu ku baana bange, abazaalibwa mu mubiri gwange, yali agenda mu ntaana; ndowooza, mazima, nnyinza okukyogera awatali kunyiiza Mukama, nti tewali kintu kinkutteko nnyo nga ekyo, okuggyako okutya okubulwa obulokozi bw’omwoyo gwange. Mbadde ndaba nga gy’obeera nnina ennyumba ennungi n’obwami mu bifo abaana bange gye baazaalibwa; omutima gwange gubadde gusibiddwa nnyo mu kitiibwa ky’omulimu guno omulungi ennyo, ne ndowooza nti Katonda ampadde omukisa n’ekitiibwa olw’ekyo okusinga singa yanfuula kabaka omukulu ow’ensi ey’Ekikristaayo, oba mukama w’ekitiibwa kyonna eky’ensi nga sirina kino! O ebigambo bino, ‘Omuntu oyo akomyawo munne eri Katonda, aba awonyezza omwoyo gwa munne okufa’ (Yakobo 5:20). ‘Ekibala ky’omutuukirivu muti gwa bulamu, era n’oyo asikiriza emyoyo gy’abantu ne balokoka wa magezi’ (Engero 11:30). ‘Abo abalina okutegeera balyakaayakana ng’okumasamasa kw’omu bbanga; n’abo abakyusa abangi okudda eri obutuukirivu, balyakaayakana ng’emmunyeenye emirembe n’emirembe’ (Danyeri 12:3). ‘Kale Mukama waffe Yesu bw’alijja, si mmwe mulibeera essuubi n’essanyu lyaffe, n’engule ey’okwenyumiriza kwaffe? Kubanga mmwe kitiibwa kyaffe era essanyu lyaffe’ (1 Abasessaloniika 2:19, 20). Bino, njogera, wamu n’ebirala bingi ebiri ng’ebyo, bibadde binzizaamu nnyo amaanyi. 287. Nkirabye nti, gye mbadde n’omulimu gw’okukolera Katonda, nsooka okuba, nga bwe kiri, n’okutambula kwa Katonda ku mwoyo gwange nga nneegomba okubuulira eyo. Nkirabye era nti emyoyo egimu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo gitekeddwa nnyo ku mutima gwange, ne nkubirizibwa okwegomba okulokolebwa kwabwe; era nti emyoyo egyo gyennyini, oluvannyuma, giweereddwa ng’ebibala by’obuweereza bwange. Nkirabye era nti ekigambo ekyogeddwa mu kuyitawo kikoze nnyo mu kubuulira okusinga byonna ebirala ebyayogerwa; era oluusi bwe mbadde ndowooza nti sikoze kirungi kyonna, olwo nga nkoze kingi okusinga; era emirundi emirala bwe mbadde ndowooza nti nja kubakwasa, nvubye ne sikwasa kantu. 288. Nkirabye era nti, awaabanga omulimu ogw’okukola ku boonoonyi, eyo Omulyolyomi abadde atandika okuwuluguma mu mitima, ne mu kamwa k’abaddu be. Weewaawo, emirundi mingi ensi embi bw’ebadde esinga okunyiiga, eyo emyoyo we gizuukusiddwa Ekigambo. Nnandisobodde okulaga eby’okulabirako, naye nneeziyiza. 289. Kye nnasinga okwegomba mu kutuukiriza obuweereza bwange kwali kuyingira mu bifo ebisinga ekizikiza mu kitundu, ne mu bantu abo abaali ewala ennyo n’okwatula eddiini; naye si lwa kuba nti saasobola kugumira kitangaala, kubanga saatya kulaga Njiri yange eri muntu yenna, wabula kubanga nnazuula nti omwoyo gwange gwasinga kwegomba mulimu gwa kuzuukusa na kukyusa, era n’Ekigambo kye nnatwala kyennyini kyalaganga nnyo mu kkubo eryo; ‘weewaawo, nduubirira okubuulira Enjiri mu bifo etayatulwanga linnya lya Kristo, nneme okuzimba ku musingi gw’omuntu omulala’ (Abaruumi 15:20). 290. Mu kubuulira kwange mbadde mu bulumi ddala, era mbadde, nga bwe kiri, nga ndumwa ebisa okuzaalira Katonda abaana; era nnali sisobola kumatira okuggyako ng’ebibala birabise mu mulimu gwange. Singa sibala, tekyali kikulu ani antendereza; naye singa mbala, saafaayo ani ansalira musango. Nfumiitirizza ku kino, ‘Oyo asikiriza emyoyo gy’abantu ne balokoka wa magezi’ (Engero 11:30); era nate, ‘Abaana aboobulenzi kya bugagga okuva eri Mukama; era abaana mpeera gy’agaba okuva gy’ali. Ng’obusaale bwe bubeera mu mukono gw’omulwanyi, n’abaana abazaalibwa mu buvubuka bw’omuntu bwe bali bwe batyo. Alina omukisa omuntu oyo ajjuzza ensawo ye n’obusaale, kubanga tebaliswazibwa; balyolekera abalabe baabwe mu mulyango omunene’ (Zabbuli 127:3-5). 291. Tekyansanyusa n’akatono okulaba abantu nga banywa endowooza bwe baali nga tebamanyi Yesu Kristo n’omuwendo gw’obulokozi bwabwe; okukakatibwa okw’amazima olw’ekibi, naddala olw’obutakkiriza, n’omutima ogukutte omuliro okwagala okulokolebwa Kristo, n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi okw’omwoyo ogutukuziddwa ddala, ekyo kye kyansanyusanga; abo be bantu be nnatwalanga nti balina omukisa. 292. Naye mu mulimu guno, nga mu mirimu emirala gyonna, nnalina okukemebwa okwangoberera, era okw’engeri nnyingi; oluusi nga nnumbibwa okuggwamu amaanyi okungi, nga ntya nti sijja kusobola kwogera Kigambo n’akatono mu ngeri ezimba; weewaawo, nti sijja kusobola na kwogera bigambo bitegeerekeka eri abantu; mu biseera ebyo omubiri gwange gwakwatibwanga okuzirika okwewuunyisa n’obutaba na maanyi, ebigere byange ne bitasobola na kuntwala mu kifo we nnalina okubuulira. 293. Oluusi nate, bwe mbadde mbuulira, mbadde nnumbibwa n’amaanyi ebirowoozo eby’okuvvoola, ne nkemebwa nnyo okwogera ebigambo ebyo n’akamwa kange mu maaso g’ekibiina. Era oluusi, ne bwe mbadde ntandise okwogera Ekigambo n’obutangaavu bungi, n’obukakafu, n’eddembe ery’okwogera, naye nga ekiseera ekyo tekinnaggwaako, mbadde nzibiddwa amaaso nnyo, era nga ndi wala nnyo n’ebintu bye mbadde njogera, era nga nziyizibwa nnyo mu kwogera kwange mu maaso g’abantu, ne mbeera nga gy’obeera simanyi oba sijjukira kye mbadde nkola, oba ng’omutwe gwange guli mu nsawo ekiseera kyonna eky’okubuulira. 294. Ate, oluusi bwe mbadde nga nnaatera okubuulira ku kitundu ky’Ekigambo ekisala era ekyokya, nsanze omukemi ng’ansalira amagezi nti, Ki, ogenda kubuulira kino? kino kikusalira musango ggwe wennyini; omwoyo gwo gwennyini gulina omusango gwa kino; noolwekyo tokibuulirako n’akatono; oba bw’onookibuulira, kikendeeze ng’okwekolera ekkubo ery’okuwona; si kulwa nga mu kifo ky’okuzuukusa abalala, oteeka ku mwoyo gwo omusango gw’otoliva wansi waagwo. 295. Naye, nneebaza Mukama, nkuumiddwa obutakkiriza kuteesa kuno okw’entiisa ennyo, era nsinze, nga Samusooni, okusindika n’amaanyi gange gonna, okusalira omusango ekibi n’okusobya buli we nnabisanganga, weewaawo, ne bwe nnali nga mu kyo nange nneeretako omusango ku muntu wange ow’omunda! ‘Leka nfiire,’ nnalowooza, ‘wamu n’Abafirisuuti’ (Abalamuzi 16:29, 30), okusinga okukozesa Ekigambo kya Katonda eky’omukisa mu bukuusa, ‘Ggwe ayigiriza abalala, lwaki toyinza kweyigiriza wekka?’ Kirungi nnyo ggwe okwesalira omusango, ne bw’oba ng’obuulira abalala lwatu, okusinga ggwe, olw’okwewonya, okusiba amazima mu butali butuukirivu; Katonda yeebazibwe olw’obuyambi bwe ne mu kino. 296. Era, bwe mbadde nkola omulimu guno ogw’omukisa ogwa Kristo, emirundi mingi nkemeddwa okwekulumbaza n’okwegulumiza mu mutima; era newaakubadde nga sigumira kwogera nti sikwatiddwako kino, naye mazima Mukama, olw’okusaasira kwe okw’omuwendo, ankoledde bw’ati, nti, emirundi egisinga, mbadde n’essanyu ttono okukkiriza ekintu ekyo; kubanga buli lunaku gubadde mugabo gwange okulagibwa obubi bw’omutima gwange gwennyini, era n’okulaba bulijjo obungi bw’obuvundu n’obunafu mu gwo, ne kimpunza omutwe wakati mu birabo byange byonna n’ebyo bye ntuuseeko; mpulidde eriggwa eryo mu mubiri, nga kwe kusaasira kwennyini kwa Katonda gye ndi (2 Abakkolinso 12:7-9). 297. Era wamu n’ekyo, mbadde ndagibwa ekifo ekimu oba ekirala ekyeyoleka mu Kigambo, ekigambo ekyo nga kirimu ekigambo ekisala era ekifumita ku kuzikirira kw’omwoyo, newaakubadde n’ebirabo n’obusobozi; okugeza, kino kibadde kya mugaso nnyo gye ndi, ‘Singa njogera ennimi z’abantu n’eza bamalayika, naye nga sirina kwagala, mba ng’ekidde, ekireekaana oba ng’ekitaasa ekisaala’ (1 Abakkolinso 13:1, 2). 298. Ekitaasa ekisaala kye kivuga ky’ennyimba, omukubi omukugu ky’asobola okukubamu ennyimba ennungi ennyo ezikwata ku mutima, abo bonna abamuwulira ng’akuba ne batasobola na kwekomako kuzina; naye laba, ekitaasa tekirina bulamu, n’ennyimba teziva mu kyo, wabula olw’obukugu bw’oyo akikuba; kale ekivuga ekyo kiyinza ku nkomerero okufuuka ekitaliimu n’okuzikirira, newaakubadde nga edda ennyimba ng’ezo zaakubirwangako. 299. Bwe ntyo bwe nnalaba nga bwe kiri era bwe kiriba eri abo abalina ebirabo naye nga tebalina kisa kirokola: bali mu mukono gwa Kristo, ng’ekitaasa mu mukono gwa Dawudi; era nga Dawudi bwe yasobolanga, n’ekitaasa, okuleeta essanyu eryo mu kusinza Katonda n’okusitula emitima gy’abasinza, bw’atyo Kristo bw’asobola okukozesa abantu bano abalina ebirabo, okukwata nabo ku myoyo gy’abantu be mu kkanisa ye; naye bw’amala okukola byonna, n’abawanika ku bbali ng’ebitaasa ebitalina bulamu, newaakubadde nga bivuga. 300. Okulowooza kuno, noolwekyo, wamu n’ebirala, emirundi egisinga kwali ng’ennyondo ku mutwe gw’amalala n’okwegomba ekitiibwa ekitaliimu; ki, nnalowooza, nneekulumbaze kubanga ndi kidde ekireekaana? Kikulu nnyo okuba endingidi? Ekitonde ekisinga obutono ekirina obulamu tekirina ku Katonda okusinga bino? Ate era nnamanya nti okwagala kwe kutalifa, naye bino biriggwaawo ne bibula; kyennava nsalawo nti ekisa ekitono, okwagala okutono, okutya Katonda okw’amazima okutono, kusinga ebirabo bino byonna; weewaawo, era nkakasiza ddala nti kiyinzika omuntu atasobola na kuddamu muntu okuggyako n’okutabulwa okungi mu ngeri y’okwogera, njogera nti kiyinzika omuntu ng’oyo okuba n’ekisa emirundi lukumi okusingawo, era bw’atyo okuba mu kwagala ne mu kusiimibwa kwa Mukama okusinga abamu abasobola, olw’ekirabo eky’okumanya, okwogera nga bamalayika. 301. Bwe ntyo, noolwekyo, ne ntegeera nti newaakubadde ng’ebirabo mu byo byennyini birungi eri ekyo kye byategekerwa, kwe kugamba okuzimba abalala, naye tebirina kintu era tebirina maanyi kulokola mwoyo gw’oyo abirina, bwe biba nga biri byokka; era tebiri, mu ngeri eyo, kabonero konna nti embeera y’omuntu ya mukisa, kubanga birabo bya Katonda ebigabibwa eri abamu, era ku ngeri gye babikozesezza oba gye batabikozesezza, balina, obulamu obutono bwe bunaaba buwedde, okubiwozaako eri Oyo eyeeteeseteese okusalira abalamu n’abafu omusango. 302. Kino era kyandaga nti ebirabo, bwe biba nga biri byokka, bya kabi, si mu byo byennyini, wabula olw’ebibi ebigoberera abo ababirina, kwe kugamba amalala, okwegomba ekitiibwa ekitaliimu, okwemanya, n’ebirala, ebyo byonna ebyafuuwibwanga mangu olw’okutenderezebwa n’okusiimibwa buli Mukristaayo atalina magezi, ne bireeta akabi eri ekitonde ekyavu okusalirwa omusango ng’Omulyolyomi bwe yagusalirwa. 303. Kyennava ndaba nti oyo alina ebirabo yeetaaga okulagibwa obutonde bwabyo, kwe kugamba nti tebimala kumufuula muntu alokoleddwa ddala, aleme okubyesigamako, n’atuuka obutatuuka ku kisa kya Katonda. 304. Era alina ensonga okutambula n’obwetoowaze ne Katonda, n’okuba omutono mu maaso ge ye, n’okujjukira wamu n’ekyo nti ebirabo bye si bibye, wabula bya kkanisa; era nti olw’ebyo afuuliddwa omuweereza w’ekkanisa; era nti ku nkomerero ateekwa okuwoza ku buwanika bwe eri Mukama Yesu; era okuwoza obulungi kuliba kintu kya mukisa. 305. Abantu bonna, noolwekyo, basiime ekitono awamu n’okutya Mukama; ebirabo mazima birungi okwegombebwa, naye ekisa ekinene n’ebirabo ebitono bisinga ebirabo ebinene awatali kisa. Tekigamba nti Mukama awa ebirabo n’ekitiibwa, wabula Mukama awa ekisa n’ekitiibwa; era alina omukisa omuntu oyo Mukama gw’awa ekisa, ekisa eky’amazima, kubanga ekyo kye kikulembera ekitiibwa mu bukakafu. 306. Naye Setaani bwe yategeera nti okunkema kwe n’okundumba bwe kutyo tekujja kutuukiriza kigendererwa kye, kwe kugamba okumenyawo obuweereza bwange, n’okubufuula obutaliimu mu bigendererwa byabwo; olwo n’agezaako ekkubo eddala, kwe kusiikuula emitima gy’abatamanyi n’ab’ettima, okuntikka okuwaayiriza n’okuvumibwa; noolwekyo kaakano nnyinza okugamba nti buli Omulyolyomi kye yasobola okuteesa, n’ebikozesebwa bye kye byasobola okuyiiya, kyasaasaanyizibwa mu kitundu kyonna okunnwanyisa, nga balowooza, nga bwe nnyogedde, nti mu ngeri eyo bajja kuleetera obuweereza bwange okulekebwa. 307. Awo ne kitandika okuyitingana mu bantu nti ndi mulogo, Omujesuwiti, omubbi ow’oku makubo, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo. 308. Ku ebyo byonna, nja kugamba bugambi nti, Katonda amanyi nti siriiko musango. Naye abanvunaana, beeteeketeeke okusisinkana nange mu maaso g’entebe ey’okusala emisango ey’Omwana wa Katonda, eyo okuwoza ku bintu bino, wamu n’obutali butuukirivu bwabwe obulala bwonna, okuggyako nga Katonda abawadde okwenenya olw’ebyo, kye nsaba n’omutima gwange gwonna. 309. Naye ekyasinga okwogerwa n’obuvumu obungi, kyali nti nnina abakazi bange ab’ebweru, abenzi bange, abaana bange ab’ebweru w’obufumbo, weewaawo, n’abakyala babiri omulundi gumu, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo. Kaakano okuwaayiriza kuno, wamu n’okulala, nkwenyumiririzaamu, kubanga kuwaayiriza bwokka, bulimba bwa busirusiru oba bwa bukuusa, n’eby’obulimba Omulyolyomi n’ezzadde lye bye bansuulako; era singa ensi tenkola bubi bwe butyo, nandibuliddwa akabonero kamu ak’omutukuvu era ak’omwana wa Katonda. ‘Mulina omukisa mmwe (bw’atyo Mukama Yesu bwe yagamba) bwe banaabavumanga, ne babayigganya, ne baboogerako ebibi ebya buli ngeri, ne babawaayiriza, nga babalanga nze; musanyuke era mujaguze kubanga empeera yammwe nnene mu ggulu, ne bannabbi ab’edda bwe baayigganyizibwa bwe batyo’ (Matayo 5:11). 310. Ebintu bino, noolwekyo, ku lwange tebinteganya; nedda, ne bwe byandibadde emirundi abiri okusinga bwe biri. Nnina omuntu ow’omunda omulungi, era kubanga banjogerako bubi ng’omukozi w’ebibi, baliswala abo abawaayiriza empisa zange ennungi mu Kristo. 311. Kale, kiki kye nnaagamba abo abansiize enziro bwe batyo? Nnaabatiisatiisa? Nnaabanenya? Nnaabawaanawaana? Nnaabeegayirira bakwate ennimi zaabwe? Nedda, nze si bwe ntyo; singa tekyali nti ebintu bino bibafuula abeetegefu okuzikirizibwa, abo ababiyiiya n’ababiwagira, nandibagambye nti, Mukyogere, kubanga kinaayongera ekitiibwa kyange. 312. Noolwekyo obulimba buno n’okuwaayiriza mbyesiba ng’eby’okwewunda; kiri mu kwatula kwange okw’Ekikristaayo okunyoomebwa, okuwaayirizibwa, okuvumibwa n’okujeregebwa; era kubanga bino byonna si kirala wabula obulimba, nga Katonda wange n’omuntu wange ow’omunda bwe bantegeeza, nsanyuka mu kuvumibwa ku lwa Kristo. 313. Era mbayita abasirusiru oba abakuusa abo bonna abafudde kino omulimu gwabwe okukakasa ekimu ku bintu ebyogeddwako waggulu ku nze, kwe kugamba nti nnayenda ku bakazi abalala, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo. Bwe banaamala okukozesa amaanyi gaabwe gonna, ne banoonyereza ddala nga bwe basobola, bakakase mu mazima nti waliwo omukazi yenna mu ggulu, oba ku nsi, oba mu ggeyeena, ayinza okugamba nti, nnali ngezezzaako okwenda naye, ekiseera kyonna, mu kifo kyonna, emisana oba ekiro. Ate njogera bwe ntyo okwegayirira abalabe bange bansiime? Nedda, nze si bwe ntyo: mu kino sijja kwegayirira muntu yenna kumbeera; nzikiriza oba tonzikiriza mu kino, byombi gye ndi kye kimu. 314. Abalabe bange bagudde ebbali w’akabonero mu kunkuba kwabwe kuno. Nze si nze muntu oyo. Nneegomba nti bo bennyini babeere nga tebalina musango. Singa abenzi n’abakaba bonna mu Bungereza bawanikibwa mu bulago okutuusa lwe bafa, John Bunyan, oyo gwe bakwatirwa obuggya, yandibadde akyali mulamu era bulungi. Simanyi obanga waliwo ekintu ng’omukazi assa omukka wansi w’eggulu lyonna, okuggyako olw’engoye zaabwe, abaana baabwe, oba olw’ebigambo ebimanyiddwa bonna, okuggyako mukyala wange. 315. Era mu kino neewuunya amagezi ga Katonda, nti yanfuula omuntu ow’ensonyi eri abakazi okuva lwe nnakyuka okutuusa kaakano. Abo abamanyi, era abayinza okunjulira, be nnasinga okubeera nabo okumpi, nti kintu kya buzibu okundaba nga nneeyisa mu ngeri ey’okusanyusa eri omukazi; okulamusa omukazi okwa bulijjo nkukyawa, kunnyiwaza mu muntu yenna gwe nkulabako. Okubeera nabo bokka, sikigumira. Sitera na kukwata ku mukono gwa mukazi, kubanga ndowooza ebintu bino tebinsaanira. Bwe ndabye abasajja abalungi nga banywegera abakazi be baakyaliddeko, oba abaabakyalidde, emirundi egimu mbiwakanyizza, era bwe bandiddamu nti kyali kya mpisa nnungi bubeezi, mbagambye nti si kyakulaba kirungi; abamu mazima baawolereza okunywegera okutukuvu, naye olwo ne mbabuuza lwaki baasosola, lwaki baanywegera abasinga obulungi, ne baleka abatali balungi; bwe kityo, ebintu ng’ebyo ne bwe byandibadde bitenderezebwa batya mu maaso g’abalala, mu maaso gange bibadde tebisaana. 316. Era kaakano okumaliriza ensonga eno, mpita si bantu bokka, naye ne bamalayika, okukakasa nti nnina omusango gw’okwegatta n’omukazi yenna mu mubiri okuggyako mukyala wange; era sitya kukikola omulundi ogwokubiri, nga mmanyi nti siyinza kunyiiza Mukama mu nsonga ng’eyo, okuyita Katonda okuba omujulirwa ku mwoyo gwange, nti mu bintu bino siriiko musango. Si nti nkuumiddwa bwe ntyo olw’obulungi bwonna obuli mu nze okusinga omulala yenna, wabula Katonda ansaasidde, era ankuumye; gwe nsaba ankuume bulijjo, si mu kino kyokka, naye ne mu buli kkubo n’omulimu omubi, era ankuume okutuuka mu bwakabaka bwe obw’omu ggulu. Amiina. 317. Kaakano nga Setaani bwe yafuba, olw’okuvumibwa n’okuwaayiriza, okunfuula ekinyoomebwa mu bannansi bange, bwe kiba nga kiyinzika okubuulira kwange kufuulibwe okutaliimu, bwe kityo ne kwongerwako okusibibwa mu kkomera okw’ekiseera ekiwanvu era ekikooya, ndyoke ntiisibwe ndeke obuweereza bwange eri Kristo, n’ensi etiisibwe, ne batya okujja okumpulira nga mbuulira; ekyo nja kukibawa ennyinyonnyola ennyimpi mu kitundu ekiddako.

fields.title: Ebimpi ku Kusibibwa kw’Omuwandiisi mu Kkomera
fields.body_html:
318. Bwe nnamala ebbanga ddene nga njatula enjiri ey’ekitiibwa eya Kristo, era nga ngibuulira okumala emyaka ng’etaano, nnakwatibwa mu lukuŋŋaana lw’abantu abalungi mu kyalo, era mu bo, singa banndeka, nnandibadde mbuulidde olunaku olwo; naye ne bantwala okuva mu bo, ne bantwala mu maaso g’omulamuzi; oyo, newaakubadde nga nnali mmaze okuwaayo omusingo nti ndirabikako mu lukiiko lw’emisango oluddako, yansindika mu kkomera, kubanga abanneeyimirira tebakkiriza kweyama nti sijja kuddamu kubuulira bantu.

319. Mu lukiiko lw’emisango, bwe nnamala okuvunaanibwa ng’omuwagizi era omukuumi w’enkuŋŋaana ezitali mu mateeka n’enkuŋŋaana ez’ekyama, era olw’obutagoberera kusinza kwa ggwanga okw’Ekkanisa ya Bungereza, era nga tumaze okuteesaako n’abalamuzi, bo, nga batwala okwogera kwange okw’obwesimbu nga kwe kukkiriza omusango, nga bwe baakiyita, ne bansalira okugobebwa mu nsi emirembe gyonna, kubanga nnagaana okugoberera. Awo bwe nnaddamu okuweebwa mu mikono gy’omukuumi w’ekkomera, ne banzizza mu kkomera, era mmazeemu kaakano emyaka kkumi n’ebiri miramba, nga nnindirira okulaba Katonda ky’anaaganya abasajja abo okunkola.

320. Mu mbeera eyo mbaddemu n’obumativu bungi, olw’ekisa, naye omutima gwange gusanze okukyukakyuka n’okusika kungi, okuva eri Mukama, n’eri Setaani, n’eri obwonoonefu bwange; era mu ebyo byonna, ekitiibwa kibe eri Yesu Kristo! nfunye, mu bintu ebingi, okulabulwa okungi, okuyigirizibwa n’okutegeera, bye sijja kwogerako wano mu bujjuvu; wabula okubawa akabonero kamu oba bubiri, ekigambo ekiyinza okukubiriza abatya Katonda okumutendereza n’okunsabira; era n’okuzzibwamu amaanyi, singa embeera eyo ebatuukako, baleme kutya muntu ky’ayinza kubakola.

321. Mu bulamu bwange bwonna saali nnyingiddeko nnyo mu Kigambo kya Katonda nga kaakano; Ebyawandiikibwa bye nnali sirabangamu kintu, mu kifo kino ne mu mbeera eno byafuuka bimasamasa gye ndi; era Yesu Kristo teyali wa ddala era alabika lwatu nga kaakano; wano mmulabye era mmuwulidde ddala. Oh! ekigambo kiri, tetwagoberera ngero bugero ezaagunjibwa (2 Peetero 1:16), n’ekiri nti, Katonda eyamuzuukiza mu bafu, n’amuwa ekitiibwa, era okukkiriza kwammwe n’okusuubira kwammwe kyebivudde binywerera ku Katonda, bye byali ebigambo eby’omukisa gye ndi mu mbeera eno ey’okusibibwa kwange.

322. Ebyawandiikibwa bino bisatu oba bina nabyo bimbeeredde ekiwummulo ekinene mu mbeera eno (Yokaana 14:1-4; Yokaana 16:33; Abakkolosaayi 3:3, 4; Abaebbulaniya 12:22-24). N’olwekyo oluusi bwe mbadde mu buwoomi bwabyo, nsobodde okusekerera okuzikirira, n’obutatya mbalaasi wadde omwebagazi waayo. Mu kifo kino ndabye okulaba okuwooma okw’okusonyiyibwa ebibi byange, n’okubeera kwange ne Yesu mu nsi endala. Oh! olusozi Sayuuni, Yerusaalemi eky’omu ggulu, enkumi n’enkumi ez’abamalayika, ne Katonda Omulamuzi wa bonna, n’emyoyo egy’abantu abaatukirizibwa, ne Yesu (Abaebbulaniya 12:22-24), bimbeeredde biwoomu mu kifo kino. Wano ndabye ekyo, kye nkakasa nti sigenda kusobola, nga nkyali mu nsi muno, kukyogera: ndabye amazima mu kyawandiikibwa kino, “Newaakubadde nga Yesu oyo temumulabangako, kyokka mumwagala, era ne kaakano temumulaba naye mumukkiriza ne mujjula essanyu eritayogerekeka ne mumugulumiza” (1 Peetero 1:8).

323. Sibangako kumanya kiki Katonda okuyimirira nange mu buli mbeera, ne mu buli kugezaako kwa Setaani okumbonyaabonya, n’ebirala, nga bwe mmuzudde okuva lwe nnajja wano: Kubanga laba, okutya nga bwe kwejjanga gye ndi, n’obuyambi n’okuzzibwamu amaanyi bwe bityo bwe byajjanga; weewaawo, bwe nnakankananga, ng’oli atiisibwa ekisiikirize kye kyokka, Katonda, nga anfaako nnyo, teyandekanga kutawaanyizibwa, wabula yannywezanga n’ekyawandiikibwa kimu oba ekirala okulwanyisa byonna; n’okutuuka n’okwogera emirundi mingi nti, Singa kyali kikkirizibwa, nnandisabye ennaku esingako, olw’okubudaabudibwa okusingako (Omubuulizi 7:14; 2 Abakkolinso 1:5).

324. Nga sinnaba kugenda mu kkomera, nnalaba ekyali kijja, era nnalina naddala ebirowoozo bibiri ebyali bibuguumirira ku mutima gwange; ekisooka kyali, nnyinza ntya okugumiikiriza, singa okusibibwa kwange kuba kwa bbanga ddene era okukooya; eky’okubiri kyali, nnyinza ntya okusisinkana okufa, singa ekyo kye kiba omugabo gwange. Ku kisooka, ekyawandiikibwa kiri (Abakkolosaayi 1:11), kyanjigiriza nnyo, kwe kugamba, okusaba Katonda, “Amaanyi ag’ekitiibwa kye, galibafuula abagumiikiriza mu buli nsonga yonna, mulyoke musanyuke.” Nga sinnasibibwa, okumala omwaka mulamba ogutali mutono, nnali sitera kugenda kusaba nga okusaba kuno okuwooma tekwesindise mu birowoozo byange, ne kunkakasa nti bwe mba ndiyita mu kubonaabona okw’ebbanga ddene, nteekwa okubeera n’obugumiikiriza, naddala bwe mba ndikugumiikiriza n’essanyu.

325. Ku kirowoozo eky’okubiri, ekigambo kino kyangasa nnyo, “ Naye ffe ffennyini nga tusaliddwa gwa kufa, nga tetusaanidde kwetekamu bwesige bwaffe ffe, wabula mu Katonda azuukiza abafu” (2 Abakkolinso 1:9). Olw’ekyawandiikibwa kino nnalabisibwa nti, Bwe mba ndibonaabona mu ngeri entuufu, nteekwa okusooka okusalira ekibonerezo eky’okufa buli kintu ekiyinza okuyitibwa mu butuufu ekintu eky’obulamu buno, n’okutuuka n’okubala nze kennyini, mukyala wange, abaana bange, obulamu bwange, ebinsanyusa, ne byonna, nga bifu gye ndi, nange nga ndi mufu gye biri.

326. Eky’okubiri kyali kubeera nga nneesigama ku Katonda atalabika, nga Pawulo bwe yagamba mu kifo ekirala; engeri y’obutaggwaamu maanyi kwe kuba nti “tetutunuulira bintu ebirabika naye ebintu ebitalabika, kubanga ebintu ebirabika bya kiseera buseera, naye ebyo ebitalabika bya mirembe na mirembe.” (2 Abakkolinso 4:18). Era bwe ntyo ne nneebuuza mu mutima gwange, Bwe nneeteekerateekera kkomera lyokka, olwo kibooko ejja nga sikyetegekedde, era n’enkondo ey’okuswazibwako bw’etyo. Ate, bwe nneeteekerateekera ebyo byokka, olwo siba mwetegefu kugobebwa mu nsi: Era, bwe nsalawo nti okugobebwa kye kisinga obubi, olwo okufa bwe kujja kunsanga nga sikwetegekedde: Kale ndaba nti, engeri esinga obulungi ey’okuyita mu kubonaabona kwe kwesiga Katonda mu Kristo, ku bikwata ku nsi egenda okujja; ate ku bikwata ku nsi eno, okubala amagombe nga ge maka gange, okwala obuliri bwange mu kizikiza; okugamba obuvundu nti, Ggwe kitange, n’eri envunyu nti, Ggwe mmange era mwannyinaze: kwe kugamba, okwemanyiiza ebintu bino.

327. Naye newaakubadde nga nnalina obuyambi buno, nneezuula nga ndi muntu eyeetooloddwa obunafu; okwawukana ne mukyala wange n’abaana bange abeennaku kubaddenga gye ndi mu kifo kino ng’okusikula ennyama ku magumba, era ekyo si lwa kuba nti njagala nnyo nnyo ebirabo bino ebinene eby’ekisa kyokka, naye era kubanga emirundi mingi nnajjukiranga ebizibu ebingi, ennaku n’obwetaavu, ebyali biyinza okutuuka ku b’omu maka gange abeennaku singa nnaggyibwa ku bo, naddala omwana wange omwennaku omuzibe w’amaaso, eyali asinga byonna okubeera okumpi n’omutima gwange. Oh! ebirowoozo ku bizibu bye nnalowooza nti omwana wange omuzibe ayinza okuyitamu, byamenyaamenyanga omutima gwange.

328. Omwana omwennaku! bwe nnalowooza, ng’ojja kuba n’ennaku nnyingi ng’omugabo gwo mu nsi muno! Ojja kukubwa, ojja kusabiriza, obonaabone enjala, empewo, obwereere, n’ebizibu lukumi, newaakubadde nga kaakano sisobola kugumiikiriza na mpewo okukufuuwa. Naye bwe nneddamu, ne ndowooza nti, Nteekwa okubaleka mwenna mu mikono gya Katonda, newaakubadde nga kinnuma okutuuka ku mutima okubaleka. Oh! nnalaba nti mu mbeera eno nnali ng’omusajja amenya ennyumba ye ng’agisuula ku mitwe gya mukazi we n’abaana be ; naye ne ndowooza nti, Nteekwa okukikola, nteekwa okukikola. Era kaakano ne ndowooza ku ente bbiri ezaakazaala ezaali zigenda okutwala essanduuko ya Katonda mu nsi endala, ne ziva ku ennyana zaazo (1 Samwiri 6:10).

329. Naye ekyannyamba mu kukemebwa kuno bye birowoozo ebitali bimu, mu byo ebisatu naddala nja kubyogerako wano: Ekisooka kyali kulowooza ku byawandiikibwa bino ebibiri, “ Bamulekwa mu mmwe mubaleke, ndibalabirira. Ne bannamwandu mu mmwe banneesige.” Era nate, “ Mukama agamba nti, Ddala ndikununula olw’ekigendererwa ekirungi, ddala ndireetera abalabe bo okukwegayirira, mu biseera eby’okuluma obujiji, mu biseera eby’akabi” (Yeremiya 49:11; 15:11).

330. Era nnalina n’ekirowoozo kino, nti bwe mba ndiwaayo byonna ku lwa Katonda, nnali nneesibye ku Katonda okulabirira ensonga zange: naye bwe nnandimwabulidde mu makubo ge, olw’okutya akabi konna akayinza okuntuukako oba ku bange, olwo sandikoze kino kyokka okufuula okwatula kwange obulimba, naye nnandibadde mbala nti ensonga zange tezaali nkakafu nga zirekeddwa ku bigere bya Katonda, nga nze nnyimiridde ku lw’erinnya lye, nga bwe zandibadde singa zaali wansi w’obulabirizi bwange, newaakubadde nga kwe kwegaana ekkubo lya Katonda. Kino kyali kirowoozo ekyanjokyanga, era ng’ebyuma ebisongovu ebifumita omubiri gwange. Era ekyawandiikibwa ekyo kyannyamba nnyo okukinyweza ennyo ku nze, Kristo w’asaba ku Yuda, nti Katonda amulemese mu birowoozo bye eby’okwefaako, ebyamukubiriza okutunda mukama we. Nkwegayiridde, kisome n’obwegendereza (Zabbuli 109:6-20).

331. Era nnalina n’ekirowoozo ekirala, nga kwe kutya okubonyaabonyezebwa okw’omu ggeyeena, kwe nnali nkakasa nti abo bateekwa okugabanako, abo abaddirira okwatula Kristo, ebigambo bye n’amateeka ge, mu maaso g’abantu, olw’okutya omusaalaba; era nnalowooza n’ekitiibwa kye yategekera abo abaayimirira mu makubo ge mu maaso gaabwe mu kukkiriza, ne mu kwagala, ne mu bugumiikiriza. Ebintu bino, nkigamba, binnyambye, ebirowoozo ku nnaku nze n’ab’ewange gye tuyinza okutuukibwako olw’okwatula kwange bwe bibadde binnuma ku mutima.

332. Bwe nnalowoozanga ddala nti nnyinza okugobebwa mu nsi olw’okwatula kwange, olwo nnalowoozanga ku kyawandiikibwa ekyo, “ Baakubibwa amayinja, baasalibwamu n’emisumeeno, ne battibwa n’ekitala. Baatambulanga nga bambadde amaliba g’endiga n’ag’embuzi nga kumpi tebalina kantu, nga bali mu kwetaaga, ne banyigirizibwa, ne bayisibwa bubi; (n’ensi nga tebasaanira)” (Abaebbulaniya 11:37, 38); newaakubadde nga bonna baalowooza nti baali babi nnyo okubeera n’okutuula mu bo. Era nnalowooza n’ekigambo kino, “ Mwoyo Mutukuvu antegeeza,” “ nti okusibibwa n’okubonyaabonyezebwa binnindiridde mu buli kibuga” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:23). Mazima ddala ndowooza nti omwoyo gwange n’ekyo oluusi byawakana ku mbeera ennyiikaavu era embi ey’oyo agobeddwa mu nsi n’abeera mu buwaŋŋanguse, engeri gye baatuukibwangako enjala, empewo, obuzibu, obwereere, abalabe, n’ebizibu lukumi; era ku nkomerero, oboolyawo, okufiira mu lukonko ng’endiga ennaku eyalekebwa yokka. Naye nneebaza Katonda nti okutuusa kaakano sinnaba kunyeenyezebwa n’okuwakana kuno okw’obukujjukujju ennyo, wabula olw’okwo nneeyongedde okukakasa omutima gwange eri Katonda.

333. Nja kubabuulira ekintu ekyewuunyisa : Omulundi gumu, okusinga emirundi emirala gyonna, nnali mu mbeera ennyiikaavu ennyo era eya wansi okumala wiiki nnyingi; mu kiseera ekyo, nga ndi musibe akyali muto, era nga simanyi mateeka, nnalina kino nga kinzitoowerera nnyo ku mwoyo, nti okusibibwa kwange kuyinza okukoma nga mpanikibwa ku muti, nga bwe nnali simanyi. Awo Setaani n’annumbagana nnyo, okunzigyamu omwoyo, ng’ankubiriza bw’ati: Naye kiriba kitya, bw’olituuka ddala okufa, n’oba mu mbeera eno; kwe kugamba, nga towulira buwoomi bwa bintu bya Katonda, wadde okubeera n’obukakafu bwonna ku mmeeme yo obw’embeera ennungi oluvannyuma ? kubanga mazima mu kiseera kino ebintu byonna ebya Katonda byali bikwekeddwa emmeeme yange.

334. Noolwekyo bwe nnasooka okulowooza ku kino, kyanteganya nnyo; kubanga nnalowooza mu mutima gwange nti, mu mbeera gye nnalimu kaakano, nnali sisaanidde kufa, era sirowooza nti nnandisobodde singa nnayitibwa okufa; ate era nnalowooza nti, singa nnandifubye okulinnya eddaala, naye nnandibadde, oba nga nkankana oba n’obubonero obulala obw’okuzirika, mpa omulabe omukisa okuvuma ekkubo lya Katonda n’abantu be olw’okutya kwabwe. Kino, kale, kyanzitoowerera nnyo, kubanga nnalowooza nti kyandinswazizza okufa n’amaaso agaggwaamu omusaayi, n’amaviivi agakankana, mu nsonga ng’eno.

335. Noolwekyo ne nsaba Katonda ambudaabude, era ampe amaanyi okukola n’okubonaabona kyonna ky’alinjita okukola; naye tewaalabika kubudaabudibwa kwonna, wabula byonna ne bisigala nga bikwekeddwa; era mu kiseera kino ebirowoozo by’okufa byali bimbuutikidde ddala, nti emirundi mingi nnali ng’ali ku ddaala ng’omuguwa guli mu bulago bwange; kino kyokka kye kyali kinzizaamu amaanyi katono, nnalowooza nti kaakano nnyinza okufuna omukisa okwogera ebigambo byange ebisembayo eri ekibiina ky’abantu, abo be nnalowooza nti bandizze okundaba nga nfa; era ne ndowooza nti, oba nga kiteekwa okuba bwe kityo, singa Katonda akyusa emmeeme emu yokka olw’ebigambo byange ebisembayo, sijja kubala bulamu bwange nga busuuliddwa oba nga bubuze.

336. Naye era ebintu byonna ebya Katonda byakwekebwa amaaso gange, era omukemi n’angoberera ng’agamba, Naye onoogenda wa bw’onoofa? kiki ekinaakubaako ? onoosangibwa wa mu nsi endala? bukakafu ki bw’olina obw’eggulu n’ekitiibwa, n’omugabo mu abo abaatukuzibwa ? Bwe ntyo ne nsuukundibwa okumala wiiki nnyingi, nga simanyi kya kukola; ku nkomerero ekirowoozo kino ne kingwako n’obuzito, nti kyali ku lw’ekigambo n’ekkubo lya Katonda kye nnali mu mbeera eno; noolwekyo nnali nneesibye obutadda mabega wadde akatundu k’oluviiri.

337. Era nnalowooza nti Katonda ayinza okwesalirawo oba anampa okubudaabudibwa kaakano oba mu ssaawa ey’okufa; naye nze siyinza kwesalirawo oba nnaakwata okwatula kwange oba nedda ; nze nnali nsibiddwa, naye ye yali wa ddembe; weewaawo, kyali kya buvunaanyizibwa bwange okunywerera ku kigambo kye, oba alintunuulira oba alindokola ku nkomerero oba nedda: noolwekyo ne ndowooza nti, ensonga bw’eri bw’etyo, nze ngenda mu maaso, nga mpaayo embeera yange ey’emirembe gyonna eri Kristo, ka mbe n’okubudaabudibwa wano oba nedda. Katonda bw’atayingira, bwe nnalowooza, nja kubuuka okuva ku ddaala nga nzibiddwa n’amaaso ne ngwa mu nsi etaggwaawo, mbbire oba nseeyeeye, ka kibe ggulu, ka kibe ggeyeena, Mukama Yesu, bw’oba onoonkwata, nkwata; bw’oba nedda, nja kwewaayo ku lw’erinnya lyo.

338. Nnali nga nkyaakamala okunywera mu kusalawo kuno, ekigambo kino ne kingwako, Yobu, ekitiibwa akussaamu kya bwereere? Ng’omuwawaabirizi bw’aba ng’agamba nti, Mukama, Yobu si muntu mwesimbu, akuweereza olw’ebyo by’afunamu: Tomukozeeko lukomera. Naye kale geza okwate ku by’alina obimuggyeko olabe nga taakwegaane nga n’ensi yonna eraba. Kale, ne ndowooza nti, kino kye kabonero k’emmeeme ennongoofu, okwagala okuweereza Katonda nga byonna bimuggiddwako? Oyo atya Katonda ye oyo anaaweereza Katonda bwereere mu kifo ky’okulekulira? Katonda atenderezebwe; kale nsuubira nti nnina omutima omwesimbu, kubanga mmaliridde, Katonda ng’ampa amaanyi, obutegaana okwatula kwange, newaakubadde nga sandifunye kintu kyonna olw’okufuba kwange: era bwe nnali nkyalowooza bwe ntyo, ekyawandiikibwa kino ne kiteekebwa mu maaso gange (Zabbuli 44:12-26).

339. Awo omutima gwange ne gujjula okubudaabudibwa, kubanga nnasuubira nti kwali kwa mazima: Sandyagadde kubulwa kugezesebwa kuno na lwa bingi; mbudaabudibwa buli lwe nkirowoozaako, era nsuubira nga nja kutendereza Katonda emirembe gyonna olw’okuyigirizibwa kwe nfunye mu kyo. Nnyinza okunyumya ebintu ebirala bingi Katonda bye yankolera, naye bino, ku byanyagibwa mu ntalo, mbiwonze okuddaabiriza ennyumba ya Katonda (1 Ebyomumirembe 26:27).
