Bwe nnamala ebbanga ddene nga njatula enjiri ey’ekitiibwa eya Kristo, era nga ngibuulira okumala emyaka ng’etaano, nnakwatibwa mu lukuŋŋaana lw’abantu abalungi mu kyalo, era mu bo, singa banndeka, nnandibadde mbuulidde olunaku olwo; naye ne bantwala okuva mu bo, ne bantwala mu maaso g’omulamuzi; oyo, newaakubadde nga nnali mmaze okuwaayo omusingo nti ndirabikako mu lukiiko lw’emisango oluddako, yansindika mu kkomera, kubanga abanneeyimirira tebakkiriza kweyama nti sijja kuddamu kubuulira bantu. 319. Mu lukiiko lw’emisango, bwe nnamala okuvunaanibwa ng’omuwagizi era omukuumi w’enkuŋŋaana ezitali mu mateeka n’enkuŋŋaana ez’ekyama, era olw’obutagoberera kusinza kwa ggwanga okw’Ekkanisa ya Bungereza, era nga tumaze okuteesaako n’abalamuzi, bo, nga batwala okwogera kwange okw’obwesimbu nga kwe kukkiriza omusango, nga bwe baakiyita, ne bansalira okugobebwa mu nsi emirembe gyonna, kubanga nnagaana okugoberera. Awo bwe nnaddamu okuweebwa mu mikono gy’omukuumi w’ekkomera, ne banzizza mu kkomera, era mmazeemu kaakano emyaka kkumi n’ebiri miramba, nga nnindirira okulaba Katonda ky’anaaganya abasajja abo okunkola. 320. Mu mbeera eyo mbaddemu n’obumativu bungi, olw’ekisa, naye omutima gwange gusanze okukyukakyuka n’okusika kungi, okuva eri Mukama, n’eri Setaani, n’eri obwonoonefu bwange; era mu ebyo byonna, ekitiibwa kibe eri Yesu Kristo! nfunye, mu bintu ebingi, okulabulwa okungi, okuyigirizibwa n’okutegeera, bye sijja kwogerako wano mu bujjuvu; wabula okubawa akabonero kamu oba bubiri, ekigambo ekiyinza okukubiriza abatya Katonda okumutendereza n’okunsabira; era n’okuzzibwamu amaanyi, singa embeera eyo ebatuukako, baleme kutya muntu ky’ayinza kubakola. 321. Mu bulamu bwange bwonna saali nnyingiddeko nnyo mu Kigambo kya Katonda nga kaakano; Ebyawandiikibwa bye nnali sirabangamu kintu, mu kifo kino ne mu mbeera eno byafuuka bimasamasa gye ndi; era Yesu Kristo teyali wa ddala era alabika lwatu nga kaakano; wano mmulabye era mmuwulidde ddala. Oh! ekigambo kiri, tetwagoberera ngero bugero ezaagunjibwa (2 Peetero 1:16), n’ekiri nti, Katonda eyamuzuukiza mu bafu, n’amuwa ekitiibwa, era okukkiriza kwammwe n’okusuubira kwammwe kyebivudde binywerera ku Katonda, bye byali ebigambo eby’omukisa gye ndi mu mbeera eno ey’okusibibwa kwange. 322. Ebyawandiikibwa bino bisatu oba bina nabyo bimbeeredde ekiwummulo ekinene mu mbeera eno (Yokaana 14:1-4; Yokaana 16:33; Abakkolosaayi 3:3, 4; Abaebbulaniya 12:22-24). N’olwekyo oluusi bwe mbadde mu buwoomi bwabyo, nsobodde okusekerera okuzikirira, n’obutatya mbalaasi wadde omwebagazi waayo. Mu kifo kino ndabye okulaba okuwooma okw’okusonyiyibwa ebibi byange, n’okubeera kwange ne Yesu mu nsi endala. Oh! olusozi Sayuuni, Yerusaalemi eky’omu ggulu, enkumi n’enkumi ez’abamalayika, ne Katonda Omulamuzi wa bonna, n’emyoyo egy’abantu abaatukirizibwa, ne Yesu (Abaebbulaniya 12:22-24), bimbeeredde biwoomu mu kifo kino. Wano ndabye ekyo, kye nkakasa nti sigenda kusobola, nga nkyali mu nsi muno, kukyogera: ndabye amazima mu kyawandiikibwa kino, “Newaakubadde nga Yesu oyo temumulabangako, kyokka mumwagala, era ne kaakano temumulaba naye mumukkiriza ne mujjula essanyu eritayogerekeka ne mumugulumiza” (1 Peetero 1:8). 323. Sibangako kumanya kiki Katonda okuyimirira nange mu buli mbeera, ne mu buli kugezaako kwa Setaani okumbonyaabonya, n’ebirala, nga bwe mmuzudde okuva lwe nnajja wano: Kubanga laba, okutya nga bwe kwejjanga gye ndi, n’obuyambi n’okuzzibwamu amaanyi bwe bityo bwe byajjanga; weewaawo, bwe nnakankananga, ng’oli atiisibwa ekisiikirize kye kyokka, Katonda, nga anfaako nnyo, teyandekanga kutawaanyizibwa, wabula yannywezanga n’ekyawandiikibwa kimu oba ekirala okulwanyisa byonna; n’okutuuka n’okwogera emirundi mingi nti, Singa kyali kikkirizibwa, nnandisabye ennaku esingako, olw’okubudaabudibwa okusingako (Omubuulizi 7:14; 2 Abakkolinso 1:5). 324. Nga sinnaba kugenda mu kkomera, nnalaba ekyali kijja, era nnalina naddala ebirowoozo bibiri ebyali bibuguumirira ku mutima gwange; ekisooka kyali, nnyinza ntya okugumiikiriza, singa okusibibwa kwange kuba kwa bbanga ddene era okukooya; eky’okubiri kyali, nnyinza ntya okusisinkana okufa, singa ekyo kye kiba omugabo gwange. Ku kisooka, ekyawandiikibwa kiri (Abakkolosaayi 1:11), kyanjigiriza nnyo, kwe kugamba, okusaba Katonda, “Amaanyi ag’ekitiibwa kye, galibafuula abagumiikiriza mu buli nsonga yonna, mulyoke musanyuke.” Nga sinnasibibwa, okumala omwaka mulamba ogutali mutono, nnali sitera kugenda kusaba nga okusaba kuno okuwooma tekwesindise mu birowoozo byange, ne kunkakasa nti bwe mba ndiyita mu kubonaabona okw’ebbanga ddene, nteekwa okubeera n’obugumiikiriza, naddala bwe mba ndikugumiikiriza n’essanyu. 325. Ku kirowoozo eky’okubiri, ekigambo kino kyangasa nnyo, “ Naye ffe ffennyini nga tusaliddwa gwa kufa, nga tetusaanidde kwetekamu bwesige bwaffe ffe, wabula mu Katonda azuukiza abafu” (2 Abakkolinso 1:9). Olw’ekyawandiikibwa kino nnalabisibwa nti, Bwe mba ndibonaabona mu ngeri entuufu, nteekwa okusooka okusalira ekibonerezo eky’okufa buli kintu ekiyinza okuyitibwa mu butuufu ekintu eky’obulamu buno, n’okutuuka n’okubala nze kennyini, mukyala wange, abaana bange, obulamu bwange, ebinsanyusa, ne byonna, nga bifu gye ndi, nange nga ndi mufu gye biri. 326. Eky’okubiri kyali kubeera nga nneesigama ku Katonda atalabika, nga Pawulo bwe yagamba mu kifo ekirala; engeri y’obutaggwaamu maanyi kwe kuba nti “tetutunuulira bintu ebirabika naye ebintu ebitalabika, kubanga ebintu ebirabika bya kiseera buseera, naye ebyo ebitalabika bya mirembe na mirembe.” (2 Abakkolinso 4:18). Era bwe ntyo ne nneebuuza mu mutima gwange, Bwe nneeteekerateekera kkomera lyokka, olwo kibooko ejja nga sikyetegekedde, era n’enkondo ey’okuswazibwako bw’etyo. Ate, bwe nneeteekerateekera ebyo byokka, olwo siba mwetegefu kugobebwa mu nsi: Era, bwe nsalawo nti okugobebwa kye kisinga obubi, olwo okufa bwe kujja kunsanga nga sikwetegekedde: Kale ndaba nti, engeri esinga obulungi ey’okuyita mu kubonaabona kwe kwesiga Katonda mu Kristo, ku bikwata ku nsi egenda okujja; ate ku bikwata ku nsi eno, okubala amagombe nga ge maka gange, okwala obuliri bwange mu kizikiza; okugamba obuvundu nti, Ggwe kitange, n’eri envunyu nti, Ggwe mmange era mwannyinaze: kwe kugamba, okwemanyiiza ebintu bino. 327. Naye newaakubadde nga nnalina obuyambi buno, nneezuula nga ndi muntu eyeetooloddwa obunafu; okwawukana ne mukyala wange n’abaana bange abeennaku kubaddenga gye ndi mu kifo kino ng’okusikula ennyama ku magumba, era ekyo si lwa kuba nti njagala nnyo nnyo ebirabo bino ebinene eby’ekisa kyokka, naye era kubanga emirundi mingi nnajjukiranga ebizibu ebingi, ennaku n’obwetaavu, ebyali biyinza okutuuka ku b’omu maka gange abeennaku singa nnaggyibwa ku bo, naddala omwana wange omwennaku omuzibe w’amaaso, eyali asinga byonna okubeera okumpi n’omutima gwange. Oh! ebirowoozo ku bizibu bye nnalowooza nti omwana wange omuzibe ayinza okuyitamu, byamenyaamenyanga omutima gwange. 328. Omwana omwennaku! bwe nnalowooza, ng’ojja kuba n’ennaku nnyingi ng’omugabo gwo mu nsi muno! Ojja kukubwa, ojja kusabiriza, obonaabone enjala, empewo, obwereere, n’ebizibu lukumi, newaakubadde nga kaakano sisobola kugumiikiriza na mpewo okukufuuwa. Naye bwe nneddamu, ne ndowooza nti, Nteekwa okubaleka mwenna mu mikono gya Katonda, newaakubadde nga kinnuma okutuuka ku mutima okubaleka. Oh! nnalaba nti mu mbeera eno nnali ng’omusajja amenya ennyumba ye ng’agisuula ku mitwe gya mukazi we n’abaana be ; naye ne ndowooza nti, Nteekwa okukikola, nteekwa okukikola. Era kaakano ne ndowooza ku ente bbiri ezaakazaala ezaali zigenda okutwala essanduuko ya Katonda mu nsi endala, ne ziva ku ennyana zaazo (1 Samwiri 6:10). 329. Naye ekyannyamba mu kukemebwa kuno bye birowoozo ebitali bimu, mu byo ebisatu naddala nja kubyogerako wano: Ekisooka kyali kulowooza ku byawandiikibwa bino ebibiri, “ Bamulekwa mu mmwe mubaleke, ndibalabirira. Ne bannamwandu mu mmwe banneesige.” Era nate, “ Mukama agamba nti, Ddala ndikununula olw’ekigendererwa ekirungi, ddala ndireetera abalabe bo okukwegayirira, mu biseera eby’okuluma obujiji, mu biseera eby’akabi” (Yeremiya 49:11; 15:11). 330. Era nnalina n’ekirowoozo kino, nti bwe mba ndiwaayo byonna ku lwa Katonda, nnali nneesibye ku Katonda okulabirira ensonga zange: naye bwe nnandimwabulidde mu makubo ge, olw’okutya akabi konna akayinza okuntuukako oba ku bange, olwo sandikoze kino kyokka okufuula okwatula kwange obulimba, naye nnandibadde mbala nti ensonga zange tezaali nkakafu nga zirekeddwa ku bigere bya Katonda, nga nze nnyimiridde ku lw’erinnya lye, nga bwe zandibadde singa zaali wansi w’obulabirizi bwange, newaakubadde nga kwe kwegaana ekkubo lya Katonda. Kino kyali kirowoozo ekyanjokyanga, era ng’ebyuma ebisongovu ebifumita omubiri gwange. Era ekyawandiikibwa ekyo kyannyamba nnyo okukinyweza ennyo ku nze, Kristo w’asaba ku Yuda, nti Katonda amulemese mu birowoozo bye eby’okwefaako, ebyamukubiriza okutunda mukama we. Nkwegayiridde, kisome n’obwegendereza (Zabbuli 109:6-20). 331. Era nnalina n’ekirowoozo ekirala, nga kwe kutya okubonyaabonyezebwa okw’omu ggeyeena, kwe nnali nkakasa nti abo bateekwa okugabanako, abo abaddirira okwatula Kristo, ebigambo bye n’amateeka ge, mu maaso g’abantu, olw’okutya omusaalaba; era nnalowooza n’ekitiibwa kye yategekera abo abaayimirira mu makubo ge mu maaso gaabwe mu kukkiriza, ne mu kwagala, ne mu bugumiikiriza. Ebintu bino, nkigamba, binnyambye, ebirowoozo ku nnaku nze n’ab’ewange gye tuyinza okutuukibwako olw’okwatula kwange bwe bibadde binnuma ku mutima. 332. Bwe nnalowoozanga ddala nti nnyinza okugobebwa mu nsi olw’okwatula kwange, olwo nnalowoozanga ku kyawandiikibwa ekyo, “ Baakubibwa amayinja, baasalibwamu n’emisumeeno, ne battibwa n’ekitala. Baatambulanga nga bambadde amaliba g’endiga n’ag’embuzi nga kumpi tebalina kantu, nga bali mu kwetaaga, ne banyigirizibwa, ne bayisibwa bubi; (n’ensi nga tebasaanira)” (Abaebbulaniya 11:37, 38); newaakubadde nga bonna baalowooza nti baali babi nnyo okubeera n’okutuula mu bo. Era nnalowooza n’ekigambo kino, “ Mwoyo Mutukuvu antegeeza,” “ nti okusibibwa n’okubonyaabonyezebwa binnindiridde mu buli kibuga” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:23). Mazima ddala ndowooza nti omwoyo gwange n’ekyo oluusi byawakana ku mbeera ennyiikaavu era embi ey’oyo agobeddwa mu nsi n’abeera mu buwaŋŋanguse, engeri gye baatuukibwangako enjala, empewo, obuzibu, obwereere, abalabe, n’ebizibu lukumi; era ku nkomerero, oboolyawo, okufiira mu lukonko ng’endiga ennaku eyalekebwa yokka. Naye nneebaza Katonda nti okutuusa kaakano sinnaba kunyeenyezebwa n’okuwakana kuno okw’obukujjukujju ennyo, wabula olw’okwo nneeyongedde okukakasa omutima gwange eri Katonda. 333. Nja kubabuulira ekintu ekyewuunyisa : Omulundi gumu, okusinga emirundi emirala gyonna, nnali mu mbeera ennyiikaavu ennyo era eya wansi okumala wiiki nnyingi; mu kiseera ekyo, nga ndi musibe akyali muto, era nga simanyi mateeka, nnalina kino nga kinzitoowerera nnyo ku mwoyo, nti okusibibwa kwange kuyinza okukoma nga mpanikibwa ku muti, nga bwe nnali simanyi. Awo Setaani n’annumbagana nnyo, okunzigyamu omwoyo, ng’ankubiriza bw’ati: Naye kiriba kitya, bw’olituuka ddala okufa, n’oba mu mbeera eno; kwe kugamba, nga towulira buwoomi bwa bintu bya Katonda, wadde okubeera n’obukakafu bwonna ku mmeeme yo obw’embeera ennungi oluvannyuma ? kubanga mazima mu kiseera kino ebintu byonna ebya Katonda byali bikwekeddwa emmeeme yange. 334. Noolwekyo bwe nnasooka okulowooza ku kino, kyanteganya nnyo; kubanga nnalowooza mu mutima gwange nti, mu mbeera gye nnalimu kaakano, nnali sisaanidde kufa, era sirowooza nti nnandisobodde singa nnayitibwa okufa; ate era nnalowooza nti, singa nnandifubye okulinnya eddaala, naye nnandibadde, oba nga nkankana oba n’obubonero obulala obw’okuzirika, mpa omulabe omukisa okuvuma ekkubo lya Katonda n’abantu be olw’okutya kwabwe. Kino, kale, kyanzitoowerera nnyo, kubanga nnalowooza nti kyandinswazizza okufa n’amaaso agaggwaamu omusaayi, n’amaviivi agakankana, mu nsonga ng’eno. 335. Kale, ne ndowooza nti, kino kye kabonero k’emmeeme ennongoofu, okwagala okuweereza Katonda nga byonna bimuggiddwako? Oyo atya Katonda ye oyo anaaweereza Katonda bwereere mu kifo ky’okulekulira? Awo omutima gwange ne gujjula okubudaabudibwa, kubanga nnasuubira nti kwali kwa mazima: Sandyagadde kubulwa kugezesebwa kuno na lwa bingi; mbudaabudibwa buli lwe nkirowoozaako, era nsuubira nga nja kutendereza Katonda emirembe gyonna olw’okuyigirizibwa kwe nfunye mu kyo. Nnyinza okunyumya ebintu ebirala bingi Katonda bye yankolera, naye bino, ku byanyagibwa mu ntalo, mbiwonze okuddaabiriza ennyumba ya Katonda (1 Ebyomumirembe 26:27).

fields.title: Okufundikira
fields.body_html:
OKUFUNDIKIRA KW’EKITABU

1. Mu kukemebwa kwonna kwe nnali nsanze mu bulamu bwange, okubuusabuusa okubaawo kwa Katonda, n’amazima g’enjiri Ye, kwe kusinga obubi, era kwe kusinga okuzibu okugumiikiriza; okukemebwa kuno bwe kujja, kunzigyako olukoba lwange, ne kuggyawo emisingi wansi wange. Oh, emirundi mingi ndowoozezza ku kigambo ekyo, ‘ng’amazima lwe lukoba lwammwe lwe mwesibye mu kiwato kyammwe’; ne ku kiri, ‘Emisingi nga gizikirizibwa, omutuukirivu ayinza kukola ki?’

2. Oluusi, bwe nnamalanga okukola ekibi, ne nnindirira okukangavvulwa okw’amaanyi okuva mu mukono gwa Katonda, ekintu ekyasookanga okunzijira okuva gy’ali kwe kwolesebwa kw’ekisa kye. Oluusi, bwe mbadde mbudaabuddwa, neeyise musirusiru olw’okugwa ennyo bwe ntyo wansi w’ennaku. Ate era, bwe nnagwangamu amaanyi, nnalowooza nti saali mugezi okuwa okubudaabudibwa ekifo ekyenkanidde awo. Ebyo byombi byabanga ku nze n’amaanyi n’obuzito bwe butyo.

3. Neewuunyizza nnyo ekintu kino ekimu, nti newaakubadde nga Katonda akyalira emmeeme yange n’okwolesebwa okw’omukisa ennyo okwa ye yennyini, naye nzudde nate nti essaawa ezimu zinzijidde oluvannyuma, nga mu mwoyo gwange nzijudde ekizikiza, nga sisobola wadde omulundi ogumu okutegeera Katonda oyo kye ali n’okubudaabudibwa kuli kwe nnali nfunye ne kunzizzaamu obuggya.

4. Oluusi ndabye mu lunyiriri lumu olwa Bayibuli ebisinga bye nnandisobodde okugumira, ate mu kiseera ekirala Bayibuli yonna ebadde gye ndi nkalu ng’omuggo; oba okusingawo, omutima gwange gubadde mufu era mukalu gy’ali, nga sisobola kufunamu wadde akatundu akatono ennyo ak’okuzzibwa obuggya, newaakubadde nga ngyetegerezza yonna.

5. Mu maziga gonna, agasinga obulungi ge gaaleetebwa omusaayi gwa Kristo; ne mu ssanyu lyonna, erisinga obuwoomi lye ritabuddwamu okukungubagira Kristo. Oh! kintu kirungi nnyo okubeera ku maviivi gaffe, nga Kristo ali mu mikono gyaffe, mu maaso ga Katonda. Nsuubira nti mmanyiiko katono ku bintu bino.

6. Ne leero nsanga mu mutima gwange eby’omuzizo musanvu: (1) Okusikirizibwa eri obutakkiriza. (2) Okwerabira amangu okwagala n’okusaasira Kristo by’alaga. (3) Okwesigama ku bikolwa by’amateeka. (4) Okuwaba n’obunyogovu mu kusaba. (5) Okwerabira okutunula nga nnindirira kye nsaba. (6) Okwanguyirwa okwemulugunya kubanga sirina bingi, ate nga ndi mwetegefu okukozesa obubi bye nnina. (7) Siyinza kukola kintu na kimu ku ebyo Katonda by’andagira, nga obwonoonefu bwange tebwesindise mu byo, ‘nga bwe njagala okukola ebirungi, ekibi kimbeera kumpi.’

7. Ebintu bino mbiraba era mbiwulira buli kiseera, era bimbonyaabonya era binnyigiriza; naye amagezi ga Katonda gabitegeka okuba olw’obulungi bwange. (1) Bindeetera okwetamwa. (2) Binziyiza okwesiga omutima gwange. (3) Bimmatiza obutamala bwa butuukirivu bwonna obuli mu nze. (4) Bindaga obwetaavu bw’okuddukira eri Yesu. (5) Binkubiriza okusaba Katonda. (6) Bindaga obwetaavu bwe nnina obw’okutunula n’okuba omutebenkevu. (7) Era binkubiriza okutunuulira Katonda, mu Kristo, annyambe, era ampise mu nsi eno. Amiina.
